projects.title: Helix
projects.summary: Hold ⌥Space and your tools open in a ring around your pointer. 16 tools, including your apps, clipboard history, Spotify and Apple Music controls, notes and Claude or GPT. Your data stays only on your Mac. One-time purchase, no subscription.

projects.title: Voilà pro 支持离线实时输入了
projects.author: qfdk
projects.summary: 五月份发过一次帖,这是半年之后的一个更新. 期间收到了不少朋友的来信,也有不少的建议,一直没有做的是离线的输入,还有快捷键. Voilà pro 的混合输入之前是依赖网络模型,但是很多朋友希望用本地使用,并不想让数据云端处理. 并且对国内的用户不是很友好. 离线模型使用苹果的转录效率很低,准确也不是很好. 因为到现在为止，发现大多数离线的输入还是在转录层面。市面上比较出名的模型，一个是 Whisper ，还一个就是千问的模型，也就是 Qwen. ![]( https://i.v2ex.co/O9mSu727.png) 相信大家也看出来,新版的 Voilà 从 UI 上有了很大的变化,但是这不是重点,重点在于我们现在使用本地模型可以做到实时输入,而且做到混合输入,中文/英文/法语甚至其他的语言都可以同时输入 当然也有离线 api 可以调用 openai 兼容的服务器, 当然理论上用过 Voilà 的本地模型之后会感觉到他的强大的. 毕竟 Voilà Pro 是一开始使用古法编程来使用 Swift 做的，新版的 UI 当是借助了 "天才程序员" 加上 Voilà一起协作完成的 之前也发了不少早鸟授权,激活过,使用过的朋友一直有效,因为是离线激活. 重点: 只支持 Apple silicon 系列芯片, 离线模型 要 16G+ 的机器才有效 https://voilapro.app Voilà 有你们才会更美好

projects.title: 【工具自荐】Screen Capture for macOS：纯原生 Swift + ScreenCaptureKit 截图与防卡死滚动长截图工具（开源免费 / 过 Apple 公证）
projects.author: nasadunadu

github.name: nasadunadu/screen-capture-macos
github.description: Native Swift macOS screenshot & sticky-aware scrolling long-capture app (ScreenCaptureKit, Apple Notarized, 100% On-Device) · 原生免费无内购 Mac 截图与防卡死滚动长截图工具

projects.summary: GitHub 最新正式版 DMG 直接下载（v0.5.0 · Apple Silicon）： 为什么做这个工具？ 平时在 Mac 上最高频的截图动作只有两个：顺手截张图画个箭头（Command + 4） 和 把长网页/长聊天记录拼成一张滚动长图（Command + 5）。 但目前 Mac 截图工具普遍存在三个痛点： 1. 早期好用的免费工具（如 iShot、Xnip）塞满了会员付费墙、长图水印与冗余后台功能； 2. 滚动截长图极易翻车：遇到带顶部固定导航栏（Sticky Header）或底部悬浮输入框（Sticky Footer）的页面，滚到中段要么卡死不动，要么每隔一屏就残留一条重复的底部栏； 3. 升级到 macOS 26/27 + 120Hz ProMotion 高刷屏后，部分基于旧窗口过滤机制的截图工具在快速销毁浮窗时会触发 WindowServer 的 CARenderUpdateValidateRestrictedLayerHosts 崩溃黑屏。 因此我用纯原生 Swift + AppKit + ScreenCaptureKit + Accelerate 编写并开源了 Screen Capture for macOS（v0.5.0）——100% 免费开源（Apache-2.0）、零广告、零内购、零网络权限（所有像素仅在本机内存处理），且已通过 Apple 官方 Developer ID 签名与公证（Notarized）。 核心特性 1. 防卡死、自动去吸底的滚动长截图（Command + 5）： 左栏实时滚动视口、右栏无缝拼接预览； 解耦固定顶/底栏遮罩搜索对普通匹配得分的前置门限，结合水平与垂直双维梯度能量识别静止底栏； 滚动中途一旦检出固定底栏，立即通过 trimOutputTail 从已拼接尾部精确裁除，配合 84px 灰度粗配准、1:1 原生像素级垂直微调（±3px）与快速滚动两步前瞻（2-step lookahead），彻底告别长图断层与重影。 2. 紧凑型 AI 时代精细矢量工具条（Command + 4）： 使用 SwiftUI Canvas 原生绘制全套 17×17pt 矢量图标，31×31pt 紧凑热区 + 毛玻璃胶囊外观； 支持 #8839EF 紫色四角标尺二次缩放/移动选区、前粗后细渐变箭头、圆角阴影导出与全流程 Escape 取消。 3. macOS 26/27 WindowServer 120Hz 稳定性加固： 采用进程级 SCContentFilter(desktopIndependentWindow:excludingApplications:) 过滤自身窗口，并设计 EditorPanel.retire 跨渲染周期延后 50ms 安全释放机制。 一键安装（支持 Apple Silicon M1–M5，macOS 14+） bash brew tap nasadunadu/tap brew install --cask screencapture

projects.title: Show HN: HackerFlow – A Responsive HN Reader

I just can't seem to leave well enough alone I built HackerFlow because I wanted to browse HN visually while keeping articles and comments in the same place.The goal is a fast UI that stays out of the way but offers more visuals. Seamlessly test, mock, and monitor HTTP/REST, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSockets, MQTT, and MCP directly in your browser. Stores output in Obsidian or as Markdown, available in German & English.

projects.title: Hemmed
projects.summary: Native macOS app that hides menu bar icons behind one item, rescues icons stuck behind the notch, pins menu commands to hotkeys, keeps new menu bar apps hidden, flags battery-hungry hidden apps, and syncs your layout across your Macs with iCloud.

projects.title: Tracked
projects.summary: Native time tracking for freelancers who bill by the hour. Start a timer from the menu bar or the MacBook notch, and fix forgotten time by dragging blocks onto your day. Projects with hourly rates and budgets become PDF timesheets clients accept. A built-in MCP server lets Claude start timers and log your hours. Import your full history from Tyme, Toggl, Clockify, Harvest & more. No account, your data stays on your devices. One purchase covers Mac, iPhone, iPad & Apple Watch, widgets included.

projects.title: CubbyPad
projects.summary: Apple removed Launchpad in macOS 26. CubbyPad brings back the full-screen app grid: pages, folders you arrange, F4, hot corners and the trackpad pinch. Then it goes further: a search bar that does maths, opens System Settings pages and runs your Shortcuts; Apple Intelligence that sorts your apps into folders on your Mac; and a row of the apps you use at this time of day. One-time purchase for 2 Macs, in 20 languages.

projects.title: Sessions Pro for Cursor
projects.summary: Cursor stays signed in to one account at a time, so switching between work, personal and client accounts means logging out and back in. Each keeps its own login, chats, settings, extensions and agent data; MCP servers, rules and skills stay shared. On a Mac, every account is its own app in the Dock, with a menu bar switcher and each account's monthly usage.

projects.title: AgentsCircle

projects.title: Switchdesk

projects.title: Yuzu Shot
projects.summary: Capture an area, window or full display with ⌘⇧4/5/3 and the editor opens right away, with the raw shot already on your clipboard. Fourteen tools with one-key shortcuts: arrows, shapes, text, counters, redaction, pen, emoji, crop and frame. ⌘S saves; export PNG, JPEG, HEIC or WebP. Annotate any image from Finder too. projects.title: Facebook Reels Controls

projects.title: OZEN — Your AI Assistant for Windows
projects.summary: Meet OZEN, your personal AI assistant for Windows. Interact with your computer more naturally through AI-powered voice interaction and computer assistance. Built to make everyday desktop workflows more intuitive, OZEN brings your AI assistant experience closer to your Windows environment. Try OZEN, explore its features, and share your feedback to help shape its future.

projects.title: 【工具自荐】Crossbow：开源跨平台的现代化代理客户端（mihomo / sing-box 双内核）
projects.author: Richard-Zhang1019

github.name: Richard-Zhang1019/Crossbow
github.description: Proxy Client

projects.summary: 1. 项目简介 Crossbow 是一款开源的跨平台网络代理客户端，基于 Tauri 2 + React + Rust 构建，支持 mihomo / sing-box 双内核一键切换。它把订阅管理、节点选择、系统代理、TUN 模式、连接与日志放在同一个界面里，并在托盘 / 菜单栏常驻实时上下行速率。目前提供 macOS（Apple Silicon，Developer ID 签名 + 公证 + 自动更新）、Windows x64（系统级服务承载 TUN）与 Linux x8664（实验性）安装包。 2. 解决痛点 内核与界面割裂：mihomo / sing-box 官方只发布内核本体，命令行与 YAML 配置门槛不低；现有图形客户端或闭源、或体积庞大、或内置大量用不到的功能。 双内核难以对比：想在不同网络环境下比较 Clash Meta 与 sing-box 的表现，通常要手动改配置来回重启。 托盘信息量不足：多数客户端托盘只剩一个开关，想知道当前速率得点开主界面。 TUN 与系统代理互斥：不少客户端二者只能二选一，切换成本高。 Crossbow 针对这四点给出了一体化的开源答案。 3. 项目亮点 双内核热切换：mihomo / sing-box 随时切换，配置自动转换，启动失败快速报错。 系统代理与 TUN 独立控制：可同时开启、分别关闭；macOS 一键管理员授权，Windows 由受控系统服务承载 TUN，带端口自愈与接管自愈能力。 菜单栏实时速率：macOS 菜单栏双行常驻显示上下行速率（等宽字体、宽度零抖动），托盘菜单内可直接切换节点、批量测延迟。 轻量原生：Tauri 2 而非 Electron，安装包小、内存占用低，完整适配深浅色主题。 工程化发布：双平台 CI 构建、macOS 签名 + 公证、启动冒烟验证、SHA256SUMS 与应用内自动更新。 4.

projects.title: Initial Launch
projects.summary: OneFrame is a macOS window manager for people who love clean, organized workspaces. Easily stack multiple Mac windows into a single slot and switch between them using tabs. ✨ Key Features: - Combine multiple app windows into one frame - Switch smoothly between apps using tabs - Keep your Mac desktop clutter-free and stay focused - Free to use for 1 stack and up to 4 windows!

projects.title: 【开发者自荐】Yenpo：和 AI 一起写项目时，读懂它改了哪些代码（macOS）
projects.author: yangsibai
projects.summary: Yenpo 是一个 macOS 桌面应用，用来在和 Claude Code、Codex 这类 agent 一起写项目时，读懂和审查 AI 写的代码，跟上它的思路。它不接入 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 或 GitHub，看的是你本地仓库里的改动。 直接读取本地的 git 仓库，按改动列出 AI 改过的文件，逐个看行内 diff 内置 AI Reader，默认只读，可以对着代码问"这段为什么这么改"；用你自己的模型服务商 自带终端和编辑器，看完可以顺手改 不需要注册账号，应用内没有遥测 支持 macOS 14+，界面有 10 种

projects.title: [开源推荐] Agent Ping — 六家 AI 编程助手的菜单栏会话面板
projects.author: hnyxgxm

github.name: DreamOfXM/agent-ping
github.description: Menu-bar panel that tells you which AI coding-agent session needs you right now. macOS + Linux, reads only the logs your tools already write, makes no network calls.

projects.summary: 同时开着 Qoder、Claude Code、Codex、ZCode、WorkBuddy、OpenCode 的时候，很难判断谁在跑、谁在等你回答。Agent Ping 是一个 macOS 菜单栏 / Linux 托盘面板：只读这些工具已经写在本机的日志，把每条会话标成正在跑、排队、等你回答、已完成或报错停下，点一行就回到那条会话；不联网、不要账号。 亮点 同屏六家 Agent，按状态分组而不是按工具分组——打开面板先看见「谁在等你」；等你回答的那条会话会带出问题原文和可选项（装 hook 后可精确到提问）。整个二进制不发起网络请求，只读日志，不碰账号密码；macOS 用 Homebrew 一条命令源码编译安装，Linux 有源码构建。

projects.title: Melt
projects.summary: Melt keeps your recent Mac screenshots and screen recordings in a menu bar tray. Drag a capture into any app, copy it, share it, show it in Finder, or pin it. If you turn on automatic cleanup, unpinned captures move to the system Trash after 1, 7 or 30 days, so the Desktop stops filling up. It works on your original files, fully on your Mac. No account, no subscription. Launch price $2.99, normally $4.99.

projects.title: Handoff
projects.summary: Handoff is a free, open-source desktop app for sharing completed freelance projects. Add the files, send a private link, and your client previews and downloads the originals. No watermark, no recompression. Early development, Windows first.

projects.title: 【工具自荐】Still：帮 ADHD、拖延的人找回专注力的 Mac App，纯本地
projects.author: limingming66
projects.summary: macOS 14+，原生应用 工具介绍 传统的番茄钟需要每次手动点击“开始”，而人一旦走神往往连点开始都会忘；像 Timing、RescueTime 这类全量time tracker又过于复杂，每天生成的大量分类饼图和评分很容易带来负罪感。 Still 是一款极简的 macOS 菜单栏工具（UI 受 Things 3 和苹果原生“屏幕使用时间”启发）。它砍掉了复杂的分类和图表，只回答一个问题：此时此刻，你在专注吗？（Are you focused right now?） 核心功能 全自动记录，零启动成本：只需勾选哪些 App 和网站（支持读取浏览器当前 Tab 的 URL）属于工作区，切入即自动统计专注时长。 三个客观信号，代替专注打分：不做任何效率评分，只诚实展示三个核心指标——进入专注次数（Focus starts）、专注时长（Focus time）、应用切换次数（App switches）。 安静的走神微提醒：当你切出工作区走神过久时，屏幕最顶部边缘会亮起一根微小的磁吸挂绳，安静地提醒你回到工作状态（也可切换为标准系统通知）。 100% 本地运行（Local-first）：仅在本地判断当前最前台窗口与标签页，所有数据完全保存在 Mac 本机，不上传任何服务器。 免费可用，无订阅制：基础核心功能完全免费直装可用（Pro 版采用传统一次性买断，无任何订阅）。 我是独立开发者，因为过去几年自己注意力下降、经常无意识切窗口走神，所以写了这个自救小工具。如果合适，希望能被周刊收录，谢谢阮老师！

projects.title: Genesis OS Browser Virtual System
projects.summary: Transform Google Chrome into an interactive desktop operating system with floating windows, split-screen multitasking, and native AI copilots. Key Highlights: - Floating window manager: run multiple web apps side by side in a single tab - Integrated AI assistant dock for instant notes, calculation, and summaries - Customizable widgets, shortcuts, and persistent workspace layouts - Lightweight, stunning UI inspired by modern desktop operating systems

projects.title: Home Office Compliance Guard
projects.summary: Home Office Compliance Guard — a privacy-first desktop app that audits your home network and issues a verifiable compliance certificate for IT/HR. Subscribe to access reports.

projects.title: SpotFind
projects.summary: SpotFind finds files on your Mac when you describe what’s in them, in your own words. - It searches documents, PDFs, scanned pages, photos, screenshots, voice recordings & videos. - Results with your exact words come first, then files that match the meaning. - Each result shows where it matched, such as the page or the moment in a recording. - Everything runs on your Mac, offline & read-only. - It opens with ⌥Space from the menu bar & keeps up as files change.

projects.title: Nocto
projects.summary: Nocto turns your MacBook's notch into a small control center. Hover to see what's playing and skip songs. Ten minutes before a call it starts a countdown, and when the meeting begins the notch opens with a Join button (Zoom, Meet, Teams, Webex, FaceTime). Park files on the shelf, find anything you copied in clipboard history, and check your Mac and AirPods battery at a glance. Native, light, macOS 14+. One-time purchase, 7-day free trial. Music stays free forever.

projects.title: Syllo
projects.summary: Syllo is a desktop productivity app that adds a Dynamic Island and dynamic notch for Windows and macOS, with music controls, files, clipboard history, capture, notes, timers and supported AI coding agents.

projects.title: [开源自荐] Glint：通过输入法学习英语的 macOS 工具
projects.author: jsogn

github.name: jsogn/Glint
github.description: 面向中文母语者的 macOS 英文学习工具：读取中文拼音输入法的当前高亮候选，在候选栏旁显示对应的英文翻译。

projects.summary: Glint 是一款为中文母语者设计的 macOS 英文学习工具。你照常用拼音输入，候选栏旁就会直接出现对应的英文，不切换应用，也不改变输入法。它支持单词、短语和短句，还能把选中的英文译文直接插入当前输入位置；内置词典和本地模型，日常使用无需联网，也不会保存你的输入内容。 亮点 1. 边打中文边学英文：不需要打开词典或翻译网站，照常输入拼音，就能在候选旁看到对应的英文表达。 2. 从单词到短句都能用：单词给出简洁常用的英文对应词，短语和短句显示自然翻译，适合聊天、写邮件和日常表达。 3. 选中译文就能直接插入：按设定好的触发键加数字，把需要的英文译文插入当前输入位置，不用复制粘贴。 4. 离线也能用，输入内容不会外传：内置词典和本地翻译模型，也能按需安装更适合的本地模型；不保存候选或译文，不安装键盘事件监听。 5. 敏感场景自动避开：遇到密码框、终端安全输入等情况时停止显示翻译，只读取当前高亮候选，不读取输入框正文。 6. 原生 macOS 小工具：菜单栏常驻，提供 PKG/DMG 安装包；翻译数量可调，可以设置登录时启动，适配浅色和深色外观。 技术实现方面，Glint 使用 Swift 6、AppKit 和 SwiftUI 构建，内置 CTranslate2 翻译运行时，并支持可选 MLX 模型，也适合作为本地 AI macOS 应用的参考项目。 截图或演示视频 45 秒产品演示视频（Bilibili）

projects.title: iQ

projects.title: MacOS Neat Menubar Calendar

There is still much work to do on this project, but it's in open beta with a web client so people can see how it works before committing to a desktop app download. Mobile apps will come later, if there is proven interest in this platform. I don't care to monitize it. The only thing users will ever see is a non-intrusive "Please donate" badge at most, with the intentions to just keep the maintainer nodes and some official relays running. There are no accounts. Sunlight is the way I imagined the Mac working before I got my 1st-gen MacBook Air in high school (2008). I had looked at a bunch of Apple videos of Mission Control (Exposé back then) and somehow decided it worked like an infinite canvas. I even told my mom about it! I guess it stuck with me. github.description: Documentation and setup guide for the MCP interface built into the UniPublisher desktop application (1.6.8+). Not a standalone server.

projects.summary: 阮老师和各位读者好，向周刊自荐我们开源的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务端适配器与桌面发布工具 UniPublisher。 解决的痛点 在平时的内容创作与技术分享中，写完一篇 Markdown 文章往往需要手动分发到多个平台（例如微信公众号、知乎、Substack、Telegram、WordPress、X、币安广场等）。每个平台的富文本排版、代码高亮、图片上传机制各不相同，逐一复制粘贴经常需要消耗 1~2 小时，极易打断创作者的写作心流。 主要特点与设计考量 1. 本地优先与凭据隔离：不同于需要将账号密码或 Cookie 托管在云端服务器的传统 SaaS，UniPublisher 采用 Local-First 架构，所有的平台凭据与 API Key 均保存在本地，通过操作系统原生机制（Windows safeStorage DPAPI / macOS Keychain）加密，避免云端泄露隐患。 2. AI 与桌面协同（MCP 协议标准）：仓库开源了基于标准 stdio 的 MCP 服务端（unipublisher-mcp）。在 Claude Desktop、Cursor 或 Windsurf 中生成技术文章或研报后，可直接通过 MCP 工具调起桌面端。 3. 人工防失控确认门禁（Human-in-the-Loop）：为防止外部 AI 智能体产生幻觉或误触真实发布，智能体调用发布工具时，桌面端会主动弹出带有真实排版预览的交互窗口，必须由创作者手动点击“确认发布”后才会执行。 4. 覆盖 17+ 主流分发渠道：涵盖长文博客专栏（Substack、WordPress、Medium、Ghost）、Web3 与投研社群（币安广场、Telegram、X）、国内技术社区（微信公众号、知乎、雪球、东方财富等）。 系统支持与获取方式 客户端支持 Windows 10/11（提供微软商店认证版本与独立 .exe）及 macOS（Apple Silicon 原生 .dmg），新安装包含 50 次免费分发额度。 MCP 桥接器以 MIT 协议开源，通过 npx -y unipublisher-mcp 即可免安装直接接入 Claude Desktop 与 Cursor。

projects.title: Show HN: Wavefunction – a minimal, open-source desktop coding agent for Mac
projects.author: spstoyanov
projects.summary: During the dark ages of AI, when Opus 5 was incomprehensible and Codex Ultra was burning all tokens within a day, I decided to give open-source agents and models a try. What I saw was that a lot of the tools I tried were terminal-first, and desktop apps were less common. Additionally, I felt that lately a lot of the agents apps are slowly trying to become “superapps”. They keep adding more and more features that imo are not always useful and make the UI quite heavy and complex. This motivated me to build Wavefunction: A minimal, open-source app desktop app that focuses on the coding experience and tries to reduce unnecessary features. It doesn’t have a built in browser and its computer use functionality works in a VM. I built it on top of langgraph and it’s packaged as a tauri desktop app. Currently, It works with Vercel AI Gateway, OpenRouter, Anthropic API key, Google AI Studio API key, and you can log in with your ChatGPT account or use a local model with Ollama. It also has 70+ connectors. Last, but not least, you can also require ZDR-only models from the providers. If you try it out I would love to hear your feedback! Thanks!

github.description: 常用的窗口挂起来，随点随用。  Your most-used windows, hung up and one click away.

projects.summary: 晒窗（ShaiWin）是一个 Windows 桌面小工具，只做一件事：把你正在用的窗口从屏幕上“摘下来”，挂到屏幕顶端的一根晾衣绳上。抓住任意窗口的标题栏往屏幕顶端一拖，窗口就缩成一张卡片垂在绳子上；点一下卡片，窗口长回原来的大小和位置。桌面立刻变干净，但窗口没关、没最小化到任务栏，也没从 Alt+Tab 里消失。 为什么值得推荐 日常工作中窗口一多，在任务栏和 Alt+Tab 里来回找窗口很打断节奏。ShaiWin 的做法足够轻：它不接管、不整理、不猜测，只挂你亲手拖上去的窗口，不隐藏任务栏按钮，不改 Alt+Tab，也不动系统的 Snap 布局。定位很克制，就是一个“手边窗口暂存架”。 技术上也足够省心：单个 exe，绿色免安装，不需要 .NET / VC++ 运行库，不需要管理员权限，Windows 10 1809+ 或 Windows 11 x64 即可运行。项目用 Rust 构建，CI 通过 GitHub Actions 自动测试、打包、发 Release，已有 67 个单元测试覆盖。 如果你也经常面对一堆窗口、又不想改变现有的窗口管理习惯，这个小工具值得一试。

projects.summary: Mac App Store： Windows：winget install Trappist.AgentCat Homebrew：brew install --cask yong076/tap/agent-cat 工具介绍 用 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 写代码时，最常遇到的问题是：这个账号还剩多少额度？什么时候重置？换哪个账号还能继续？每个工具的查看方式都不一样，账号一多就更乱。 Agent Cat 是一款免费的 macOS 菜单栏 / Windows 托盘应用，把这些信息集中在一个地方。 核心功能 支持 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、GitHub Copilot、Cursor、Grok、Kimi、OpenCode 等 同一服务的多个账号分别显示剩余额度和重置时间；某个账号用完时，会提示可以换用的账号 7 天 token 用量图表、用量历史与报告 只读取各 CLI 已经写在本机的数据，无需额外登录；负责读取的 connector 源码公开（PolyForm Shield 许可，属于 source-available）： 界面支持简体中文，另有 iOS / Android 手机端 完全免费，没有订阅 我是作者（韩国的独立开发者）。如果合适，希望能被周刊收录，谢谢！

projects.title: Barista
projects.summary: Read and answer email, check your calendar, add a reminder, grab something from your clipboard history: all from the Menu Bar, without switching apps. 30+ productivity and utility widgets in one native Mac app, with a floating bar when the notch hides everything.

Couldn't find any that were as minimal/fast as I had in mind so threw together something small. Tiny footprint, runs offline after first load, familiar keyboard shortcuts, absolutely distraction free. Also the style is nice and configurable so you can find whatever's most comfortable for your eyes.

projects.title: Lectavi
projects.summary: Lectavi is a desktop app that records your lectures. While the class is on, it shows the terms as they come up and catches you up when you ask. When you stop, it writes the notes, flashcards and figures. Every line it takes from the lecture keeps the second it was said, so you can press that line and hear your lecturer say it. Nothing is a summary you have to take on trust.

projects.title: Krill
projects.summary: Run Claude Code, Codex, Cursor CLI, OpenCode or any shell side by side, each in its own Git worktree, with a queue of agents waiting on you and diff review. projects.title: [开源推荐] Pika Clean：删除前先让 AI 解释文件能不能删的 Mac 清理工具

github.name: black-robe-sanfeng/pika-clean
github.description: Open-source Mac cleaner that explains every file with AI before you delete it. 开源的 Mac 清理工具，用 AI 告诉你文件能不能删。

projects.summary: Pika Clean 是一个开源免费的 Mac 清理工具，用 Tauri 2 + Rust + React 开发，安装包约 10 MB。扫描出缓存、日志、旧下载后，点一下任意条目，AI 会说明它是什么、删了会怎样，看懂了再删。还带卸载软件、开机启动项管理、菜单栏系统监控和开发者缓存清理。 亮点 删除前用 AI 解释文件用途。AI 用你自己的：本机 Claude Code，或任何 OpenAI 兼容服务（DeepSeek、通义、Kimi、Ollama 等）。只发路径、大小这类元数据，不发文件内容。 删除收得很紧：只有一个删除入口；前端只传条目编号不传路径；删前核对 inode；个人文件只进废纸篓，可一键放回。 调用 Claude Code 时关掉全部工具（--tools ""），AI 只能返回文字，不能动你的文件。 开发者清理：Xcode、模拟器、Docker、包管理器，以及 Claude、Cursor 等 AI 工具的缓存。 同时支持 Intel 和 Apple 芯片，界面支持中英日韩。

projects.title: Mi-Sub
projects.summary: Mi-Sub gives you live English ↔ Spanish transcription and translation in real time. Use it directly in your browser or download the Windows desktop app for calls, interpreting, study, and everyday conversations. Start with 30 free minutes — no card required.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】MenuBarMijia：在 Mac 菜单栏与 Win11 托盘里控制米家和 Home Assistant 设备
projects.author: jryang1997

github.name: jryang1997/MenuBarMijia
github.description: Native macOS (Swift 6 + SwiftUI) & Windows 11 (Tauri v2) menu-bar/tray controller for Xiaomi Mijia & Home Assistant with hold-to-talk voice control · 跨端米家与 HA 菜单栏智控中心

projects.summary: 阮老师好，自荐一个我写的开源桌面小工具 MenuBarMijia（MIT 协议）。 平时在电脑前写代码或码字时，想开关灯、把吸顶灯切到月光模式、调空调温度，或者看一眼插座功率，往往得拿起手机点米家 App，或者喊小爱同学（容易打断思路，晚上还会听一串语音回复）。所以我做了一个常驻在 macOS 菜单栏和 Windows 11 系统托盘的控制器。 主要功能： 米家扫码直连或接入 Home Assistant：打开设置用手机米家 App 扫码就能同步家庭和设备，不用额外部署服务器；已有 Home Assistant 的 Mac 用户也可以通过局域网 WebSocket 接入，程序会自动把同一台物理设备拆散的开关、功率、用电量、童锁等实体合成一张卡片。 键盘拼音搜索与按住说话：按 ⌥M（Windows 下 Alt+M）呼出面板，直接敲拼音首字母（比如 sftd 找「书房台灯」）回车开关，方向键调亮度和温度；也可以用鼠标按住菜单栏图标直接说「关客厅灯」「再暗一点」「10 分钟后关书房灯」，松手即发，没有唤醒词，也不播报语音。明确的中英文指令在本地直接解析，复杂说法可以按需接你自己的大模型接口。 跟着 Mac 状态自动执行（macOS）：支持锁屏/合盖离开时自动关灯、唤醒回来开灯，或外接显示器插拔触发场景；同时提供 4 个 macOS「快捷指令」（Shortcuts）动作与 menumijia:// URL 调用。 防误触与用电统计：批量操作会弹出 10–15 秒撤销条（10 分钟内也能直接说「撤销」），只恢复那次操作改过的属性；「全关」需要按住 0.6 秒，默认排除插座和扫地机。内置插座本地用电统计，只按电表累计读数算增量，不用功率乘时间估算。 安装与试用（内置离线演示家庭，不绑设备也能直接试界面）： bash brew install --cask jryang1997/tap/menubarmijia

Approve Claude Code permission prompts from the bar, and see what's playing, volume, timers, headphone battery, and mic or camera use. Click it for stats, media, weather, calendar, clipboard, Gmail and GitHub tabs. No polling while idle, nothing leaves your computer. Free and open source for GNOME Shell 46–50: Zorin 18, Ubuntu, Fedora, Bazzite.

projects.title: 【工具自荐】Coday：让 Devin、Cursor 等编辑器使用你自己的模型

projects.summary: Coday 是一个 Windows 桌面工具：在本机接管 Devin、Cursor、Windsurf、Kiro 以及 VS Code（GitHub Copilot）的 AI 请求，转换协议后转发到你自己选择的 OpenAI 兼容或 Claude 接口。编辑器不用手改 baseurl，聊天、补全、Agent 和工具调用照常使用。 主要功能： Devin 全家桶：快速上下文复用本地 Devin 登录；Devin Tab 补全走官方 GetTab Supercomplete；本机 Devin CLI / Devin Local / ACP 的系统提示词改写与回滚；Devin 界面汉化与还原。 自选模型与 API 源：粘贴接口地址和 Key，同步上游模型列表；支持多源故障转移，当前源限流或不可用时自动切换。 跨 IDE 项目规则：读取 .windsurfrules、.cursor/rules、.kiro/steering、CLAUDE.md 等规则文件。 Remote-SSH：通过反向隧道把 Linux 远端的 AI 流量接回本机，路由和模型注入继续生效。 可观测：内置请求控制台、用量统计、证书与拦截诊断。 界面支持中英文，仓库提供 Windows 安装包，源码暂不开放。

projects.title: Remlo
projects.summary: Remlo is a native notes app for Mac, iPhone and iPad. Type a checkbox in any note and it becomes a real to-do, linked back to where you wrote it. Each day gets its own page with your note, what's due and your habits. To-dos sit on a board with stages you name. Habits show streaks and the weekly trend. Hand a to-do to an agent and send it to Claude in Terminal or the desktop app. It all lives in your own iCloud: no account, no server, works offline. Free to try for 7 days.

Add native notifications, Finder file handling, menu bar controls, and Dock animations. Embed your files or keep them linked to the original folder, with no local HTTP server.

Built for instructors and course creators who want professional video lectures without touching a camera or editing timeline. One-time purchase: $500, no subscription. Your course content stays local — never uploaded to the cloud. Windows desktop app, no coding required.

projects.title: Bifurc
projects.summary: Free desktop app for API work on localhost: *.localhost proxying with capture, a client for REST/GraphQL/gRPC/SOAP/WebSocket/MCP & more, proxy-level mocks, git-synced workspaces, visual flows, a local mail inbox, and an agent-ready CLI. Windows, macOS, Linux.

projects.author: jayson-sheyue

github.name: jayson-sheyue/fuci
github.description: 浮词 Fuci · 支持 macOS 与 Windows 的毛玻璃桌面悬浮词典（中/英/日互译、假名活用、长句拆解、Gemini TTS）

projects.summary: 阮老师好，自荐一个我自己开发的开源桌面悬浮词典与长句拆解工具 浮词 (Fuci)（支持 macOS 与 Windows）。 GitHub 安装包下载： 解决什么痛点？ 平时读外文文档、论文或日文网页时，为了查一个生词切去浏览器或词典窗口，回来时往往已经找不到刚才读到的那一行。 浮词平时只是一条半透明搜索框或一颗桌面悬浮球，按 ⌘⇧Space（Windows 为 Ctrl+Shift+Space）随时在当前页面最上层呼出，查完按 Esc 收起，视线始终停留在正在读的那一页。 核心特点 1. 单词与句子自动分流（两套专属排版） 查单词：展开成结构化词典卡片（译文、国际音标/假名/拼音、词形变化与日语动词活用形、母语释义、双语例句、Gemini 自然语音朗读）。 查句子：不铺冗长词条，只给整句译文、整句读音注音以及逐词释义拆解，长难句结构一目了然。 2. 中 · 日 · 英三语互译：支持 6 个翻译方向一键切换，日语汉字自带 Ruby 振假名注音，中文支持简繁切换。 3. 1 分钟零门槛配置（BYOK）：支持直接粘贴免费的 Google AI Studio Gemini API Key 开箱即用，也支持 GCP 满血模式一键浏览器 OAuth 登录。所有凭证与缓存仅保存在本地。 4. 7 款中国传统色半透明主题：内置晴空、青竹、朱砂、藤紫、琥珀、海棠、夜色主题与透明度调节。 运行动图与截图

projects.title: 【开源项目自荐】SwaprTrans：在任意 Mac App 敲空格选词即查、敲回车原地覆写翻译的极轻量原生工具
projects.author: linrol

github.name: linrol/swapr-trans
github.description: ⚡️ 选词空格即翻，回车原地覆写。macOS 原生极简端侧翻译工具，纯菜单栏常驻，告别复制粘贴 | Ultra-fast native in-place translator for macOS

projects.summary: SwaprTrans 是一款极轻量（打包体积 < 2MB）的 macOS 原生常驻翻译与原地覆写工具。专为跨语言即时沟通、跨国远程与外企办公打造。 解决的核心痛点 在浏览器之外的桌面端应用（如 Slack、Teams、邮件客户端、IDE、终端）用外语沟通时，传统的翻译流程极其繁琐且割裂： 打出中文 ➔ 复制 ➔ 切屏去网页翻译 ➔ 复制英文 ➔ 切回原窗口粘贴。一天往往要来回切屏几十次。 SwaprTrans 把整个输入和查词链路做到了光标原地： 1. 打字即换（原地覆写）：在任意输入框打完中文选中文本，直接按 Enter 键即可在光标处原地无缝替换成地道英文，免去切屏复制粘贴； 2. 选词即查：在屏幕任意窗口选中文字，轻敲 Space 空格键即刻弹出极简 HUD 悬浮窗显示翻译； 3. 原生纯离线（隐私保护）：基于 macOS 15+ 系统的本地端侧翻译模型（Apple Translation API）运行，工作机密与私密聊天不上云，兼有 Edge / Google 双通道自动兜底； 4. 极速轻巧：纯原生 Swift 构建，非 Electron 框架，打包体积不到 2MB，常驻内存仅数兆。 安装体验 已支持 Homebrew 一键安装： bash brew install linrol/tap/swapr-trans 或直接在 Releases 页面 下载 DMG 安装体验。 代码完全基于 MIT 协议开源，核心能力同时以 SwaprTransKit 完整对外开放，供其他 macOS 开发者直接集成。欢迎大家体验和交流反馈！

projects.title: Crawlune

projects.title: Show HN: Hob - Open-source, on device alternative to Claude Cowork and ChatGPT
projects.author: pancomplex

github.name: FrigadeHQ/hob
github.description: An easier way to use AI on your own computer. A free, open-source alternative to Claude and ChatGPT that runs open-weight models like Gemma and gpt-oss locally on Mac, Windows and Linux. Private, and works offline.

projects.summary: Hey HN, I'm Christian and this is a new OSS project I've been noodling on for the last couple of weeks. Hob is a free, MIT-licensed desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux that works on your files the way the Claude and ChatGPT desktop apps do, except the model runs on your own computer. It uses open-weight models (currently Gemma 4 and gpt-oss). All your chats and files never leave your system. The only things that go online are web search (can be turned off in settings) and any MCP connectors you add yourself. Main features: - Automatically finds the best open-weight model for your hardware on first install (Mac/Linux/Windows) - Writes sandboxed Python code for ad hoc tools (data processing, document conversion, graphs etc.) - Built-in web search (powered by SearXNG) - MCP support - Image recognition - CRUD to your local filesystem - Works fully offline with no internet Before building this I tried every local AI app I could find, but it seemed each one had different problems. The main thing I noticed is that none of them could do what the ChatGPT and Claude apps do with your files, e.g. read and change files in a folder, look at images, run code in a sandbox, draw a chart. The most advanced thing any of them did was paste a plain text file into a small context window, which basically failed as soon as you had a file larger than a few KB. I couldn't find anything that could easily parse images and bigger PDFs. The OSS solutions that were more advanced all seemed to default to hosted models (either OSS or closed), which defeats the entire point of the privacy that on-device OSS offers. They also seemed to push towards an account/open-core style business. I build it using Electron bridged with llama.cpp in its own process. On initial load, the system will try and figure out if you have a compatible graphics card and if not default to CPU-only (I ran into a lot of issues of graphics card beeing seemingly compatible but then crashing on first query, there's a whole saga to this lol). Code execution happens in a sandbox that can only write to the chat's folder and has no network unless asked (sandbox-exec on macOS, Landlock on Linux and a low-integrity process on Windows). Images go to a small Qwen3-VL model. Dictation is a local Whisper model. The hardest part was definitely to get the smaller models to use tools reliably. Ran into a ton of issues of 4B models happily saying "here's your chart" without ever calling the chart tool or get stuck in an infinite call loop. I spent a fair amount of the work building guards vs tweaking prompts (that didn't really work for small models). I understand the pushback that local models are weaker than frontier cloud models. This is true, but for most tasks for most normal people, I'd argue you rarely need the newest frontier model. From my own evals, systems with 16+ GB of RAM do really well, and if you have a GPU or more RAM, you get very close to what you'll get out of the box with a frontier hosted model. Excited to hear what you think and see how it runs on other systems!

projects.title: Show HN: ssh zydra.sh, a GPU Linux desktop in your terminal, with Doom
projects.author: teledream
projects.summary: ssh zydra.sh There's no sign-up or anything, and you get a 15-minute demo of a graphical Linux VM drawn entirely in your terminal. It has a browser, an editor, and it runs Doom. It works best in Kitty or Ghostty. WezTerm and Konsole also work, as well as Sixel and iTerm2 terminals, though with less detail. Text-only terminals support non-graphical apps: shells, editors, and other TUIs. Why? For a few months I ran coding agents in tmux on a VPS over SSH, and it sucked. I couldn't paste images, scrolling broke and I didn't wanna figure out why, I had no notifications for when an agent finished, I couldn't see browsers agents opened to smoke-test, logins drifted between my laptop and the server, I couldn't check in from my phone, and to know what an agent had done five minutes ago I had to read through opaque chunks of tool calls. These issues added up and had me in a limbo: They made my setup bad enough to annoy me every day, but not quite bad enough to stop my real work and fix it. How it works: Zydra is a custom (Smithay-based) Wayland compositor in a microVM with an AMD GPU, implementing a series of terminal protocols that solve many issues but are often ignored: Kitty graphics for windows, OSC 52 for the clipboard, images included, OSC 9/99/777 for notifications, SGR mouse for scrolling and clicks. VNC is limited to sending pictures of the screen and diffing frames to find what changed. In Zydra, apps directly tell the compositor what changed, and terminal text is sent as text you can select and copy natively. The browser is a WebKit build that delivers frames to the compositor as DMA-BUFs without a readback, and agents drive it through Playwright. Alt+P is sort of like Raycast: browse apps, linked GitHub, websites, and SSH targets from it. You can watch the desktop at any point in time and rewind to periodic snapshots. To achieve this, the desktop records into a timeline file, a kind of structured video, and the VM takes snapshots along it. You can traverse back like a livestream to see what happened while you were away, then restore or fork the whole machine from that point. Agents can mark points on the timeline and checkpoint the whole machine before risky changes. Other things to try: ssh -t zydra.sh dino # the Chromium dino game via SSH tar -czf - -C ~ .claude .claude.json | ssh -T zydra.sh upload # bring your configs (includes your Claude login) ssh -o ObscureKeystrokeTiming=no -A zydra.sh # lower latency & forward your SSH agent ssh -p 443 zydra.sh # connect from a corporate firewall sshfs zydra.sh: ~/zydra # paid accounts: mount your home Everything runs on one dedicated server with one AMD iGPU, so there are 12 demo slots. When they're full you wait in a queue and can play Chromium's offline dino game. The paid plan is $40/month (+ tax): 8 GB RAM, 4 vCPUs, 80 GB disk, GPU access, with no time limit and a 3-day money-back guarantee. I'll be around all day to answer questions.

projects.summary: ## Steamcup：合上电脑，让任务接着跑 编译、渲染或跑 Agent 时，任务还没结束，Mac 却睡了。Steamcup 是一个原生 macOS 菜单栏小工具：点一下像素咖啡杯，让 Mac 保持唤醒；开启合盖模式后，合上盖子也能继续运行。 ### 怎么用 - 点杯子开启或关闭，右键设置 30 分钟到 8 小时的定时。 - 开启合盖模式，让屏幕熄灭、后台任务继续；首次需管理员授权。 - 可选择允许屏幕熄灭、锁屏时暂停，也可用 ⌃⌥W 快捷键切换。 - 配置命令行入口后，使用 `steamcup run -- <命令>`，醒到命令结束。 ### 下载与安装 介绍页有 12 秒功能示意短片、下载入口和完整安装说明：https://longado.github.io/steamcup/ 下载 Steamcup.zip，解压后将 Steamcup.app 拖进「应用程序」。当前版本尚未经过 Apple 公证，首次打开可能被 macOS 阻止，请按仓库安装说明处理。 ### 当前版本与边界 v1.3.2 Alpha，免费、MIT 开源，不需要账号或订阅，应用不发送网络请求。 下载包面向 macOS 14+，包含 Apple 芯片和 Intel 架构；真机验证来自 macOS 26 的 Apple 芯片 Mac，macOS 14–15 与 Intel 设备仍待实际验证。 合盖模式会更改系统睡眠设置，并安装后台恢复检查。正常关闭或定时结束后恢复设置；崩溃、强退后由后台检查恢复。设有过热和低电量停止机制，但尚未在真实过热、低电场景下验证触发效果。合盖运行时请保持通风，权限范围与卸载方法见仓库说明。 这是需要下载安装的 Mac 应用，网页是介绍与下载入口。配图为产品介绍页与功能示意。 源码：https://github.com/Longado/steamcup 欢迎反馈你的 macOS 版本、机型与具体使用过程。

projects.title: Show HN: Orisuji, a maze you solve by folding your phone
projects.author: friggeri
projects.summary: When Apple announced the iPhone Duo I felt the same excitement that I had felt when I got my first iPhone, way back when. I remember playing Tap Tap Revenge, Fruit Ninja and all those other games that really took advantage of the new hardware to create new experiences. I also loved playing cute puzzles like Cut the Rope and Where’s my water. A month ago, I got the itch to build something for the duo, in the lineage of those apps. Something that would be a fun puzzle with a unique game mechanic. I started with a simple premise: what if the cover screen was partly transparent? That could make a fun maze that you have to fold and unfold as you solve it. Orisuji is a turn based paper maze, when the phone is open you have your base maze on the right part of the screen, but the only way to solve it is to figure out when to fold/unfold it to create bridges and new routes. Along the way you’ll encounter increasing complex levels: cats and foxes patrolling, doors you need to unlock, platforms you can toggle, and floors that crumble under you. Some fun things I built/had to do that aren’t obvious: - I built a web based level editor that runs the game’s rules engine compiled from Swift to wasm. - Every level is validated by a solver that identifies shortest solutions, lints the board and identifies which “tricks” are required to solve it. This helped me a few times when designing levels where I would make a change but accidentally would introduce a shortcut. - Figuring out how to translate the fold mechanic to non iPhone Duos was a cool challenge, I ended up adding a “virtual” on screen fold, which still doesn’t justice to the game. - As much as I would love to have some data on how people play the game, it was super important to me that the game worked totally offline, not collecting any data. It was so incredibly fun to build this, as you can expect I leaned heavily into agentic tools, which enabled me to move pretty fast. Every puzzled was however designed by hand, AIs are not good at “fun”, and from a game design perspective this was the most interesting part to me. The whole game costs $4.99, all 69 levels (and already working on new worlds), no IAP ever. Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w98lwzHgGWA If you’ve got a duo (or not) I’d love to hear your feedback. And more than happy to answer anything about building/designing it!

projects.summary: 先说明一下：我是 Acard 的维护者，也在负责它的内测，所以这是一条自荐。 Acard 是一个开源（AGPL-3.0）、本地优先的 Notion 式工作区。一个 Bun 进程跑起编辑器和接口，所有数据都存在你自己选定文件夹里的 SQLite 文件中，不开云功能就不会有任何东西离开你的电脑。 做它的初衷很简单：我平时大量的想法和资料其实都是在和 AI 的对话里产生的，但这些内容最后总是散落在聊天记录里。与其再手动整理进 Notion 或 Obsidian，不如让 AI 直接把对话写成页面。 主要功能： 块编辑器：标题、列表、待办、折叠块、引用、代码、表格、公式、图片，支持 / 命令和 Markdown 快捷键，可以分 2–4 栏排版。 数据库：表格、看板、画廊、列表、日历、时间线、图表 7 种视图，支持关联、汇总和公式。 内置 MCP 和 REST API：在本机运行时，Claude Code、Codex 等 MCP 客户端无需 token 就能直接读写页面，例如 claude mcp add --transport http acard 导入导出：支持 Markdown 和 Notion 导出文件。 备份：一个 zip 包含所有表、文件和每个页面的 Markdown 副本，每天自动备份。 团队使用：在局域网、家里的服务器或 VPN 上跑一个服务端，其他人用浏览器或桌面端连接。 界面支持简体中文、英文、韩文。 安装：Windows 可以直接下载 Acard Local 安装包（目前还没签名，SmartScreen 会提示，点「更多信息 → 仍要运行」即可）；macOS / Linux 需要从源码构建，或者直接 bun local/main.ts 跑服务端用浏览器打开。

projects.title: Show HN: ReVault – new secure archive format
projects.author: bsutto
projects.summary: reVault is a new, secure-by-default archive format called a lockbox, designed to be simple to use. I've been working on reVault for about 2 years. It was originally written in Dart, but with the improvements in AI, I decided to port it to Rust using AI. It's now in beta, so I'm looking for feedback, particularly around the different language bindings. A lockbox is encrypted, signed and compressed by default. Each can be disabled selectively. - Hybrid post-quantum or passphrase encryption, including metadata. - Zstd compression. - Pure Rust libraries wherever possible. We intend to phase out remaining C code as alternatives become available. The project has been scanned using OpenAI's Daybreak cyber security tools. The manual is a work in progress: https://docs.revault.onepub.dev/ reVault supports Linux, macOS and Windows, x64 and arm64, plus Wasm. The core is Rust, with bindings for C/C++, Java, Dart, Python, Ruby, JS/TypeScript, Go, C#, Kotlin, Lua, PHP and Swift. Within a lockbox you can store: - Files, directories, permissions and symlinks. - Variables. - Forms. Variables, forms and the lockbox itself can have descriptions. reVault uses a portable vault (just another lockbox with structured content) to hold your keys, contacts' keys, lockbox aliases and form definitions. It ties into your platform's secure store, so logging into your desktop unlocks your vault. You don't have to enter a passphrase every time you access a lockbox. You can disable this. There are lots of shortcuts. Creating a lockbox stores an alias in your vault, based on its filename or a name you choose: lbx create /some/path/mybox.lbox lbx mybox open --duration 1h lbx mybox var set KEY VALUE Set a default lockbox and you can leave its name out: lbx session default mybox lbx var get KEY You can mirror a directory tree into a lockbox and update it when the directory changes: lbx store.lbox mirrors project create --from ./project --to /projects/project lbx store.lbox mirrors update The API lets you read, write and seek within files without extracting them to the filesystem. Each lockbox has a table of contents, so extracting a single file from a multi-gigabyte lockbox is fast. Recovery Updates are transactional, with automatic rollback for failed updates. The format is designed for recovery: content is stored in pages, allowing unaffected content to be recovered if part of a lockbox is corrupted. Sharing An encrypted lockbox is more useful if you can share it. reVault has an open-source keyserver for exchanging public keys, with validation through a second trusted channel. It's still experimental. OnePub has donated a server to run a single keyserver. If you're interested in donating resources, I'd like to bring up a second redundant server. It's pure Rust, uses under 100 MB RSS and supports rate limits. To publish your default profile's public key: lbx vault profiles email you@example.com lbx vault profiles publish Give the publish code to your contact. They can import your key: lbx vault contacts receive <publish-code> <contact-name> Display your profile's fingerprint and exchange it through a second trusted channel: lbx vault profiles fingerprint Repeat the process in the opposite direction to get their key. Once you have it, grant them access to your default lockbox: lbx access grant alice You can then email the encrypted lockbox to Alice. To install the CLI and get started: cargo install revault_cli lbx vault init lbx completion install Completion installation detects your shell. To diagnose issues: lbx doctor The language bindings are published to their respective package repositories. I'm looking for constructive criticism of the project on its own merits, particularly the APIs and language bindings. I'm not interested in a debate about using AI.

projects.author: coffeefreehans
projects.summary: 平时经常在 GitHub 上找好玩的开源桌面端、开发工具与前沿 AI 项目，但经常遇到几个痛点： 1. 找安装包繁琐：很多优质开源项目没有独立官网，下载时需要点进 Releases 在一堆 source code.zip 和各类架构二进制包中捉迷藏； 2. 官方榜单刷星/题库多：GitHub 官方 Trending 经常被面试八股文、刷星题库霸榜，很难真正发现高可用的实际软件； 3. 架构与平台不清晰：确认是否支持 Mac Apple Silicon 还是 Windows ARM 经常需要费时翻阅 README。 因此开发了 GitHubPlay，致力于做一个专注“应用与客户端分发视角”的开源软件发现平台。 核心功能 多平台安装包一键直达：自动识别分析 Releases 中的多架构安装包（macOS DMG/PKG、Windows EXE/MSI、Linux AppImage/deb），免去繁琐翻找； 多维度真实增长榜：提供 24 小时、7 天、30 天星标增长排行榜，支持按客户端和 AI 工具分类筛选； 深度分类目录：整理了 AI 大模型、开发辅助、效率工具、音视频处理等 30 多个垂直领域； 开源作者专属徽章：开源作者可以直接取用类似动态星标徽章嵌入自己的 README 中； 智能语言自适应：全站基于 Next.js App Router 服务端直出（SSR），智能自适应浏览器语言偏好（中/英双语）。 欢迎阮老师与周刊读者试用交流与批评指正！

projects.title: Show HN: Corgi, a helpful {agent, terminal} multiplexer
projects.author: eiopa
projects.summary: Hey everyone, Inspired by Herdr, I've built an agent multiplexer that I've been using as my daily driver for a few weeks now. I think I improved on the concept in a few ways, focusing on the ergonomics I always wished I had: I show you what the agents are up to, along with a running feed of their activity. There's also a simple shortcut (F1) to go to the next unread agent. I use multiple accounts, so I've added unified launcher for Codex/Claude Code/Pi. Theres some careful ergonomics there: fast search and resume over sessions, inline usage tracking etc. Many small quality of life improvements to the terminal experience: - Links can be copied with a click, so no need to drag-select over many lines - cmd+v just pastes images (even on SSH) - images have a thumbnail preview. - Built-in CPU/Memory/GPU usage tracking, broken down by workspace I assume you have access to cheap inference (Luna/Haiku/etc). It just reuses the agents to organize things for you: what is this http link? what is this worktree about? what is each agent doing? It's small but it made my environment feel more cozy. On a personal note, I've been on a frustrating sick leave for a while now. I created Corgi to challenge myself, and see if I can go back. The answer is more mixed than I had hoped, but I am happy with the result and thankful for the experience. I hope you like it! a few friends & myself have been using it for a few weeks and it's been pretty nice. There's still a lot to improve and some rough edges, so feedback would be greatly appreciated. Thank you :)

projects.title: Show HN: Kino Transcode – Open Red and Blackmagic Raw Files in the Browser
projects.author: lukeigel
projects.summary: I'm Luke from Kino. We make a video editor + MAM in the browser. Transcode opens Blackmagic RAW, RED R3D, ProRes, DNxHR, and MXF files in the browser (including the famously tricky OP-Atom). You can scrub rapidly, convert to H.264 or ProRes, all without installing anything or uploading footage. We built this because the film editors and creators we work with still need a desktop app just to look at a clip from these cameras, and we want it to be a link instead. The BRAW decoder builds on Paul B Mahol's FFmpeg BRAW decoder, which we ported to FFmpeg 8 and extended for newer files. For the R3D decoder, scrubbing uses quarter, eighth and sixteenth resolution, because a full 8K frame takes about 24 seconds on one core. Also, HDR clips convert to Rec.709 when they're tagged as PQ or HLG with BT.2020 colors. We also built a ProRes encoder+decoder, but we instead merged our efforts with Vanilagy of Mediabunny fame. His turbores implementation is very much worth the hype.

projects.title: Show HN: Bloom – an org-mode compatible Android app for managing notes and tasks
projects.author: rrajath
projects.summary: TL;DR: Made an android app for note-taking and task management compatible with org-mode and I'd love for you to try it. It has a ton of features and a lot of quality of life improvements. If you use Emacs and use an Android phone, this would be a great companion app for you. What is Bloom and why does it exist? Bloom is an org-mode compatible Android app for note-taking and task management. I was a long time Orgzly Revived user and there were certain pain points I wanted solved, like capture templates, bookmarks, nicer UI, better themes, handling sync conflicts, etc. I wanted to solve this for myself and spent a few months working on the app. I announced it on r/emacs ( https://www.reddit.com/r/emacs/comments/1w35r88/grove_an_and... ) a few weeks ago and it is now available on F-Droid and Play Store. Features I want to list out some of the features here (copied over from my announcement post on r/emacs): - Beautiful UI with read and edit modes that offer a really nice viewing experience (rendering headings, plain text, formatted content, tags, dates, drawers, todo keywords, etc) and easy editing with a formatting toolbar that sits above the keyboard. - Handle sync conflicts by showing a diff between current version and incoming copy and select between either of them or keep both - Capture templates that is rich with placeholders like %t, %? and even %^{prompt} - App shortcuts for easy access to capture templates - Agenda view with a separate section for overdue tasks that offers a one-click "move to today" to bulk reschedule all overdue items to today - Agenda widget with a quick add overlay to quickly add tasks - Ability to refile by drilling down to a specific heading, choose the last refiled location or use the ARCHIVE property in the heading, its ancestors or what's defined in the file-level preface. - Ability to auto archive done tasks so that your todo list is clean and you don't have to manually clean up tasks - Setting scheduled/deadline with support for repeater cookies that also have nice explanations for each (I kept forgetting them). It also supports shorthand entry like "d: fri 10-11am ++1w" - Ability to pin specific org files to the top of the list for easy access - Bookmark specific headings in the sidebar for easy access - Support for nested folders - Orgzly-compatible search expressions + visual filtering by including/excluding various facets in the UI - Ability to import/export your settings - Tons of themes. Two official Bloom Light and Dark themes, some custom themes and some popular ones like Catppuccin, Rose Pine Dawn/Moon, Tokyo Night, etc - Notifications for both tasks with a set time as well as a daily digest notification telling you how many tasks you have for the day. There are more features than what I've listed here. You'll stumble upon them as you use the app. I'd really appreciate it if you give it a try. How to get the app? - F-Droid: https://f-droid.org/packages/com.rrajath.grove - Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rrajath.gr... - GitHub Releases: https://github.com/rrajath/bloom/releases Full disclosure: LLMs were involved. But so was I. I spent a lot of time reading through the code that was generated, modifying code, tweaking things, regularly improving performance and redoing certain features over and over again so that I could get it right. One last thing. This app has no tracking, no data collection, no ads, no monetization, no paywall. I hate all of that and I don't want to put users through a shitty experience just to make a few bucks. It will forever be free. I'm very grateful for the Emacs community and it's such a joy to use emacs on a daily basis, I just wanted to share a nice (well, subjective!) app experience.

projects.summary: MegaKey is a proposed standardization + extension of Hyper and Meh - Mental tools for your mind: turn a mouthful like "Shift+Control+Option+Command+C" into "Giga+C" - Software tools for your fingers: easily press Shift+Control+Option+Command+C using just two fingers from a single hand! (via Karabiner rules) I renamed Hyper and Meh because the modifier key combinations varied depending on the source. I picked the most logical combination: Giga == Shift + Mega I picked the names/symbols and even modifier combinations so they would be easy remember. Explained in detail: https://leftium.github.io/megakey/modifiers --- In addition, I created 3 more pseudo-modifier keys. They are very handy for existing shortcuts. For example: - Wish+Space: TrellisWM "Show everything"[1] (Ctrl+Option+Space) - Chaos+N: Chrome "Add tab to new split view" (Cmd+Option+N) - More useful pre-existing shortcuts: https://leftium.github.io/megakey/shortcuts [1]: https://trelliswm.app/docs/#shortcuts

projects.title: Show HN: Ternlux – Free, local-first, bring-your-own-key AI pipeline builder
projects.author: sdataengineer
projects.summary: For the past 12 years as a data engineer, I've been building pipelines across many different business categories and sizes. Most pipelines that I’ve encountered were relatively simple jobs and required more orchestration and infrastructure than the work seems to justify. I wanted to make it easier for business users or analysts to take on the less complicated requests and technical engineers be able to focus on more complex pipelines. So in the past year I've been building a local desktop application (Mac/PC/Linux) to make it easy enough for analysts to build pipelines and answer analytical questions they have about their data, no matter their level of technical expertise. It’s called Ternlux, and it streamlines the process of transforming and getting your data where it needs to go. There are two key features: - Ask questions: AI helps to write the query for your connection and answer your question - Build reusable workflows: The AI generates SQL, Python, and workflow logic that executes based on your defined rules and triggers One of the key advantages of the application is you can perform cross-database joins between databases, local files, vector databases, and cloud storage. You describe the workflow you want and the app writes the code and builds the environment to execute it in (for local joins, it uses either JS, Python, or DuckDB to execute the code). For example, if I want to build a workflow that joins a Postgres table with a CSV file and write the results to Snowflake, I just describe the tables I want to use, the keys to join on, and where the join should run. The app takes care of the rest. I also wanted the app to be as secure as possible. It always asks for approval before performing any database or local file manipulation. It never sends anything to Ternlux servers if you haven’t opted into telemetry. It’s important to note that the app will send query results to your selected AI provider to analyze and answer your questions. It will also send the schema and a small sample size of your data to build workflows properly. It is a bring your own key application. It supports Gemini, Claude, OpenAI, and any models that are OpenAI compatible (Ollama, LM Studio, Openrouter…). All of your credentials stay encrypted locally. And the app is completely free including all features (besides the AI models you use with your own key obviously). I’ve built a quick demo showcasing the applications Demo: https://www.ternlux.com/online-demo/ 3-min overview: https://youtu.be/tA7N7wiLliA The list of connectors that exist: Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server, BigQuery, Snowflake, MongoDB, Pinecone, LanceDB, S3, GCS, Azure Blob, Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, and Google Sheets. I would love your honest feedback on this. How can this product be improved? Would you currently use it as a tool to replace your current tool or in conjunction with your other tools? What feature do you find most useful and I should focus on from the list?

projects.title: Hatoba

projects.title: 【开源自荐】token-pilot：所有 AI 工具的本地账单 + 预算控制器（国产模型自动归一）
projects.author: anthonyhann
projects.summary: 开源协议：MIT 平台：macOS / Windows（CLI 全平台） 为什么做（背景与痛点） 我同时用 Claude Code、Codex、Kimi Code，还经常通过它们跑 DeepSeek、GLM、Kimi 等国产模型。有一天发现：我根本答不上来「我这个月给 AI 烧了多少钱」——每个工具有自己的用量页，分散、单位不一、没有总账、更没有预算。 它是什么 token-pilot = 你所有 AI 工具的本地账单 + 预算控制器。 一条命令看清今天/本月各工具、各模型烧了多少 token、多少钱；菜单栏常驻 ¥今日 · 预算%；超支系统通知；打转检测（揪出死循环烧钱的会话）；省钱建议（贵模型干轻活迁移、缓存优化空间）。 几个不一样的点 国产模型自动归一：DeepSeek/GLM/Kimi/Qwen 等靠宿主日志 model 字段识别，不用单独配置；定价表对齐 8 家官方目录价（DeepSeek 含高峰/空闲分时） 覆盖 9 个数据源：CLI 日志（Claude Code/Codex/Kimi Code/pi）、SQLite（OpenCode）、zstd 压缩日志（DeepSeek Harness）、trace（WorkBuddy）、云端 API（火山 arkcli）；读不到的工具诚实标注，不假装 数据准确性可验证：自带独立对账脚本（第三方口径重算原始日志逐项比对）+ 39 个单元测试 + 36 项看板算法不变量 零入侵：只读本地日志，不装 hook、不改配置、不过代理，数据不出本机 实测数字（作者本机，2026-10） 本月 810M+ tokens · 12,685 次调用；打转检测抓到单会话 120 次重复重试；缓存命中分析显示本月缓存省了 ¥3,048；压缩潜力量化显示上下文重发还有 $63–95/月可省。 截图 安装：npm install -g token-pilot 或 Releases 下载状态栏应用安装包。

projects.summary: Knovum 一款开源、本地优先的无限画布 AI 知识工作空间。将 Heptabase 式的空间白板、Obsidian 的数据掌控权（开放 JSON Canvas + SQLite）与本地离线 AI（Ollama + LanceDB + Whisper）结合，打造轻量、隐私可控的技术调研与学习桌面工作台。 • 本地优先与数据掌控：完全杜绝云端绑定和私有格式锁定。支持行业开放的 JSON Canvas 规范与标准单文件 SQLite，数据 100% 留存在本地，断网全功能可用。 • 极轻原生桌面（Tauri 2 + Rust）：底层由 Rust 驱动，前端采用 Vue 3，启动秒开，常驻内存仅几十 MB，彻底告别传统 Electron 工具动辄数百 MB 内存的笨重感。 • 空间化无限画布：支持 Markdown 笔记卡片、技术草图、PDF/音视频素材同屏混排与双向关联连线，告别死板的层级文件夹。 • 开箱即用的端侧 AI：内置嵌入式 LanceDB 向量检索与本地 Whisper 语音切片转录，原生对接本地 Ollama 模型，提供变异感知溯源引擎（修改源笔记时自动标识引文失效，避免假引用）。 • 开放协议集成：原生支持 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 与 Agent Client Protocol (ACP)。

projects.title: Mippoo

projects.title: Show HN: NiFT – Frictionless, Fast, Note taking app
projects.author: t_mahmood
projects.summary: I have built a note taking, to-do application, what makes this different then others? This app targets to make note taking fun, and efficient. - Most important feature it's fast. Performance wise, and usage wise. It's a combination of convenient, clever (actually obvious) keyboard shortcuts, and focused optimizations to make it extremely simple to take notes fast. - This is completely hand crafted application, Not an AI slop, nor AI assisted. And, a lot of thought has been put to architect the app, and design. - Stores all notes in a simple text file, so personal data is never locked down. If you are a Linux user, you can simply use grep/ripgrep to filter/search your data. - Every note is one liners, actions are done through keyboard shortcuts - Local only - Organize notes using Projects, Tags - A simple but effecting Task management system - Unlimited undo/redo - Search - Filtering by date, date range - Context system to group notes and focused work - Notes are archived, instead of being deleted. But in future there will be way to purge archived notes WIP feature: Reminders - Planned features Back-links, Simple Bookmark manager, Kanban, Timer, Eisenhower matrix, while storing all data in text file. This app is still in development, and many things will be cleaned up gradually. But even in current state it's a complete powerful, efficient note taking application. [Check here for more details, and screenshots]( https://mtarin.com/projects/nift/ ) [Demo video here]( https://youtu.be/r4c6hFey-8M ) [Demo version download]( https://github.com/tmahmood/fluffy_sparrow/releases ) Let me know what do you think! NB: Previously I posted this app as FluffySparrow, NiFT uses same back-end, but the UI is completely rewritten using Tauri, with more features.

projects.title: Offstage

projects.title: AskOnce
projects.summary: AskOnce is a free Windows desktop app that shares project context between Claude Code and Codex. A new chat in one tool starts with a short, local, secret-scanned brief of what you did in the other, so you never explain the same project twice.

projects.title: Cybokron Dock Groups
projects.summary: A free, open-source macOS menu bar app for grouping apps and websites. Open, hide, or close a whole group in one action, and filter groups from the menu bar. Native Swift app for macOS 14+, with a universal Apple Silicon and Intel build, Developer ID signing and Apple notarization. No accounts or analytics. MIT licensed.

projects.title: Ramback
projects.summary: A Mac menu bar app that shows every simulator, emulator, Gradle daemon, container, dev server and AI agent using your RAM, and stops them the way their own tools do. Databases and pins are left alone. A Disk tab finds old runtimes and caches.Ramback shows every simulator, emulator, Gradle daemon, container and dev server eating your Mac's memory, and stops them in one click.

projects.author: UniversalSDK

github.name: UniversalSDK/Dopamine
github.description: Next-generation keep-awake utility with 0.0-nit display backlight cutoff for Apple Silicon MacBooks. Modern Amphetamine successor.

projects.summary: Dopamine 是一款专为搭载 Apple Silicon（M1/M2/M3/M4）MacBook 设计的原生 macOS 菜单栏防休眠与屏幕保护工具。 解决的核心痛点 在 MacBook 上使用传统防休眠工具（如 Amphetamine / Caffeine）时，如果合上笔记本盖子，Liquid Retina / Mini-LED 屏幕底层的背光往往依然处于通电常亮状态，不仅加速发热烘烤键盘，还严重消耗电池。 Dopamine 针对 Apple Silicon 芯片进行了深度底层优化： 1. 合盖硬件级断电：合上屏幕时，通过底层硬件接口与 DPMS 机制自动将背光彻底切断（0.0 尼特纯黑），同时保持 CPU 后台下载、大模型推理、视频渲染或编译持续运行，完全杜绝发热。 2. 开盖毫秒级复原：打开屏幕时，无缝恢复原本设置的亮度与色彩。 3. 轻量纯原生：100% Swift 原生打造，内存仅占用 ~15MB，零 Electron 臃肿。 4. 多语言适配：原生支持简体中文、英语等 11 种语言。 5. 苹果官方公证：已通过 Apple Developer ID 签名与 Apple 官方安全公证（Notarized by Apple），macOS Gatekeeper 零报警直接运行。 代码

github.description: Push-to-talk voice typing for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android. On-device or cloud speech recognition, AI polish with presets, a dictionary, rules and scenes, long recordings with subtitles; the phone works on its own or pairs end-to-end encrypted as the computer's microphone and keyboard.

projects.summary: Voltip 是我做的语音输入工具，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 和 Android。在任意应用里按住 Ctrl+Alt+Space 说话，松开后文字粘贴到光标处；开着 AI 润色时，口头禅和说错又改口的部分会被去掉。识别可以用云端服务商，也可以下载 Qwen3-ASR、SenseVoice 等模型完全在本机完成；AI 润色可选，能接自己的服务商或本机的 Ollama。适合每天在电脑上写大段文字、给 AI 工具口述提示词，或不希望录音离开电脑的人。 亮点 识别可以不离开电脑：应用里能下载五个模型（Qwen3-ASR 0.6B / 1.7B、SenseVoice Small、Paraformer、实时预览用的流式模型）。Qwen3-ASR 经 transcribe.cpp 运行，有显卡时走 Vulkan（Windows、Linux）或 Metal（macOS），没有显卡就用 CPU；SenseVoice 和 Paraformer 经 sherpa-onnx 在 CPU 上运行。也可以自己配置各个服务商的URL和api key使用云服务识别润色。 词典专门对付总被听错的词：每个词条写一个正确写法和最多 10 个常被听成的样子，识别后立即替换，正确写法还会作为提示发给云端识别和 AI 润色。最后还有字面和正则两种替换规则。 场景：开始录音时看前台是哪个应用，自动换用对应的润色预设。内置了编程、办公写作、即时聊天等场景（默认关闭，打开后生效），编程场景里代码、命令、路径和标识符保持原样。 语音编辑：选中一段文字，按住 Ctrl+Alt+E 说「改得正式一点」或「翻译成英文」，选区直接被改写结果替换。 安卓手机可以当电脑的麦克风和键盘：扫码或输入 6 位验证码配对，音频端到端加密后经中继传到电脑，由电脑用自己的设置识别。 没有桌面的 Linux 服务器上可以运行 voltip-server，向本机其他程序提供 OpenAI 兼容的转写接口。 核心用 Rust 写，桌面端是 Tauri 2 + React，AGPL-3.0 开源。 目前的限制：Windows 安装包还没有代码签名，macOS 版未经 Apple 公证；iOS 版还没有；纯 Wayland 会话没有全局快捷键；不做说话人区分和批量转写。

projects.summary: 自荐一个开源的港股量化交易系统，futualgo，基于富途 OpenAPI。 项目 2020 年写的，攒了 600 多个 star。今年翻出来一看，新装的环境根本跑不起来（futu-api 删了 OpenHKTradeContext），实盘遇到第一个卖出信号就崩，持仓平不掉，有个策略因为拿一根 K 线跟它自己比，永远不会交易。所以干脆整个重写了，刚发了 2.1.0。 现在的版本： K 线本地缓存，自动翻过富途单页 1000 根的限制，不超频率和历史额度；任意分钟周期按交易时段合成，不跨午休。 指标按通达信的算法实现，公式可以逐行搬过来；每次回测自动检查未来函数。 回测按下一根开盘价、整手成交，印花税和交易征费按成交当天适用的费率算，滑点按港交所价位表，基准是恒生指数。 模拟盘吃 OpenD 实时推送的 K 线，跟回测用同一份策略代码。测试会拿真实的一分钟 K 线同时跑回测和实盘引擎，要求每一笔成交、每一笔费用和最终资金完全一致。 自带网页控制台，不需要富途账户也能用 futu-algo web --demo 在模拟行情里体验。 Python 3.11+，Apache-2.0。

projects.summary: ScreenShade 是一个用 Swift/AppKit 编写的 macOS 菜单栏工具，适合让 Codex、Computer Use 等桌面自动化继续运行时遮黑本地屏幕。它覆盖多块显示器，在可读取原亮度的外接屏上尝试硬件调光，并区分物理键鼠活动与普通后台输入。支持逐屏配置硬件待机、自动唤醒验证和原亮度恢复，可作为 AppKit 窗口、IOHID 输入及 DDC/CI 控制的实践项目。 亮点 项目自荐，主要特点如下： 保留软件桌面供自动化继续使用，同时遮黑多块本地显示器，不主动修改分辨率或移动窗口。 使用 IOHID 识别物理键鼠活动，普通后台合成输入不会自动解除遮罩；另有关闭按钮及全局唤醒快捷键。 硬件待机逐屏配置，验证是可选流程：测试后自动请求唤醒、检查原亮度与桌面布局，再由用户确认实际熄屏和远程操作。未验证也能设置。 原亮度和电源状态先保存再修改，恢复失败保留记录，支持重试及重新启动后恢复。 Swift、AppKit、IOKit 实现，无第三方运行时依赖，DDC 传输部分复用 m1ddc。 主项目采用 MIT 许可证，保留第三方 m1ddc 的版权和许可声明。 使用范围：Apple Silicon Mac、macOS 13 及以上；当前需要从源码构建并授予输入监控权限，尚无经过 Apple 公证的下载版。DDC 调光、待机及远控兼容性取决于具体设备，纯黑遮罩不代表物理背光完全关闭。

projects.title: 【开源自荐】Treefold：把 AI Coding 的多仓库、Worktree、终端和任务放在一起
projects.author: win5do

github.name: win5do/treefold
github.description: A local-first macOS app for running AI agents in parallel Git worktrees. Keep code, terminals, and tasks together, then merge changes back cleanly.

projects.summary: LLM 时代高强度用 AI Agent 搞项目，LLM 很强，但想要高效舒服的开发还是有很多繁琐的流程。 例如经常同时推进几个任务，还涉及前后端两个 repo，并行任务不相互冲突大家都知道用 git worktree。 手敲 git worktree 命令很繁琐，AI 可以代劳，但每次都要交代一遍却挺烦：从哪个分支创建，前后端项目在哪个目录，做完合回哪里。想去对应目录跑条命令，还得找路径、开终端、切过去。任务一多，就容易忘记哪个目录对应哪件事。 我就在想能不能把常用流程做到一个 ui 界面中管理，于是做了一个 APP 叫 Treefold。我想把每项任务的代码、终端和进度放在一起，打开就知道做到哪了，接下来可以继续做什么。 任务展开以后，要知道怎么收回来 我把工作分成三层：Project、Workspace、Fork。 Project 放一个项目相关的仓库和目录。我一般让原仓库保持在 main 分支，再为每项 feature 创建 Workspace，各自使用独立分支和 worktree。创建时默认从原仓库当前分支展开，也可以选择其他本地或远端分支作为起点。 一个 feature 里有可以并行的子任务，就继续创建 Fork。比如做“商品搜索”，可以让几个 Fork 分别负责接口、页面和测试，各自在独立目录里修改，完成后合回父 Workspace，再一起联调和交付。 这样，worktree 就有了明确的父子关系，交付时知道应该合回哪里。操作由人确认，发生冲突仍然需要处理。Workspace 还可以选择推送 feature 分支，接着走原来的远端评审流程。 简单任务开一个 Workspace 就够了，不用每次都拆 Fork。同一 Workspace 里的多个 Session 共享代码目录；需要隔离修改时，再创建 Fork。 worktree 多了，目录和状态都得看得清 git worktree list 能列出目录和分支，但想知道里面是否有未提交的修改、改动是否已经合回去，还得逐个检查。任务多了，这些小操作也会打断思路。 Treefold 把 worktree list 做成了界面里的管理列表，按仓库展开。每个 worktree 的分支、路径、当前提交和关联任务放在一起，同时显示未提交改动、冲突，以及相对目标分支领先或落后的提交数。已经合入目标分支的状态也会标出来，不用挨个进入目录查 Git。 从列表可以直接打开关联任务；不再使用的 worktree，可以在界面里确认后删除，也能清理失效的 worktree 记录。哪些还在开发、哪些改动已经合入、哪些目录可以收拾，都有地方查看。 完成的任务可以归档，先保留分支、worktree 和工作记录，之后再按需清理。Project 里可以批量清理已归档的 Workspace，Workspace 里也能清理已归档的 Fork。隔天回来看时，活跃任务和已完成的工作分开，也能找到之前的交付记录。 创建 worktree、启动 Session 和批量清理都可以在后台继续，不用一直守着弹窗。切去做其他任务后，也能回来查看状态和失败原因。 Agent 写完，检查代码和提交 我一直挺喜欢 JetBrains 的 Git 集成：修改在哪里，提交了什么，都可以直接看。 Treefold 里也放了 Git Changes 和 History。开发过程中看 diff，交付前检查提交；几个零散提交可以用 Squash 整理成一个，也可以 Reset 到指定提交。当前分支最新一次提交的说明写得不合适，也可以直接在 History 里修改。如果本地记录显示它被远端分支、标签或其他分支引用，会先提醒，再由我决定是否继续。 完成交付时，可以选择 Squash，把这项工作的成果合成一个提交放进父分支。前后端改动不一样，就分别填写提交说明，在同一个弹窗里检查后一起确认。源分支上的开发记录仍然保留，父分支收到的是整理后的提交。 我没有做完整的交互式 rebase 和冲突编辑器。常用操作放在界面里，更复杂的 Git 操作继续交给终端和 Agent，处理完再回来检查结果。 Project 里也能直接查看和搜索本地、远端分支，切换分支，或者删除不再需要的分支。这些短操作，不用每次都通过聊天交给 Agent。 检查代码时，也不想每次都重新告诉 Agent：“这是哪几个仓库，应该和哪个分支比较，别漏掉还没提交的修改。”所以加了 AI Review：在 Workspace 或 Fork 里选一个 Agent，确认提示词，就会打开一个专门检查这项工作的 Session。 Fork 和父 Workspace 比较，Workspace 和 Project 当前分支比较。Treefold 会把各仓库的路径、分支和比较范围交给 Agent，要求同时检查已提交、未提交的修改和新文件。默认提示词让它先报告问题，我确认后，可以在同一个 Session 里继续讨论、修复和验证。也可以给 Project 保存自己的 Review 提示词。 这样，从开发、检查到修复都留在同一项任务里，最后再决定怎么交付。完成交付前，如果还有将被停止的 Session 在运行，界面会先列出来，让我选择暂缓交付，或者确认停止后继续。这里检查的是进程是否还活着，不能替我判断 Agent 是否已经做完。 暂缓的任务，先记在 Todo 里 和 AI 讨论方案时，经常会冒出一些现在不做、以后值得试的点子。以前我会开个文件记 Todo，接下来还得记得这个文件放在哪。 现在可以直接记到 Workspace 的 Todo list。要做的时候，把 Todo 分配给 Fork，展开成一项独立工作；完成并合回父 Workspace 后，关联的 Todo 也会完成。 Treefold 也带了 CLI 和 Skill，Agent 能读取、添加和修改 Todo，遇到问题时也能记录阻塞原因。换一个 Session 接着做，代码、Todo 和交付记录都还留在 Workspace 里，不用依赖某一次聊天记住所有事情。 比如接口开发时发现一个值得单独处理的问题，可以先留下 Todo，继续完成手头的工作。等有空了再把它分出去，也不用为了保留这个点子一直开着原来的 Session。 Agent 把服务跑起来了，我却看不到它在干什么 调试的时候，我经常要让 Agent 启动前后端服务。以前它通常在自己的会话后台启动，再告诉我“服务已经起来了”。我只知道启动了，眼前却没有一个能持续看日志的终端。想知道请求有没有进来、服务有没有报错，还得让它再查一遍。 两个 Agent 并行工作时更麻烦：各自的会话没有共享的进程列表，不知道对方已经启动了什么。一个刚把服务跑起来，另一个又启动一遍，端口就冲突了。 Treefold 用 amux 管理这些需要持续运行的进程。服务可以跟着任务列出来，人能在界面里看日志、输入命令，Agent 也能通过 amux 查询进程、读取日志、停止或重启服务。几个 Session 可以共同观察同一个服务，启动前先查看已有进程，再决定复用还是另开一套。 切走页面不影响进程运行，也不用再回忆服务藏在哪次聊天里。不过并行启动多套服务时，端口仍然需要分别配置，Treefold 目前不会自动隔离端口。 关闭窗口时，可以选择让 App 留在后台，或者直接退出。退出 App 后是否保留 amux 和受管进程，则由单独的设置控制。 一个任务，可能要改几个仓库 有些项目的前后端是两个 Git 仓库。一个功能要两边一起改，就得告诉 AI 两边的位置，同步创建分支和 worktree，再检查是不是进了对应的目录。 所以 Treefold 的一个 Project 可以放多个仓库。创建 Workspace 或 Fork 时，相关仓库一起准备分支和 worktree，后续查看修改、同步和交付也在同一个任务里完成，各仓库的结果分别展示。 接手已有工作也不用从头开始。创建 Workspace 时，每个仓库可以分别新建分支，或者选一个已有的本地或远端分支继续做。分支列表可以搜索，已经被其他 worktree 占用的本地分支会标出来，避免选错工作目录。前端从 main 开始，后端接着已有 feature 开发，也可以放进同一个 Workspace。 还有 monorepo：一个仓库里放了很多项目，我可能只关心其中几个目录。Treefold 可以把这些子目录设为工作入口，也可以加入外部资料目录，方便 Agent 找到相关上下文。目录选择帮助组织工作，Git worktree 仍然以整个仓库为单位。 需要换回熟悉的工具时，Open With 可以直接在 IDE、终端或 Finder 中打开当前目录，也能一键复制路径。选中了哪个任务，就打开它对应的工作目录。 保留终端习惯，少记几个快捷键 我日常主要用 Agent 的 CLI 和 TUI，所以 Treefold 里的 Agent 也是原来的终端界面。目前支持 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 和 Pi，也可以单独开 Shell 跑命令。终端使用 xterm.js。 Agent 使用本机安装的 CLI，沿用自己的登录和模型配置。喜欢哪个就用哪个，同一项任务里也可以开不同的 Agent Session。使用前先确认相应 CLI 在终端里能正常运行；没有配置 Agent，也可以先用 Shell。 我喜欢 Command Palette，但不想记一大堆快捷键。所以默认只给少数高频操作绑定快捷键，其他操作从 Palette 找，也可以按自己的习惯修改绑定。 这里我比较在意上下文：在某个 Fork 里打开 Palette，新建 Session、开始 AI Review 或打开目录，就应该接着使用这个 Fork 的上下文，不用重新选一遍。 免费开源，本地运行 Treefold 免费开源，使用 AGPL-3.0-only 许可证。App 在本机运行，项目状态、任务、Session 元数据和配置保存在自己的电脑上，核心管理功能不依赖云端服务。 Agent projects.title: [开源了一个小工具] AI 回答写好了，怎么发到聊天框？我做了一个开源工具 md2chat
projects.author: brightguo
projects.summary: [ 10-20 新增支持了快捷键设置] [ 10-18 新增支持了 dsh 插件] 用 AI 整理内容时，我们很容易得到一份排版清楚的回答：标题、列表、对比表格，偶尔还有代码、数学公式和流程图。 但分享给别人时，往往还要做一轮整理。 一张表格复制进聊天框，可能变成夹着竖线的文字；公式露出一串符号；流程图剩下源代码。把整段内容截图发过去，阅读是方便了，对方想复制一句话、一个链接，又得借助文字识别。 我做了一个开源工具 md2chat ，中文名叫「贴贴 Markdown 」，用来处理这一步：把 Markdown 转成适合聊天的图文，普通文字保持可编辑，表格、代码、公式和流程图转成图片，再按照原文顺序组合。 ![]( https://i.v2ex.co/FaA8pV5J.jpeg) 左侧输入 Markdown ，右侧实时预览。同一份内容中的文字、表格、代码、公式和流程图，可以分别得到合适的呈现方式。 文字可以继续改，复杂排版交给图片 分享时，你可能希望临时改一下讨论时间、补上一句提醒，也希望表格和流程图保持完整。md2chat 会根据内容类型分别转换： 这种方式也有明确的取舍：代码、表格和公式成为图片后，适合阅读，但不能在聊天框里直接编辑其中的内容。如果需要对方继续修改代码或处理表格数据，可以同时附上源码或原始文档。 你可以处理自己写的 Markdown ，也可以处理从 AI 工具中复制的回答。这里不需要连接 AI 账号，也不用配置 API Key ；转换从你已经复制好的内容开始。 例如，AI 在解释一个问题时给出了数学公式，又用 Mermaid 描述了一段流程，就可以一起放进来： ![]( https://i.v2ex.co/R3pZ2W7e.jpeg) 公式与流程图完成渲染，前后的解释仍然保留为文字。图中展示的是工具内预览。 它也适合一些更日常的分享：把活动安排发给朋友，把学习笔记发给同学，或者把方案中的几段说明和一张对比表发给同事。 这些内容通常还用不上单独制作一份演示文稿，但又值得比一段纯文字更清楚一些。 不同聊天软件，采用不同的复制方式 md2chat 提供微信、钉钉、飞书、企业微信和邮件入口。选择目标平台后，工具会采用对应的转换与复制方式。 ![]( https://i.v2ex.co/BlggptlP.png) 如果每天都要做类似的事，桌面版还提供菜单栏和系统托盘入口。复制好内容后，在「剪贴板转换」中选择目标格式，转换完成后回到聊天软件粘贴即可。企微图文会打开分段面板。 你也可以把常用格式放到托盘菜单顶部，并调整顺序，减少每次寻找入口的操作。 遇到希望把整段内容作为一张图片分享的情况，桌面版还提供「转图片」入口。它会将文字、表格、代码、公式与图片按顺序合成一张 PNG 。此时整段内容里的文字也会成为图片的一部分，可以根据分享用途选择。 如果你也经常把 AI 回答、Markdown 笔记或技术说明发给别人，欢迎拿一段熟悉的内容试试 md2chat 。 https://forgeturl.github.io/md2chat

projects.title: Show HN: Frink – Desktop-first app for multi-step workflows and parallel agents
projects.author: norvalbv
projects.summary: What’s up HN?! I'm Benji, and I’ve been building Frink since ~April this year. Frink is a desktop-first, open-source (MIT) app for running coding agents in parallel and multi-step workflows that start on their own. It runs on your machine (macOS and Linux) with your own provider login. It currently supports Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, and OpenCode, but the latter 3 are in preview. No Frink account to use the app. The biggest USP of Frink is workflows: think n8n for agents. You describe a routine in a sentence, for example: "every weekday at 9am, run the tests; if any fail, have an agent fix them, then wait for my approval before it opens a PR." Then, Frink builds it as a workflow (or simply, Flow): a list of steps you can read and change before it runs. A Flow can start on a schedule, from any webhook, or from an event from a third-party such as Linear, Shortcut, ClickUp, Sentry, PostHog, etc. Steps can be agent turns, shell commands, conditions, approval steps that stop and wait for you, or steps you write yourself in code (or ask the agent to write one). Everything that needs you (an approval, an agent's question, a finished task to review) lands in one Work Queue. Other stuff: * Up to four agents side by side, each on its own git worktree if you want. Or, many agents out of direct view. * Every change shows as a diff; there's a code editor, a terminal, etc. * Local-first: chats, Flows and tasks live in SQLite on your machine. * Easier provider parity: currently working on and improving the tooling setup between providers. Once inside Frink, irrespective of what provider you use, the hooks, MCPs, and other tooling work out of the box between providers. Why I built it: I started building it when there weren’t many other competitors; now the industry is swamped with ADEs and harnesses. However, in my opinion, each still lacks good automation for more fine-tuned scenarios. I doubled down on the flows to help me with my actual day-to-day job as a SWE, and over time it’s helped me automate most of the PRs being shipped across my personal projects, team, etc., to the point that it’s a continuous loop and helps a whole ton. Notes: Windows isn't supported yet. Flows only run on Claude Code and Codex for now. It's a solo project, so expect sharp edges.
