projects.summary: Cybokron Dock Groups 是一款免费、开源（MIT 许可）的 macOS 菜单栏应用，使用 Swift 编写。你可以将应用和网站放入自定义名称的分组中，选择某个分组后，其中的应用会在 Dock 上方的小弹窗中显示，你可以一次性打开、隐藏或关闭整个分组。每个分组还可以拥有自己的 Dock 图标。它适合在编程、设计或会议等不同工作场景之间切换的用户。 亮点 原生 SwiftUI/AppKit 应用，不使用 Electron，没有第三方依赖；提供适用于 Apple Silicon 和 Intel 的通用版本，需要 macOS 14 或更高版本。 网站可以与应用一同放在同一分组中。 键盘友好的弹窗：输入即可筛选，使用方向键和回车键打开，并可为每个分组设置全局快捷键。 提供 Siri 和快捷指令操作（Launch Group、Quit Group、Show Group），以及供脚本使用的 URL scheme。 已由 Apple 签名并公证；内置的更新检查会验证每个下载文件的 SHA-256 校验值。界面提供 26 种语言，包括简体中文。

projects.title: PocketMDM
projects.summary: PocketMDM brings Apple device management to Apple Shortcuts. Connect Apple Business, Apple School Manager, Jamf Pro, Jamf School, and Microsoft Intune to automate everyday MDM tasks across iPhone, iPad, and Mac using Shortcuts. Build custom workflows with native Shortcuts actions and secure on-device credential storage. Start free, unlock more with Pro.

projects.title: Show HN: Switchboard – Mac menu bar app that shows every localhost port
projects.author: rbtsven

projects.title: popCalendar
projects.summary: See a full year in your Mac's menu bar, with a live clock behind the calendar. Drag across dates to count days and workdays, even across years. Keep daily events beside two years with a month sidebar, or fill a whole display. Make it yours with photos and 27 clock presets. Add fullscreen meeting reminders, saved ranges, and countdowns. Native for Apple silicon and Intel. Core features work offline, with no ads or developer analytics.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】iPhone Agent Harness：用 Safari + ESP32 让 AI 无线操作 iPhone
projects.author: cccat6

github.name: cccat6/iphone-agent-harness
github.description: Automate your iPhone from Safari with a low-cost ESP32 Bluetooth bridge. Local conversations, your choice of AI, and community skills.

projects.summary: 中文说明： 大家好，我是项目作者，想自荐一个开源的 iPhone 自动化项目：在 Safari 中用自然语言描述任务，由智能体查看屏幕，再通过旁边的 ESP32 蓝牙桥完成点按、输入和滑动。网站提供了在真实 iPhone 上设置闹钟的演示。 实现方式 Safari 负责会话、屏幕采集和模型调用；Harness 校验动作计划后，通过局域网 WebRTC 发送指令。 ESP32 模拟蓝牙鼠标和键盘，通过 iOS 辅助触控操作手机，不在板上运行大模型。 手机和桥接板使用同一个日常 Wi-Fi，板子独立供电，手机不用插线连接板子。 首次固件安装可在电脑 Chrome / Edge 中完成；提供会话管理、自选模型、可分享技能和 MCP 工具配置。 会话、截图和密钥保存在当前浏览器；选定的上下文发送给用户选择的模型服务商。项目提供英语、简体中文、繁体中文、日语、俄语、德语、法语和西班牙语版本。 当前需要 iOS / iPadOS 27+、Safari 屏幕共享、辅助触控，以及可用的视觉模型。演示是具体任务的实机结果，不代表任意 App 或长流程都已验证。 项目受到 onehumanbeing/esp32-iphone-agent 的启发，已在 README 中致谢。我们的实现采用 Safari + 蓝牙 HID 的无线使用路线。 欢迎试用、反馈设备兼容性和希望自动化的手机任务。

projects.title: Rayclip
projects.summary: Rayclip syncs clipboard text and shares screenshots and files between your Mac and Android — so you can stop emailing yourself. QR pairing, no accounts, end-to-end encryption.

projects.title: LilMoon
projects.summary: LilMoon keeps the live Bitcoin price, the latest block and the current fees on your Mac, in the menu bar or as a small desktop widget. Twelve looks and sixteen effects, from a clean glass panel to a CRT terminal, and every color, font and size is yours to change. Alerts on price, 24h change or fees, with a cooldown so a flat market doesn't ping you all afternoon. Prices from Binance, Kraken or Coinbase in 18 currencies. No account, no server. $2.99 once.

projects.title: [开源推荐] 抽屉 Drawer：Windows 快捷启动器（网址 / 文件夹 / 文件）
projects.author: dyyhsq1314

github.name: hsq2004815-oss/resource-hub-desktop
github.description: 抽屉 Drawer — a portable Windows quick launcher for favorite websites, folders and files. Folder mind map, global-hotkey quick panel, Chrome/Edge bookmark sync. Flutter + Python, MIT.

projects.summary: 抽屉 Drawer 是一个免安装的 Windows 10/11 快捷启动器，把常用网址、文件夹和文件收进一个可搜索的列表。一个全局快捷键呼出，敲几个字回车即开；点开文件夹会展开思维导图，不用一层层点资源管理器；还支持 Chrome/Edge 书签同步和资源管理器右键添加。纯本地运行，无账号、无联网，MIT 开源。 亮点 1. 文件夹思维导图：点开文件夹直接看目录结构，Ctrl+滚轮缩放、拖动平移、逐层展开，双击打开、右键加入抽屉，省掉一层层点资源管理器的过程。 2. 键盘优先的快速面板：Ctrl+Alt+Shift+L / F 呼出紧凑树状面板，方向键 + 回车完成打开，Esc 关闭，全程不用鼠标。 3. 免安装纯本地：约 22 MB zip，数据就是程序目录下几个 JSON 文件；不登录、不联网、无统计，换电脑复制整个文件夹即可。 4. 完整的技术迁移记录：从 2900 行单文件 Tkinter 迁移到 Flutter 客户端 + 纯标准库 Python 后端（stdio 上的 JSON Lines），75 个 Flutter 测试 + 326 个 Python 测试，25 篇阶段文档放在 migration/ 目录，适合作为桌面应用分层的案例。 5. 细节：列表 / 网格拖动排序（5 秒撤销）、收藏置顶、分类筛选、路径体检、中英文界面、明暗主题。 截图或演示视频 动图： 主界面： 快速面板： 文件夹思维导图：

projects.title: Clipper Pro
projects.summary: Pasting into Notion breaks tables, code and lists. Clipper Pro sends articles, selections, Word and PDF passages and ChatGPT answers as real Notion blocks. Chrome and Edge extension plus a desktop app. 30 free clips a month.

projects.title: DrinkMe
projects.summary: DrinkMe is a minimalist desktop app that automatically compresses videos into smaller files—no manual settings or technical know-how required. Just pick a file, click Shrink, and save space. Although it varies depending on each file, it aims at reducing between 80-90% of the original size.

projects.title: AirControl
projects.summary: A menu bar app that turns the Mac's webcam into a controller. Changes windows and screens. Scroll and Point. Supports multiple monitors! macOS 14+.

projects.title: Ahed
projects.summary: Vibe coding, made easier. Ahed turns your project context and personal preferences into useful next prompts, magical ghost text, and shortcuts that keep you building.

projects.title: Praex
projects.summary: Praex is an AI coding agent that runs on its own model family: Velox II (free, fast), Faber II (Pro, deep reasoning) and Lucia II (frontier, coming soon), post-trained from the best open models. It reads your repo, edits with your approval, runs your tests and explains every change. Use it in the terminal, the desktop app or the browser, and continue any session from your phone with /rc. The terminal agent is open source (MIT). Free to start, Pro $20/month.

projects.title:
为了不让闲置的备案被管局注销,索性单搓了个 macOS 侧边栏笔记： iFolo Note
, macOS 侧边栏简约笔记
projects.author: Jensond
projects.summary: 前阵子让 muse 整理云资产，发现早年藏箱子底的项目 `https://www.ifolo.cn` 和辛苦拿下的 ICP 备案号一直在吃灰,还有 claude 的 tokens,索性拯救了一下尸山代码,搓了一个 macOS 侧边栏笔记：iFolo Note.按我自己使用习惯来的,大家可酌情使用,可提提意见!免费,免费,免费! ### 为什么要造这个轮子？ 每天面对 IDE 和 多 Agent 终端，我在 Mac 上随手记东西一直很割裂： * **重型软件太重**：只是想临时贴段 JSON 、记行命令或闪念，用 Notion 、Obsidian 甚至系统备忘录都得 `Cmd + Tab` 切窗口，打断思路。 * **桌面便签太乱**：贴多了像牛皮癣，过后根本找不到。 我想要的只是一个**平时完全隐形、需要时从屏幕边缘一秒滑出、写完立刻缩回去,AI 时代还支持可控 mcp**的轻量容器。 ### 核心特点 1. **无感边缘呼出**：常驻屏幕侧边，鼠标贴边或快捷键秒开。全屏写代码、开会时随叫随到，不抢焦点，用完即走。 2. **原生丝滑体验**：拒绝套壳卡顿，深度优化了滑出帧率与输入延迟，后台常驻几乎零感。 3. **Markdown 混排直出**：代码片段、Todo 、临时链接所见即所得，无需在源码和预览模式间反复横跳。 4. **不只是临时草稿**：支持双链与标签整理，纯本地 Markdown 存储,目前还没做云端同步、s 5. 3 同步啥的，Mac 侧边栏记下的碎片灵感，随时能在 iOS 端继续整理，数据完全自主。 --- ![1792413680626.png]( https://picui.ogmua.cn/s1/2026/10/19/6ad60ff81f2e3.webp) ![1792413938920.png]( https://picui.ogmua.cn/s1/2026/10/19/6ad61104628ca.webp) ![1792413857126.png]( https://picui.ogmua.cn/s1/2026/10/19/6ad611192ceb9.webp) ![1792413927750.png]( https://picui.ogmua.cn/s1/2026/10/19/6ad611198bb42.webp) ![1792413912991.png]( https://picui.ogmua.cn/s1/2026/10/19/6ad61119879aa.webp) 目前 Macos 端已稳定,后期计划 windows 端，欢迎大家体验,免费、免费!： 👉 **官网**： https://www.ifolo.cn

projects.title: Accent Letters for Chrome
projects.summary: Typing é in a browser means leaving whatever you were doing — a search, a copy-paste site, Character Map. Accent Letters is a free Chrome extension. 682 accented letters in your toolbar, A to Z, each with its Alt code, keyboard shortcut and HTML entity. Click one and it is on your clipboard. Search by the letter itself, by its Unicode name, by language, or in plain words: "two dots", "squiggle", "hat". Works in Brave, Arc and Opera too. No account, no ads, no tracking.

projects.title: PickDock
projects.summary: PickDock puts Android apps, web links and map links into tabs you organize. Search and sort your links, adjust display size and layout, and open a tab through a home widget or shortcut. Backup and restore includes a review of differences before restoring, while missing app entries are retained. Build separate spaces for the links you use during different parts of your day. Android only.

projects.title: 【工具自荐】兰桥：带 AI 修电脑助手的远程桌面，动手前先征得你同意（提供免费版）
projects.author: JackieDD
projects.summary: 兰桥是我们做的一款远程桌面工具 在要被控制的电脑上装好客户端，另一台设备打开浏览器网页版，就能远程操作那台电脑，控制端不用安装。 和普通远程桌面不同的是，它内置了一个 AI 助手“小兰”。远程连上之后，遇到“软件打不开”“系统更新卡住”“磁盘空间不足”这类问题，可以先让小兰查原因，它会把检查结果和下一步办法讲清楚，需要动手修改时会先停下来，等你确认。 主要特点： 1. 提供免费版：同一账号可绑定多台电脑，同时控制 1 台；公网画面最高 1920 像素宽、30 帧，原生客户端在局域网内可选 4K/30 帧（实际效果受硬件和网络影响）；支持文件传输；在线 AI 有每 7 天滚动计算的免费额度。 2. 连接需要输入验证码或由对方批准，随时可以断开。会话使用 AES-256-GCM 加密，中继服务器只转发密文。 3. 小兰有三档权限：逐步确认（编辑外部文件、使用互联网时都会询问）、仅高风险确认、完全访问（仍限本次任务已确认的应用、文件和网络范围）。 4. 支持微信、手机号登录，国内有备案站点；Windows 安装包已签名。 定价与免费额度： 隐私政策： 目前被控端支持 Windows 10 及以上（x64）和 macOS 14 及以上（仅 Apple 芯片），暂不支持远程开机。 我们最初是为了“帮爸妈远程修电脑”这个场景做的，早期用户反馈还不错，欢迎试用和提意见。

projects.title: QuickTriggers: Text Expander
projects.summary: Type less. Save time. QuickTriggers is a powerful productivity tool designed to help you save frequently used text, images, PDFs, files, and links as quick shortcuts (Triggers). Stop typing the same information repeatedly or digging through your storage for that one file - create a short trigger and let QuickTriggers expand or share instantly! Whether you manage email templates, documents, files or standard replies, QuickTriggers makes everyday communication effortlessly easy.

projects.title: VibeRes
projects.summary: VibeRes is a free, open-source resolution switcher for the macOS menu bar. Every connected display and all its scaled and native modes are one click away. Hover a mode to see how much bigger or smaller the screen gets before you switch. Save multi-display profiles like Work, Code or Presentation and run them from Shortcuts, Siri or the viberes CLI. Native SwiftUI, signed and notarized, installs with Homebrew. A successor to EasyRes, which is no longer maintained.

projects.title: OpusBar
projects.summary: OpusBar is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app for Claude Code and Codex. A pixel cat shows your most urgent session, and a badge counts the ones waiting on you. It tracks 5-hour and weekly limits and what your tokens would cost. Nothing leaves your Mac.

projects.title: LazyBoard
projects.summary: Save the replies, signatures and prompts you type every day, then insert them with a short shortcut likethanks. Fill in names and dates before inserting. Works on Mac, Windows and Chrome. Free for 10 snippets, no account needed.

projects.title: 【产品自荐】Netlink：Mac 出口 IP 一变就提醒，一键体检 VPN、代理和 DNS
projects.author: venshine
projects.summary: Netlink 是一款 Mac 菜单栏 App，后台盯着出口 IP，一变就通知；一键沿八个阶段检查 VPN、代理、DNS 和时区，给出评分和每项扣分的修复建议。查询使用内置数据库，联网前先征得同意，运行在沙盒中。免费使用，Pro 一次买断。

projects.title: StampIt
projects.summary: A lightning-fast, 100% offline desktop app that lets you batch-watermark your photo collections instantly with zero subscriptions, zero cloud uploads, and...

projects.title: [开源推荐]NotchMuse：在 Mac 菜单栏和刘海旁显示同步歌词
projects.author: Xiye88

github.name: Xiye88/NotchMuse
github.description: NotchMuse v0.8.0: synced macOS lyrics for Spotify, Apple Music, NetEase, QQ Music and Soda Music. Menu bar, notch, side and Dock lyrics with in-app updates.

projects.summary: NotchMuse 是一款用 Swift 和 AppKit 编写的原生 macOS 歌词工具，MIT 协议开源、免费使用。它能自动识别当前播放的 Spotify、Apple Music、网易云音乐、QQ 音乐或汽水音乐，把逐行同步的歌词显示在菜单栏、MacBook 刘海旁、屏幕左右两侧或 Dock 上方。写代码、看文档时不必切回播放器窗口，也能随时看到当前这句歌词。 亮点 1. 国内播放器也能用：除了 Spotify 和 Apple Music，还支持网易云音乐、QQ 音乐和汽水音乐。这三个播放器通过随应用打包的 MediaRemote bridge 读取播放状态，不用装 Homebrew，也不用额外装 helper。同类工具 LyricsX 主要面向 iTunes/Spotify/Vox，最近一次 release 是 2022 年。 2. 四种显示位置：菜单栏、刘海旁、屏幕左右两侧、Dock 上方，宽度和位置都能调，正好利用 MacBook 刘海两边原本空着的区域。 3. 原生、轻量：用 Swift + AppKit 编写，不是 Electron。DMG 大约 6.8 MB，支持纯色/渐变、背景、透明度、外观预设，跟随系统浅色/深色。 4. 自动检测播放器：同时开着几个播放器时，会自动跟随正在播放的那个，也可以手动指定。 5. 隐私：不用注册账号，App 内没有遥测；只把歌名、歌手、专辑、时长发给歌词源做匹配，不上传音频。 6. 开源：MIT 协议，第三方组件见 THIRDPARTYNOTICES.md；README 有中英文两份，另有 CHANGELOG 和发布说明。

projects.title: LaunchAsset AI
projects.summary: LaunchAsset AI is a lightweight, offline Windows desktop utility for indie hackers, founders, and developers. Skip complex design tools and subscription software—generate high-resolution Product Hunt banners, Twitter headers, and social preview cards directly on your PC with zero cloud dependency.

projects.title: Show HN: An outliner to replace Workflowy and Obsidian – as a Claude connector
projects.author: laurentenhoor
projects.summary: A free outliner with Workflowy's shortcuts and Obsidian's markdown, no backend, and a Claude connector built in. Say "add that to my notes" in any conversation and it lands in your outline; ask what you wrote last month and Claude answers from it. No account to try: bulletlist.org/demo

projects.title: Rowcraft
projects.summary: Rowcraft is an open source database workbench written in pure Rust. Write SQL, explore schemas, and browse data in a fast native desktop app, with no Electron and no JVM. It has a CLI from day one, and it's built to cover the same ground as heavyweight IDEs like DataGrip while staying lightweight and free.

projects.title: Look Launcher
projects.summary: Look is a free, open-source launcher for macOS, Windows and Linux, with every feature free. Find apps, files, folders, clipboard history and open windows as fast as you type. One-key system controls (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, media, keep-awake) work on GNOME, KDE and tiling WMs alike. Rust core, no browser engine, no telemetry, no account. Install from Homebrew, AUR, nixpkgs or Scoop, or grab the installer from GitHub Releases.

projects.title: snyvi
projects.summary: snyvi is a free, open-source desktop app for people building several passion projects at once with coding agents. Each project gets a desk: its folder, up to four agents side by side (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, any shell), and its own notes. Every plan or review an agent writes lands on that desk as a clean page, versioned. Home shows where each project was left. Local only, no account, MIT. Mac tester needed: the Mac build is signed and notarized, but we don't own a Mac. Try it and tell us.

projects.title: MacMetric
projects.summary: A private, native menu bar monitor for people who run dev servers, containers and local AI. Groups helper processes under their app, maps ports to projects, keeps 30 days of history, and never sends your data anywhere. 14-day free trial.

projects.title: inlaut
projects.summary: inlaut is a menu bar dictation app for the Mac. Hold a shortcut or the 🌐 key, speak, let go, and the text is pasted into whatever app you are in. Recognition runs entirely on your Mac, on the Neural Engine (NVIDIA Parakeet as Core ML), so it works offline and nothing is recorded or sent anywhere. It handles English, German and sentences that mix both. No account, no subscription. Free and open source (GPL-3.0). Needs Apple silicon and macOS 26.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】CoWork OS：执行前都由你批准的开源 AI 桌面应用
projects.author: AlmarionAI

github.name: CoWork-OS/CoWork-OS
github.description: Rent the model. Own everything else. Free, open-source AI app for real work.

projects.summary: CoWork OS 是我们开发的一款开源 AI 桌面应用（MIT 协议，支持 macOS 和 Windows）。它可以处理文件、文档表格和演示文稿，操作浏览器，整理邮件和日历，运行定时任务和聊天机器人。 和命令行智能体相比，它的重点是“看得见、管得住”：每一次工具调用都实时显示在任务时间线上；发送消息、联网、使用凭据、读写工作区以外的文件之前，都会弹出批准卡片，显示将要执行的完整命令，由你确认后才运行。 模型可以自己选：本地 Ollama、LM Studio，或 OpenRouter、Kimi、GLM、ChatGPT 账号等。首次任务可以通过 OpenRouter 的免费模型直接运行，不需要 API key。记忆以 Markdown 文件保存在本地 git 文件夹里，每次修改都是一次提交，可以直接打开查看和编辑。 最新的 0.5.61 版本还支持从 Hermes Agent 和 OpenClaw 一键迁移人设、记忆、技能和定时任务，导入前会先列出所有内容，不会修改原来的目录。 安装只需要一条命令，不会弹出系统安全拦截： macOS（Apple 芯片）：curl -fsSL | bash Windows（PowerShell）：irm | iex 其他系统 / Intel Mac：npm install -g cowork-os 应用界面目前是英文的，中文说明见 README.zh-CN。

projects.title: Snap2Paste
projects.summary: Snap2Paste is a privacy-first Chrome extension that captures the visible area or a full webpage and copies it straight to your clipboard—ready to paste into ChatGPT and other AI chats. You can also export captures as PNG or PDF.

projects.title: [开源推荐] Folkbench：AI 中转站实测榜单与一键切换客户端
projects.author: realMatthewhsu

projects.title: QuotaPanel：基于 Wails 的 AI 订阅额度管理工具
projects.author: ModStart
projects.summary: # 引言 在 AI 开发日益普及的今天，开发者需要同时管理 Claude 、ChatGPT 、GitHub Copilot 、Kimi 等多个平台的订阅与 API 额度。这些额度信息分散在各个控制台，难以快速掌握整体使用情况。 **QuotaPanel** 是一款开源的桌面端 AI 额度管理工具，基于 **Go + Wails + Vue3** 技术栈开发，支持 16 种 AI 订阅与 API 额度来源，本地优先保护隐私，跨平台支持 macOS/Windows/Linux 。 ![]( https://open-cdn.tecmz.com/theme/apps/quotapanel/images/account.png?t=202609261508) ## 核心特性 ### 本地优先设计 QuotaPanel 采用**本地优先**架构，所有账号密钥与浏览器会话数据均保存在本机（默认 `~/.quotapanel/`），不会上传到云端。数据目录支持通过 `QUOTAPANEL_DATA_ROOT` 环境变量自定义位置。 ### 多源额度聚合 工具支持 16 种 AI 订阅与 API 额度来源，分为两大类： **浏览器登录类**： - Claude 订阅（ 5 小时及每周额度） - ChatGPT/Codex （订阅使用窗口） - Cursor （当前周期用量） - Xiaomi MiMo Token Plan （套餐积分与账户余额） **API Key 类**： - GitHub Copilot （ Premium 、聊天与补全额度） - Z.ai Coding Plan 、Kimi Coding Plan 、MiniMax Token Plan - Devin/Windsurf 、Grok CLI 、OpenCode - Command Goat 、DeepSeek API 、Kimi API - OpenRouter 、OpenAI API ### 额度可视化 通过进度条、余额明细、账期/重置时间等可视化元素，系统提供正常、即将用尽、超限三档状态色，超出阈值时会主动提示。 ![]( https://open-cdn.tecmz.com/theme/apps/quotapanel/images/account-dark.png?t=202609261508) ## 技术架构 ### 技术栈 - **Go 1.24+**：后端核心逻辑与额度查询服务 - **Wails v2**：跨平台桌面应用框架 - **Vue3 + TypeScript**：前端界面开发 - **AntDesign Vue**：UI 组件库 - **TailwindCSS**：样式框架 - **SQLite**：本地数据存储 ### 项目结构 ``` quotapanel/ ├── main.go # Wails 应用配置与入口 ├── app*.go # App 暴露给前端的方法 ├── backend/ │ ├── base/ # 基础库（数据库、配置、日志、窗口、平台差异等） │ └── quota/ # 各额度供应商适配器与查询服务 ├── frontend/ │ └── packages/ │ ├── ui/ # 主界面（ Vue3 + AntDesignVue + TailwindCSS ） │ └── quota/ # 额度业务模块 ├── demo/image/ # 界面截图 ├── docs/ # 文档（额度来源调研等） └── Makefile # 开发、构建与发布命令 ``` ### 开发环境 - Go 1.24+ - Wails v2 - Node.js 20 + pnpm ```bash # 安装 Wails CLI go install github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/cmd/wails@latest # 安装 pnpm npm install -g pnpm ``` ### 开发命令 ```bash # 安装依赖 make install # 启动开发模式（前端热重载） make dev # 构建生产版本 make build # 构建并安装到 /Applications （ macOS ） make build-install ``` 修改 Go 暴露给前端的方法后，执行 `wails generate module` 重新生成 JS 绑定。 ![]( https://open-cdn.tecmz.com/theme/apps/quotapanel/images/account-card.png?t=202609261508) ## 功能亮点 ### 新增账号管理 支持选择来源并填写 API Key 或发起浏览器登录，可自定义账号名称与备注，密钥默认脱敏展示并支持一键复制。 ### 浏览器登录 需要网页登录的订阅（ Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor ）通过独立 Chrome/Edge 窗口登录，登录会话持久保存，删除账号时一并清理其浏览器资料。 ### 卡片截图 一键将单张订阅卡片导出为 PNG ，方便分享或记录。 ### 定时刷新 默认每 5 分钟自动轮询一次，额度变化实时可见。同时也支持随时手动刷新单个或全部账号。 ### 托盘常驻 macOS 菜单栏/Windows 、Linux 系统托盘，快捷显示、重启、退出。关闭窗口行为可配置为「每次询问/直接退出/隐藏到后台」。 ### 多语言支持 简体中文/English 切换，界面与后端文档页配色集中到设计 token 管理，支持浅色/深色两套取值。 ![]( https://open-cdn.tecmz.com/theme/apps/quotapanel/images/setting.png?t=202609261508) ## 总结 QuotaPanel 是一款功能完善、设计优雅的 AI 订阅额度管理工具，采用 **Go + Wails + Vue3** 技术栈，支持 16 种 AI 订阅与 API 额度来源。 **核心优势**： - ✅ **开源免费**：采用 Apache-2.0 许可证，可自由使用、修改和商用 - ✅ **跨平台支持**：macOS 、Windows 、Linux 全覆盖 - ✅ **隐私保护**：所有数据本地存储，不上传云端 - ✅ **持续更新**：社区活跃，支持新增额度来源 **适用人群**： - AI 重度用户，需要管理多个平台的订阅额度 - 开发者，希望参与开源项目或自定义额度来源 - 技术爱好者，对 Go/Wails/Vue3 技术栈感兴趣 如果你也是 AI 重度用户，或者需要管理多个平台的订阅额度，不妨试试 QuotaPanel 。让它成为你开发工作流中不可或缺的一部分。 > ⭐ 如果这个项目对你有帮助，请在 [GitHub]( https://github.com/open-tecmz/quotapanel) / [Gitee]( https://gitee.com/open-tecmz/quotapanel) 上点亮 Star 支持开发者！

Pandore brings your projects, tasks, calendar, documents and AI agents together in one desktop app for Mac and Windows, with separate Personal and Professional spaces. Run Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or a local model. Give a Mission a goal: Pandore plans, works, reviews and asks before anything sensitive. Local-first, free, no account.

projects.title: Hoistbay

Set header rules once (Cache-Control, Content-Type, Content-Encoding by file pattern) and they apply on every upload. Download whole folders, clear CloudFront cache in one click, and switch AWS accounts instantly. Keys stay in your OS keychain, no backend, no telemetry. MIT licensed.

projects.title: DocExplorer Pro
projects.summary: DocExplorer Pro is a desktop utility designed to search inside Word, PDF, Excel, PowerPoint, text, and scanned image files locally. Powered by an offline OCR engine, it offers deep keyword matching, advanced boolean search, and clean report exports without cloud dependencies.

projects.title: Clipboard Share
projects.summary: Open clipboardapp.org on two devices on the same Wi-Fi and they find each other automatically. No account, no app, no pairing code. Paste text or a screenshot, or drop files up to 5GB each; they appear on the other device with the sender's animal name tag. Sending an ID scan or a contract? Lock that file with a password: it is encrypted in your browser before upload, and only people with the password (or a one-file QR link) can open it. Files are cleaned up within a day. Open source.

projects.title: Show HN: Rouler – Steer Windows traffic per app or IP across multiple interfaces
projects.author: brndnbuilds
projects.summary: Hi HN, Rouler is "rules for your routes". It allows you to steer network traffic across multiple network interfaces on Windows. For example: - Run Tailscale, Mullvad and OpenVPN official clients simultaneously. - Use Rouler to send Slack via the OpenVPN connection, Chrome + an IP range via Tailscale and a torrent client via Mullvad. Rouler is VPN agnostic, so you can "split-tunnel" with anything that sets up a windows network interface. I'm an independent developer from Australia and have been working on Rouler for a bit over a year. It's been a challenging project to say the least, but I'm really happy with how it's turning out. I have spent a great deal of time building and throwing things away, starting over, belting the initial poc into something that I find intuitive... hopefully others do too! I've done all the testing, fixing and improving I can, so now it's open for public beta. I'd love to hear your feedback... and there are some specific points I'm interested in hearing about listed on the Rouler website. Please reply with any questions you might have. Thanks for reading! Brendan p.s. Rouler is "built in Rust" TM ;-) --- On AI (skip if you're sick of hearing about it): Since AI is the hot topic and people are naturally cautious about it, I'll add some quick notes about it, specifically about the driver development as that's the key thing to get right. The driver is hand written and every detail has been poured over many times over. I spent somewhere around 6-9 months manually building and testing just the driver, staring at Dbgview logs, wireshark logs, windows route tables, restarting VM's back to their snapshot and manually copying things across to start again. That's not always the most efficient way of doing things, but it's the way it had to be done. If I had tried to vibe code it Rouler simply wouldn't exist. I did try to lean on AI at times, but it constantly sent me in the wrong direction, told me things weren't possible, tried to take shortcuts and implement poor performing trade-offs. It also loved to hallucinate the windows api. Keep in mind this was around the Opus 4.1 - 4.6 days. Outside of the driver, in user mode land, AI has crept more and more into my workflow. I've had a lot of success utilising the latest models in the app in particular, and I purposefully separated the UI and core logic so I'm able to quickly iterate on the UI. I've also found AI very useful for scripting and refactoring. It has built some great scripts that would've taken me days or weeks to build and fine tune.

projects.summary: A free photo editor with layers that runs in your desktop browser. It opens and saves PSD files, opens JPG, PNG, WebP, TIFF, HEIC and RAW (Canon CR2, Nikon NEF, Sony ARW, DNG), and uses the same menus and shortcuts as Photoshop. No account, no ads.

projects.title: Moated
projects.summary: Moated is a menu bar focus timer for your Mac. Say what you’re working on, pick how long, and choose what to block. Distracting apps disappear and sites go blank until the session ends. Everything else can wait… and it should.

projects.title: Orby
projects.summary: Orby brings the convenience of notch-style desktop tools to Windows through a movable, customisable orb. Its standout feature is keeping one useful activity visible when the orb is closed: a focus timer, current music, or a supported AI coding tool’s reported usage allowance. AI Playground detects supported Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity installations, showing remaining allowances when those tools report them.

projects.title: CheckDiffs
projects.summary: Paste before & after — see what an AI rewrite actually changed. CheckDiffs is a free, in-browser side-by-side diff (Monaco). Built for vibe-coding and long chat refactors: jump hunks, merge lines, no account for basic compare, nothing uploaded for that flow. Not a PDF/Excel suite. Not “better than VS Code.” Just a simple standalone clipboard moment. Try it: https://checkdiffs.com Privacy: https://checkdiffs.com/privacy

projects.title: KeyShuttle
projects.summary: Apple's Magic Keyboard pairs with one computer at a time. KeyShuttle moves it between your Mac and your Windows PC with one shortcut – no re-pairing, no cables, no KVM. Shut one down and the keyboard follows. Local network only. 14-day free trial.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】Swivel：拖动文件时按一下 Shift，在 Mac 上离线转换格式
projects.author: jonathanlotan

github.name: jonathanlotan/Swivel
github.description: Free, open-source, offline file converter for macOS: drag files, tap a key, and convert, crop, compress or share them from a radial menu.

projects.summary: Swivel 我是作者。Swivel 是一款免费、开源（MIT）的 macOS 菜单栏工具：在 Finder 里拖动文件时，按一下 Shift，指针处就会弹出一个转盘，把文件放到某个格式上即可转换，结果保存在原文件旁边。 三个圆环：Shift 是格式转换（图片、视频、音频、文档、压缩包），Command 是工具（裁剪、缩放、压缩、去除元数据、OCR、抠图、合并/拆分 PDF），Control 是操作（隔空投送、查看元数据、复制路径等）。 完全离线：没有任何网络代码，测试会检查程序里没有链接网络 API；不需要辅助功能权限，不收集数据。 只用 macOS 自带的框架（ImageIO、AVFoundation、PDFKit、Vision），已签名并经过 Apple 公证。 附带命令行 swivel convert --to image.jpeg .heic，以及快捷指令动作。 支持 macOS 13 及以上、Apple 芯片。安装：brew install --cask jonathanlotan/tap/swivel 开源地址 · 在浏览器里试玩转盘 · 中文说明

projects.title: AirFliq
projects.summary: Open Apple's AirDrop panel in one move: a global shortcut, the menu bar, Finder's right-click menu, or a magnetic drop target beside your cursor. Files go through AirDrop itself, with no account and no servers. 5 free sends a day; Lifetime Pro is one purchase.

projects.title: Clipt
projects.summary: Record, trim, frame. Clipt is a free, open source screen recorder for Mac that stays out of your way. Pick your screen, a window or an area, and record. When you stop, a simple editor opens: trim, crop, add a background, padding, rounded corners or your camera. Export, and the MP4 is already on your clipboard. Every feature is free. No account, no watermark, no paid tier, and your recordings never leave your Mac. Export clean videos in seconds. Try it right in your browser.

projects.title: dartpilot
projects.summary: dartpilot turns your home dartboard into a smart board using everyday cameras and 3D-printed mounts. Desktop apps for macOS, Windows and Linux track every dart automatically. Play X01, Cricket, Killer, Shanghai, Bermuda Triangle, Hammer Cricket, Conquest, Gotcha and more. Ranked online X01 matches you with players at your level, you can host your own local tournaments, and Campaign mode pits you against bot rivals across game modes and difficulties.

projects.title: AirClip
projects.summary: AirClip is a private, universal clipboard that stores everything in your own Google Drive. No database, no middleman — copy on your phone, paste on your laptop.

projects.title: RibbonBridge
projects.summary: RibbonBridge brings Windows Alt-key shortcuts to Excel for Mac. Tap Option, type H O I, done – the same keys you learned on Windows.

projects.title: ArXivHub
projects.summary: ArXivHub is a free, open-source tool that makes researching arXiv papers easier. It brings together 116 curated resources across 12 categories, including AI explanations, translation, paper reading, code discovery, and citation tools. Simply enter an arXiv ID or use the Tampermonkey userscript to access these tools directly from arXiv pages. Customize your own shortcuts and streamline your research workflow—all in one place.

projects.title: ai-usage
projects.summary: A small open-source tool that shows what's left of your Claude Code, Codex and Grok limits on every machine you run, and whether it will last until the reset. No account, no config. Mac menu bar app included.

projects.title: Hawky
projects.summary: Run Claude Code in a few repositories at once and one of them will stop and wait, silently, in a window you are not looking at. Hawky keeps watch from the menu bar: it counts the sessions waiting for your permission, lists the ones waiting for your next prompt, and shows how many are still working. One click, or Ctrl-Option-H, brings that session's tab in Cursor or VS Code to the front, even behind merged macOS tabs. Approve or reply and it clears itself. Free and open source.

projects.title: [开源自荐] claude-carbon：在 Claude Code 里估算每次会话的碳排放
projects.author: gwittebolle

github.name: gwittebolle/claude-carbon
github.description: Track the carbon footprint of your Claude Code sessions, in the terminal and the Claude desktop app

projects.summary: claude-carbon 是一个开源的 Claude Code 插件，根据每次会话的 token 用量在本机估算碳排放（CO₂e），显示在终端状态栏和 Claude 桌面应用里，与按 API 价格折算的费用并列。会话记录保存在本地 SQLite 中，不上传数据。适合想了解自己使用 AI 编程助手的环境成本、想知道哪些用法最耗能的开发者。 亮点 在 Claude 桌面应用中，/carbon-panel 打开一个面板：颜色随本次会话的排放相对你的中位数变化，并显示所选时间段的用量和用你自己的会话画出的气候条纹 按模型和 token 类型（输入、缓存写入、缓存读取、输出）分别计算，方法论公开，每个排放因子都注明出处 无遥测，会话数据只留在本机 一条命令安装：npx claude-carbon

projects.title: TapeSnip
projects.summary: TapeSnip is a free, in-browser utility to blackout secrets, pixelate text, and blur PII from screenshots and multi-page PDFs with zero server uploads. Runs 100% in local browser memory (HTML5 Canvas + Wasm): • Zero Cloud Uploads: Files never leave your RAM • Multi-Page PDF redaction with interactive filmstrip & raster sealing • Instant Clipboard: Paste (Ctrl+V) & Copy (Ctrl+C) straight into Slack/Jira • 100% Free: No account, paywalls, or forced watermarks

projects.title: TileMyMac
projects.summary: TileMyMac is a scrolling window manager for macOS. Windows sit side by side in a row — open a new one and it joins beside the focused window; nothing gets covered or squeezed. Too many to fit? Slide the strip with a trackpad swipe or Control + Option shortcuts. Set up in a settings window (no config files). Built on the open-source Paneru engine. projects.title: Filo

Give each agent a name and a job, and message it like a teammate. Agents talk in group chats, @mention each other, show you a mock before they build, and hand bigger jobs to coding tasks that run in parallel. Ask them to fix a bug, build a dashboard or watch a rival's prices. A desktop pet shows who needs you. Free.

projects.title: PulseTiles

projects.title: [开源推荐] Command Reopen：让原生 Cmd+Tab 恢复最小化窗口的 Mac 工具
projects.author: Feng6611

projects.title: Show HN: Chest – a tiny, open-source menu bar manager for macOS 27
projects.author: a-ve
projects.summary: Hi HN! One of my favorite apps on macOS, Ice, stopped working when I updated to macOS 27 because the trick it relied on doesn't work anymore. The only thing I really needed from the app was the ability to hide menu bar items to the left of it, so I built Chest to do just that. There are other apps like this as well that try to use the menu bar part of macOS's exam mode to hide items, but that approach has some issues with the screen sharing, microphone, and camera indicators in the menu bar, which is rather troublesome for me. Chest works by emulating the "Allow in the Menu Bar" switches in System Settings rather than relying on the old trick of pushing menu bar items off-screen. It just needs Accessibility permission and access to two files that let it control which items are shown in the menu bar and where they're placed. You can hide items in two ways: by ⌘-dragging them to the left of a small dot in the menu bar, or by dropping them into a separate "Chest" that keeps them out of the menu bar entirely. Clicking the dot brings the hidden items back. I think our approach is rather cleaner, and the app itself sits at ~2 MB, so it's small enough to not matter while providing a clutter-free menu bar. You can view the source at https://github.com/boringbar/chest

projects.title: # 【開源自薦】13歲香港初中生，不看任何開源源碼，和 DeepSeek 從零手擼了一個非 Vibe Coding 的 64 位裸機 UEFI 操作系統：NeuroSamaOS
projects.author: Andrew-T-Davis
projects.summary: 大家好，我是來自香港的 13 歲初中生 NeuroSamaOS 是我和 DeepSeek 共同開發的 UEFI 操作系統（其中 DeepSeek 主要參與硬體規範文檔的翻譯與實現步驟的講解）它受到 TempleOS 啟發，但不基於任何現有內核，不看任何其他開源倉庫的代碼來開發這個項目，並且不是 TempleOS 的 Fork 這是一個裸機系統（废话，我标题都说过了），不喜欢盲目 Vibe Coding（第一我没Token（从来没充过），第二我是老一派的），完全由我閱讀规范他妈的一行一行地写出來，可以直接在實體機 CPU 上運行！（我跑了实体机一分钟，没崩，所有都正常，然后我关机继续开发NeuroSamaOS了） 代碼倉庫： 項目官網： 詳細討論 (OSDev Forum)： 下載體驗： 直接 git clone 倉庫是最好的選擇 目前已實現的功能 1. 內核架構與內存管理 Ring0：全系統運行在最高權限 Identical Mapping & La57：等同映射與現代 5 級分頁支持 KMalloc：內核級內存分配 Task：多任務調度 2. 中斷、高級控制與多核 I/O APIC & ACPI SIPI / IPI / INIT：實現多核初始化與處理器間中斷 MSI & INTx & MSI-X：現代中斷機制支持 CISC Instruction Length Parser：在 IDT 中實現的 CISC 指令長度解析器 3. 儲存與文件系統 SATA & AHCI 驅動 FDFD （FREEDOM DiSK[FOUR DIMENSIONS]，玩过OSU的都懂，XD,我爆发最高手速是270BPM(1/2)BTW） 硬盘格式 4. 輸入輸出與多媒體 GOP（圖形輸出協議）& WM（窗口管理器） GUI：已實現圖形界面（註：在我看來目前有點醜我追求美感而非單調，就像乔布斯那樣，後續會持續改進） HDAudio & AC97 & WAV & AMP：支持聲卡驅動與音訊播放 PS/2 鍵盤與滑鼠驅動 5. 現代 CPU 指令集優化 REP MOVS/STOS AVX256 & SSE1~SSE4.2 NT (Non-Temporal) 緩存優化與 FPU 支持 6. 內置 JIT 編譯語言 JIT 核心 通用AST引擎（我敢说这是我在我的生涯中弄过最牛逼的，没有之一，妈的） 7. 还在开发中的 HolyNeuro-JIT GPT 分區表支援 FAT32 & RedSea 文件系統支援 xHCI 驅動以及 xHCI 鍵盤 & 鼠標 支持 （这玩意儿是真难搞吧，我太多东西依赖PS/2了，等多我一个月！！！！！，我只差中断和设备PORT一直运作的逻辑就OK了） 開發狀態與後續計劃 考慮中的： E1000 / E1000E 乙太網路卡驅動 IwlWiFi 無線網路卡驅動 C99-JIT（將 C 語言從傳統的 AOT 改造成運行時 JIT 編譯執行） HolyC-JIT （这个要等HolyNeuro-JIT开发完才可以开始根据功能移植HolyC-JIT） 基於信仰原因在这个项目不能被加入的（我在其他项目可以，XD）（但歡迎大家 Fork 自行加入）： Ring3 用戶態 Non-Identical Mapping（非等同映射，也就是类似Linux和Windows的0xFFF800000000那套非常复杂的东西，因为我坚持不搞复杂所以这复杂玩意儿我没加） 已拋棄且不需要單獨寫的功能： eHCI & oHCI & uHCI（因為這三个早就他妈被Intel集成並兼容於 xHCI 中了） 我今年 13 歲，來自香港，我的信仰是 Terry A. Davis 和 TempleOS 歡迎來我的 GitHub 點個 Star、提交 Issue,但不接受PR,任何的PR我都会驳回

projects.summary: LokalBot 是一款免费开源的 macOS 应用，用本地 AI 记住你在工作中说过和看过的内容。它不需要机器人进会，直接录制麦克风和会议软件的声音，在本机完成转写，生成要点、决策和待办；还提供工作回顾、语音输入和系统级自动补全。所有模型都在 Mac 上运行，不需要账号，没有遥测。 亮点 隐私优先： 录音、转写和纪要默认都在本机完成，没有账号系统，也没有遥测，GPLv3 开源。 支持中文： 默认的 Qwen3-ASR 1.7B 支持 30 种语言和 22 种中文方言（包括粤语、吴语、闽南语、四川话等），中英混说也能识别；中文会议会生成中文纪要，每条要点和待办都能跳回原话的时间戳。 不止会议： Quick Recall 一次搜索会议转写和屏幕文字；按住快捷键即可语音输入；在任何应用里打字时，都有灰色的自动补全建议，按 Tab 接受。 开箱即用： 内置 llama.cpp 和 MLX 运行时，模型自动下载，不用配置模型服务器或 API Key；也支持 Ollama、OpenAI 兼容服务器和 Apple Intelligence。 面向开发者： 自带只读的 lokalbot-cli 和 MCP 服务器，Claude Code 等 AI 编程助手可以查询你的会议记录（默认关闭，需要手动开启）。

projects.title: 推荐免费工具：MiniToolDesk - 100% 浏览器本地运行、保护代码隐私的开发者工具箱
projects.author: Duxinghua
projects.summary: 工具名称 MiniToolDesk 访问地址 官网体验： 开源/主页： 为什么做这个工具？ 平时在写代码时，经常需要格式化 JSON、查时间戳、或者算个 MD5 哈希。但打开很多老牌在线工具站，往往扑面而来都是满屏闪烁的广告和弹窗，有些工具甚至会悄悄把敏感数据通过 POST 发送到第三方服务器处理。 特别是在大模型辅助编程时代，很多工程师会不自觉地把带有内部 API Key、JWT 凭证、数据库连接字符串的日志或代码直接喂给 ChatGPT / Claude，存在极大的企业数据泄露安全隐患。 因此我开发了 MiniToolDesk，核心理念只有一条：零服务端存储（Zero Server Storage），所有计算 100% 运行在用户本地浏览器内存中。 核心亮点与特色功能 1. AI 提示词敏感数据脱敏利器 (AI Prompt Sanitizer)： 自动检测并脱敏 OpenAI/Anthropic Key、JWT Token、数据库连接串、手机号和邮箱，替换为安全占位符； 支持本地双向解密还原：等 AI 返回生成的代码或分析结果后，在浏览器本地一键还原为真实密钥，防止企业机密泄露给大模型。 2. 纯前端 Web Crypto 硬件加速： SHA-256、SHA-512、MD5 计算与 AES 加解密完全调用现代浏览器原生 window.crypto.subtle API，断网离线状态下依然毫秒级响应，零字节网络传输。 3. 现代化代码生成矩阵： 支持 JSON 瞬间生成 Zod Schema、Go Struct、Python Pydantic、Rust Serde 以及 TypeScript Interface。 4. 桌面级纯净体验： 永久 0 广告、0 弹窗、无登录墙； 适配沉浸式暗黑/浅色毛玻璃界面，支持 PWA 离线安装及快捷键 Alt+M 侧边栏常驻。 支持平台 Web 端、Chrome / Edge 扩展插件、PWA（支持离线运行）。 欢迎阮老师及各位读者试用指正，希望能帮到经常跟代码打交道的开发者朋友们！

projects.title: Audio Selector

projects.title: Openbroca
projects.summary: Openbroca is a native Swift AI dictation app for Mac, with a ~6.5 MB download. Press a shortcut, speak naturally, and get clean text right where you're typing. It removes fillers and repetition while keeping your meaning and tone, with no prompt tweaking. Includes a personal dictionary that learns from corrections, Typeless dictionary import, and translation into 28 languages. All features are free to try.

projects.title: Sessions Pro for Codex

Each account becomes its own app, like "Codex Work" and "Codex Personal", with its own Dock icon, login, Codex threads, projects, pins and Codex CLI. Start from your current ChatGPT so nothing is lost, switch accounts from the menu bar, and every profile stays up to date when ChatGPT updates. Free 1-hour preview, then $24.99 one-time.

projects.title: MeetPaw
projects.summary: MeetPaw is a lightweight macOS menu-bar app that puts your meetings one click away. Spin up an instant Google Meet, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams link the moment you need it. The link is created, copied to your clipboard, and ready to share before you've switched windows. No tabs, no digging, no friction.

projects.title: ClipVe

ClipVe keeps up to 10 minutes of every live stream you have open, so you go back, trim it, crop it vertical, square or wide, and save a 1080p MP4 to your own disk. projects.title: Pomodoro Timer - Increase Focus
projects.summary: A beautiful focus timer that lives in your Mac's menu bar. Work in focused intervals, write a note about each session, and see where your hours really go. Lots of custimization like Theme appearance, Sound etc.

projects.title: SpotiBlocker

projects.title: Toolbit

projects.title: Show HN: Sill for Android – control your Mac's windows from an Android phone
projects.author: rahimnathwani
projects.summary: Sill (discussed here: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50112739 ) streams one Mac window, or the whole Desktop, to an iPhone or iPad and lets you control it by touch. It's open source, so I made an Android client for it. It's unofficial and not affiliated with Sill's author: it speaks Sill's existing protocol, so the Mac side is the stock Sill app, unchanged. Install Sill on the Mac, sideload the APK from Releases onto an Android 11+ phone on the same Wi-Fi, tap your Mac in the list that shows on your phone, then look for the 12-digit code in Sill on your Mac, and type it into the Android app. Then: tap to click, drag to scroll, hold-and-drag to select text or move windows, pinch to zoom the picture on the phone, a Draw toggle for whiteboard apps like tldraw, and a key row with Esc, Tab, Cmd/Ctrl/Option/Shift and arrows. It also works over Tailscale with Sill's Remote Access. All of the code was written by Claude Code, working from Sill's Swift source and its Python test client; I tested it on a Pixel 9 Pro XL. Not done yet: drawing the Mac's pointer, a trackpad mode, clipboard sync, and a Play Store listing (I don't have Play developer account, and new individual Play developer accounts can't publish their first app until they've tested an app with a closed test with 12 testers.) (There's also a separate Android client in draft PR #89 on Sill's repo. This one is a standalone app with an installable APK. I should have checked the issues/PRs before I asked Claude to build this...)

projects.title: Show HN: Putaway – sorts your Mac's Downloads into the folders you have
projects.author: yashrajpandey
projects.summary: My Downloads folder is full of files like download (3).pdf, IMG_4821.jpg, and Untitled.docx. I already have folders for them in Documents. I never move them because I have to open each file to know what it is. Putaway does that part. It reads the start of each file on your Mac: PDF text, OCR for scans and photos, Word, Excel, CSV, and HTML. Then it picks one of the folders you already have. It never makes new folders. It shows you the plan first. Nothing moves until you click Move, and Undo puts everything back. Demo (this run uses a SubQ key, so some files are ready to move): https://github.com/devYRPauli/putaway/blob/main/docs/demo.gi... You choose the model. The default is Apple Intelligence on your Mac. It is free, and nothing leaves your Mac. You can also use your own model through any OpenAI-compatible server, such as Ollama or LM Studio. Or you can add your own SubQ or Jev API key. Those two give a probability for each folder, so Putaway moves the files they are sure about. With Apple or your own model, you confirm each file. I tested the released build on 107 files with messy names: public IRS forms, papers, receipts, photos, and spreadsheets, plus fake secret files and a partial download. There were 19 target folders, including decoy folders that apps make, such as Zoom and Adobe. Files in an acceptable folder: SubQ 88%, Jev 85%, qwen2.5 7B in Ollama 82%, Apple's on-device model 67% (of the 99 files it agreed to read). When SubQ or Jev moved a file on its own, it was right 132 of 136 times. One surprise: Apple's on-device model refused to read three blank government forms, including the IRS 1040, as unsafe content. Putaway leaves those files in place and tells you why. It never reads files with names like .env, id_rsa, or recovery-codes.txt. If a file's text looks like a private key or a token, it does not send it. It never overwrites a file, and it skips downloads that are not complete. Install (Apple Silicon, macOS 26). The install script is 33 lines, so you can read it first: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/devYRPauli/putaway/main/install.sh | bash brew install devyrpauli/tap/putaway It is a Swift menu bar app and a CLI, MIT-licensed, with no dependencies. I do not pay for an Apple developer account, so the app is not notarized. The curl and brew installs do not show the Gatekeeper prompt. I want to know which files it puts in the wrong folder, and which file types it misses. Keynote, Pages, and pptx files are filed by name only for now.

projects.title: 【工具自荐】DisplayPilot：Mac 外接显示器 DDC/CI 失灵时，用伽马表接管亮度（付费，有 14 天全功能试用）
projects.author: huayanming
projects.summary: 下载： 自荐一个 macOS 桌面工具 DisplayPilot。它解决的是外接显示器最常见、也最容易被误判的一个问题：Mac 调不动显示器的亮度，但显示器自己的按键是好的。 原因是 DDC/CI（视频线 I²C 侧通道上的控制命令）在某一环断了——显示器 OSD 里没开、扩展坞不转发、主动式转接线丢了侧通道，或者面板根本没实现。画面一切正常，只有控制失灵。 DisplayPilot 的做法是两条腿： DDC/CI 可用时走硬件，控制亮度、音量、输入源； 不可用时自动改用 CoreGraphics 伽马表调光——画面由 GPU 生成、经伽马表整形才到面板，往表里写一条压暗曲线就能调暗，完全不依赖 DDC。界面上会明确标注「DDC 无应答」，不假装成功。 代价我也写在官网上，没有藏：伽马表压的是画面不是背光，省电不如硬件调光，压不到纯黑，且对 HDR 内容无效（HDR 绕过伽马环节）。 另外两块能力： 色彩校准：对比度、伽马、色温都以面板原始曲线为基准重算，而不是在当前状态上叠加，所以反复调节不会累积误差，一键交回 ColorSync； 缓存清理：只处理 13 类有确定性重建路径的产物，删除前先移入隔离区保留 30 天，永久删除默认关闭。 关于收费，说清楚：这是付费软件，一次性买断，没有订阅，提供 14 天功能完整的试用，不需要注册账号。激活码本地离线验签，应用不做遥测、不做埋点，除了检查更新（默认关闭）外不主动联网。 官网还写了两篇排查向的长文，不是广告： Mac 外接显示器 DDC/CI 无响应 macOS 开发者缓存清理：哪些能删、哪些删了就出事 我是这个工具的开发者本人，产品相关的技术细节（DDC/IOAVService、伽马表插值、跨卷隔离）都乐意在这里回答。

projects.summary: 项目： 我是 Glim 的作者，想推荐一下这个 MIT 开源的 Mac 文件查看器。 用 Agent 做项目后，经常要看它产出的源码、说明文档、图表、表格和 PDF，每种文件都去开一个应用挺麻烦的。Glim 想解决的就是这件事：一个工作区打开本地文件夹，切换查看不同格式。 目前可以预览 Markdown（含支持的图表和公式）、PDF、Office 文档、图片、JSON、CSV 和源码。普通 UTF-8 文本能做基础编辑、自动保存；也能查看 Git 差异，暂存或取消暂存，并提交已暂存的内容。PDF、Office 为只读预览，不是完整办公编辑器。 使用 Rust + GPUI Kit，部分文档读取器使用 macOS 原生能力，支持 Apple Silicon 和 Intel。项目还很年轻，当前稳定版为 v0.2.3，欢迎试用和反馈格式兼容问题。 下载： 各格式支持范围： 架构说明： 安装包尚未经过 Apple 公证，首次启动要求见 README。没有性能跑分或完整格式兼容性的保证。截图中的示例文档来自公开的 12-factor-agents 项目，文字与插图归原项目所有。

projects.title: Transel - 开源一个使用 rust + gpui-kit 做了个跨平台的划词翻译项目
projects.author: pannanxu
projects.summary: ![Imgur]( https://i.imgur.com/GmbZb9J.png) ![Imgur]( https://i.imgur.com/KfxENID.png) # Transel 跨平台划词翻译工具。选中文字后按下热键，译文显示在鼠标附近的浮窗中。 支持 macOS 、Windows 、Linux 。可同时对照多个翻译接口，并提供截图 OCR 、静默替换、历史与收藏。日常以系统托盘常驻。 ## 介绍 Transel 面向阅读与写作时的即时翻译：在浏览器、编辑器或其它应用中划词，用全局热键唤出结果，而不必切换到翻译网站。 - 划词翻译：读取当前选区（文本、图片或文本文件） - 多通道对照：多家接口并行出结果 - 截图识别：框选屏幕区域后 OCR ，可选翻译或只复制文字 - 静默替换：将译文写回选区或当前输入框 - 密钥保存在系统钥匙串，配置文件不保存明文 默认目标语言为简体中文，可在设置中修改。新安装默认仅启用系统翻译（ macOS 为 Apple 翻译，其它平台为 Google 免费）；其它接口在设置中点「添加」后再配置。 ## 功能 | | | |---|---| | 划词翻译 | 默认 `Alt+D`（ macOS 为 Option+D ），浮窗显示原文与译文 | | 输入翻译 | 弹出输入框，回车翻译 | | 截图 OCR | RapidOCR ，以及火山 / 腾讯 / 百度 / 有道 / Google 云识别；腾讯图片翻译 | | 原图翻译 | 在截图上标出识别区域并翻译 | | 静默替换 | 译文写回选区或输入框全文；指针旁可停止当前任务 | | 翻译接口 | 机器翻译（ Apple 系统翻译、DeepL 、Google 、微软、Amazon 、百度、有道、阿里、火山、彩云、小牛 Flash / Pro 等）与 LLM 通道（ OpenAI / Azure / Claude / Gemini / 智谱 / DeepSeek / 通义 / 豆包 / Kimi / Ollama 等） | | 词典 | 英语单词：音标、词性、例句 | | 朗读 | 系统 TTS ，以及火山 / 腾讯 / Google / Microsoft 云语音 | | 历史 / 收藏 | 应用内搜索 | | 托盘 | 设置、历史、输入翻译、截图 OCR 、固定浮窗、退出 | ### 默认快捷键 Windows / Linux 上 `Cmd` 对应 **Ctrl**。可在设置中修改；将按键留空即取消注册。 | 功能 | 快捷键 | |---|---| | 翻译选区 | Alt+D | | 截图翻译 | Alt+F | | 截图 OCR （不翻译） | Shift+Alt+S | | 静默 OCR （只写入剪贴板） | Alt+C | | 输入翻译 | Cmd+Shift+I | | 朗读选区 | Cmd+Shift+R | | 历史 | Cmd+Shift+H | | 设置 | Cmd+, | | 固定 / 取消固定浮窗 | Cmd+Shift+P | | 原图翻译 | Alt+Shift+O | | 收藏夹 | Cmd+Shift+F | | 静默划词替换 | Alt+S | | 静默输入框替换 | Alt+A | 关闭当前窗口：`Esc` 或 `Cmd+W`。macOS 退出应用：`Cmd+Q`。 ## 安装 从 [Releases]( https://github.com/pannanxu/transel/releases) 下载对应平台的安装包。 ### macOS 1. 下载 `Transel- -aarch64-apple-darwin.dmg`（ Apple 芯片）或 `Transel- -x86_64-apple-darwin.dmg`（ Intel ）。 2. 打开磁盘映像，将 Transel 拖入「应用程序」。之后可用聚焦（ Spotlight ）或启动台搜索「 Transel 」。 3. 打开 **系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 辅助功能**，启用 Transel 。若从终端启动，请授权「终端」或 iTerm ，然后完全退出并重新打开。未授权时无法读取选区。 若提示「已损坏，无法打开」或无法打开未验证的开发者应用：这是 Gatekeeper 拦截未公证的下载包，不是文件真的坏了。在终端执行： ```bash xattr -cr /Applications/Transel.app ``` 然后再次打开。从浏览器下载的 DMG 也会带隔离属性，可先对磁盘映像执行 `xattr -cr ~/Downloads/Transel-*.dmg` 再打开。 ### Windows 安装 `Transel- -x86_64.msi`，或解压 zip 后运行 `transel.exe`。 以管理员身份运行的窗口，需以相同权限运行 Transel ，否则可能无法读取选区。 ### Linux Debian / Ubuntu： ```bash sudo dpkg -i transel_ _amd64.deb ``` 或使用 AppImage： ```bash chmod +x Transel- -x86_64.AppImage ./Transel- -x86_64.AppImage ``` 建议： - 安装托盘支持（ GNOME 需 AppIndicator 扩展） - Wayland 下全局热键通常仅对 XWayland 窗口有效；划词依赖 `wl-clipboard`，交互截图依赖 `grim` 与 `slurp` - 需要稳定热键时，优先使用 X11 会话 ### 配置翻译接口 启动后通过托盘打开「设置」，启用所需接口并填写 API Key 。OpenAI 兼容通道（智谱、硅基流动、Groq 、Ollama 等）已预置地址与默认模型。密钥写入系统钥匙串（ macOS Keychain 、Windows 凭据管理器、Linux Secret Service ）。云 OCR / TTS 也可使用环境变量，例如 `TENCENT_SECRET_ID`、`VOLCANO_ACCESS_KEY`、`GOOGLE_OCR_API_KEY`、`VOLCANO_TTS_TOKEN`。 配置文件位置： | 平台 | 路径 | |---|---| | macOS | `~/Library/Application Support/dev.transel/config.json` | | Windows | `%APPDATA%\dev.transel\config.json` | | Linux | `~/.config/dev.transel/config.json` | 命令行工具 `transel-cli`： ```text transel-cli config show transel-cli config set target zh-CN transel-cli history search transel-cli backend list ``` 临时覆盖 OpenAI 兼容接口（明文，仅建议调试使用）： ```bash export TRANSLATE_API_BASE=https://api.deepseek.com/v1 export TRANSLATE_API_KEY=sk-xxx export TRANSLATE_MODEL=deepseek-chat ``` ### 从源码构建 需要 Rust 1.88 或更高版本。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/pannanxu/transel cd transel cargo run --release ``` **macOS**：安装 Xcode Command Line Tools （`xcode-select --install`）。 **Windows**：安装 Visual Studio Build Tools ，并勾选「使用 C++ 的桌面开发」。 **Linux**（ Debian / Ubuntu ）： ```bash sudo apt install build-essential pkg-config cmake clang \ libxkbcommon-dev libxkbcommon-x11-dev libwayland-dev libvulkan-dev mesa-vulkan-drivers \ libx11-xcb-dev libxcb1-dev libxcb-randr0-dev libxcb-xfixes0-dev libxcb-shape0-dev \ libfontconfig-dev libfreetype-dev libssl-dev libzstd-dev \ libgtk-3-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev libxdo-dev libxi-dev libxtst-dev \ espeak-ng wl-clipboard grim slurp maim gnome-screenshot ``` 在本机生成安装包： ```bash # macOS / Linux bash packaging/package.sh --build # Windows （ PowerShell 7+） pwsh packaging/package.ps1 -Build ``` 产物位于 `dist/`。推送 `v*` 标签时，CI 会构建 macOS （ arm64 / x86_64 ）、Windows x86_64 与 Linux x86_64 并发布到 Releases 。 ## 许可 本项目采用 [MIT]( https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT) 许可证。

projects.title: DevFeed
projects.summary: DevFeed turns your new tab into a home for developer news. Combine daily.dev recommendations, RSS feeds, and your favorite tech blogs in one clean reading experience. Enjoy a built-in reader, keyboard shortcuts, unread tracking, favourites, customizable themes, and weather. Switch between a three-column reader and a full-width grid. Free, open source, and privacy-first: your settings and reading history stay in your browser. No custom backend or tracking analytics.

projects.title: Docktopus
projects.summary: Docktopus brings window previews, clipboard history, and widgets to your Mac’s dock. Add a Dynamic Island (no notch needed), track your day with Time Spent, search past screen captures with Remembrance, and control each app’s volume with the audio mixer. Includes dev server tools, a color picker, Coffee, and more, with Liquid Glass, CDE, and Windows 95 themes. Activity history and text recognition stay on your Mac.

projects.title: cornercase
projects.summary: A fast terminal multiplexer for coding agents. Turn GitHub, GitLab, Linear, Jira, Plane or Shortcut issues into running Claude Code, Codex or Gemini agents in a click. Each agent gets its own git worktree and tab. See which agent needs you, review the diff as it's written, and close the window: they keep running Away from your desk? Continue from your phone or on Telegram. Everything works with clicks. Really fast: 34 ms launch, 53 MB RAM. Free and open source. Linux and macOS.

projects.title: CopyTap - [CMD] [C] like never before.
projects.summary: CopyTap gives your Mac three clipboard slots using the copy and paste shortcuts you already know. Undo your last 'copy' if you accidentally copied over something important. It's not just another 'clipboard'. No long history. No need to open a separate UI. Windows version is also available - I'm not a monster. Lifetime purchase, No subscriptions! Currently on launch offer! Support me so I can feed my dog and buy some fuel to drive to the pet store.

projects.title: ClipBook 2
projects.summary: ClipBook 2 is a keyboard-first clipboard manager for Mac, rebuilt from scratch in Swift. Copy several things, then paste them in the same order without ever opening the history window. Native, fast, private: everything stays on your Mac.

projects.title: Atticus
projects.summary: Hold a shortcut, say what you want, let go. Atticus opens apps, shops for you, fills out forms and answers questions about what's on your screen. It asks before it buys or sends anything. Simple asks run instantly with no AI, and the rest run on your own Claude plan. Free and open source.

projects.title: DraftKey
projects.summary: DraftKey is a native Mac app that brings private, on-device AI autocomplete and instruction-based rewriting into most Mac apps: tap ⌘+⌥, review the change, then insert it. The model runs locally and works offline after setup, so your text is never sent to a cloud AI. It also includes ⌘⌥V clipboard history saved only on your Mac and optional mechanical keyboard sounds (requires Apple Silicon, macOS 14+, 8 GB RAM).

projects.title: MyPhotoCraft
projects.summary: MyPhotoCraft is an independent, unofficial resource hub for the open-source PhotoCraft editor. It brings official GitHub downloads, platform-specific installation steps, a searchable Windows/Linux and macOS shortcut guide, and a practical PhotoCraft vs. Photoshop comparison into one place. Every download points directly to the official release—we do not mirror or repackage installers.

projects.title: GoodsTracker
projects.summary: GoodsTracker is the all-in-one inbound logistics platform for warehouse teams. Replace clipboards and Excel sheets with real-time audio/visual alerts, Dock-to-Stock SLA tracking, automated damage claim PDFs, and an internal PO lookup portal.

projects.title: Fubble VPN
projects.summary: Fubble VPN is a freemium VPN from LUNEXLAB OÜ with a free tier that actually works — not a teaser that dies on day one. Key features: • One-tap connect and server picker • Bring-your-own config (QR, clipboard, or manual) • Flexible sign-in • Free tier for everyday privacy on public Wi‑Fi • Premium for more locations and capacity ($6/mo or $30/6 mo) • iOS, Android, and Windows Built for people who want a clear Free → Premium path without dark patterns.

projects.title: Whipback
projects.summary: Mac menu bar app for Claude Code and Codex. Ignore your agent and a whip cracks across your screen. Slap an idle agent and it types “Continue.” First 100 free.

projects.title: YT1S.video — YouTube Video Downloader
projects.summary: YT1S.video is an online YouTube downloader and creator toolkit designed to make everyday video tasks easier. It offers video and audio download options, thumbnail retrieval, and useful creator tools for tags, metadata, transcripts, subtitles, and content research. With a browser-based workflow, YT1S.video brings multiple YouTube-related utilities together in one convenient place, without requiring a traditional desktop application.

projects.title: Festival Lights · Holiday lights for Mac
projects.summary: A string of glowing lights under your Mac’s menu bar. Pumpkins, ghosts and bats for Halloween, twinkle lights for Christmas, lanterns for Lunar New Year, even fruit. Click-through, near-zero CPU, every display. Free.

projects.title: Deskthaw
projects.summary: A free Mac menu bar app in public beta. It waits while your camera or mic is on, a meeting app is in front, or something is fullscreen, then offers one move for your neck, shoulders or lower back, done sitting, a minute or less.

projects.title: Wisp
projects.summary: Wisp turns your MacBook notch (or the top, left or right edge of any screen) into a live Dynamic Island. Now Playing for Spotify, Apple Music and YouTube, each glowing in its own color, with the actual YouTube video inside the island. Telegram messages drop in as Liquid Glass bubbles. Official prayer times with reminders, timer, clipboard history, file shelf, volume/brightness HUD. Follows your external monitor. Mac + Windows. One-time purchase, no account.

projects.title: Desk Goblin
projects.summary: A Mac menu bar app that reminds you to stand up, stretch and move. Ignore it and a tiny goblin comes looking for you. $4.99 launch price, paid once.

projects.title: Clip'M
projects.summary: Clip’M is a free, open-source clipboard manager for Apple silicon Macs. Open history with ⌥⌘V, search text or filter images, preview clips, organize snippets, and transform text before pasting. Built on ClipMenu. Requires macOS 14+.

projects.title: Tasklo
projects.summary: Tasklo is a fast, clean interface for your Apple Reminders on iPhone and Mac. Type a natural sentence and it detects date, time and list on-device. Includes a weekly view with drag & drop, subtasks, repeats, widgets, Siri & Shortcuts and a morning summary. No account, no server, no ads, no tracking: your data stays with Apple. One-time €2.99, no subscription.

projects.title: Show HN: I think Apple should have built this a long time ago
projects.author: zacattackjuice
projects.summary: Built this little tool a while ago and shared it with a few friends. The feedback I got was great that I decided to release it publicly. It's not just another 'clipboard'... Honestly, would love you guys to try it out! This is my first public release of a product with a price tag! I have 0 expectations for it... but I genuinely love using it myself.

projects.title: [开源自荐] TokenFlow：统计 AI 编程用量，生成自动更新的 README／博客卡片
projects.author: caopulan

github.name: Renaissance-Mind/TokenFlow
github.description: Track Token Flow. Record AI usage at the source, then turn token flow into cost, rhythm, and role insight.

projects.summary: 大家好，我是 TokenFlow 的作者，想自荐一个面向 AI 编程用户的用量统计与展示工具。 同时使用 Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI 等工具，又在几台电脑之间切换，用量记录往往很分散。TokenFlow 在本机读取 Agent 日志，按工具、模型和时间汇总 token 与估算费用，再把多设备统计放到同一个看板中。 其中一个核心功能是生成自动更新的 AI 用量卡片。复制 Markdown 图片或 HTML 嵌入代码，就可以把用量总览、趋势或热力图放进 GitHub README、个人主页或博客。新增用量同步后，同一个卡片链接会呈现更新后的数据，省去手动截图和替换图片的过程，适合展示个人 AI 编程活动和使用习惯。 TokenFlow 提供桌面端、CLI 和网页看板。桌面端可在菜单栏／系统托盘查看当天用量，未登录也能查看本地统计；需要多设备汇总时可以开启同步。提示词、回复正文、会话 ID 和源文件路径保留在本地，上传的是使用量元数据。未知价格的模型仍统计 token，并标记未计价。费用按模型定价估算，可用于观察使用趋势。

projects.title: Vemoir
projects.summary: Vemoir records meetings from your Mac's menu bar. No bot joins the call. It transcribes on-device, groups meetings into projects that share context, and turns each call into minutes, decisions, action items and follow-ups from export-ready templates. Ask Vemoir answers questions and links back to the transcript. Nothing is uploaded by default. Launch price: $22.99 one-time for the first 200 buyers on the Mac App Store. No subscription.

projects.title: S3 Explorer
projects.summary: The S3 browser desktop client for S3-compatible storage. Browse, edit and navigate millions of objects across all your buckets. Windows, macOS, Linux.

projects.title: Walk Mate
projects.summary: Walk Mate now works with iPhone Duo and Siri AI, Shortcuts, Spotlight, and Apple Intelligence (App Intents). Save a walk once - then start a new loop or reopen a favorite without hunting through the app. Ask Siri • "Generate a route in Walk Mate" or "Make me a walk in Walk Mat ' creates fresh walking loops near you. In Shortcuts you can also set a distance first. • "List my walks in Walk Mate" - Siri names your saved favorites and shows tappable cards.

projects.title: MemStats
projects.summary: Free, open-source menu bar app for macOS that splits RAM by user account, groups helper processes into their apps, and shows memory pressure, swap, and a short history. Built for shared Macs, light enough for any Mac. No network, no tracking

projects.title: NotchMind
projects.summary: NotchMind turns your Mac notch into a home for everyday tools. New since launch: live Claude Code and Codex activity, a shake-to-open file Basket, customizable Home pages, searchable clipboard history, global shortcuts, call controls and a floating music player. Works on notchless displays too. Native macOS app for Apple silicon, macOS 15+. Pay once: $7.99 for 1 Mac, $12.99 for 2, or $19.99 for 5. All 1.x updates included. No subscription.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】请旨 Ask Key：给 AI 用的 Mac 密钥管家
projects.author: sudoHG

github.name: sudoHG/AskKey
github.description: Ask Key: the Mac key manager for AI agents. API keys stay encrypted on your Mac; Claude Code, Codex and Cursor find them over MCP, you approve each use, and the value goes only to the program, never to the AI. | 请旨：给 AI 用的 Mac 密钥管家。AI 自己找得到密钥，普通密钥直接放行，敏感密钥由你审批，密钥只交给目标程序，AI 看不到明文。

projects.summary: 请旨（Ask Key）是我开发的一款 macOS 菜单栏应用，用来管理 AI 编程助手要用的密钥。 用 Claude Code、Codex 这类 Agent 干活，迟早要给它密钥：部署要 token，登服务器要密码。常见做法是把密钥贴进对话，或者写在 .env 里，结果密钥会明文留在对话记录和日志里。我统计过自己的记录：家里 NAS 和 Mac mini 共用的一个密码，在 20 个 AI 对话里明文出现了 1483 次。 请旨换了一条路。密钥加密存在本机，Agent 通过 MCP 只能看到密钥的名字和用法说明，看不到值。它要用时，通过请旨运行命令；敏感密钥会弹窗请示，写明是哪个 Agent、要运行什么命令，你可以选「允许本次」「允许 30 分钟」或「拒绝」。批准后，密钥作为环境变量或临时文件，只交给那一条命令。批一次 30 分钟，同一台 Mac 上的多个 Agent 都能直接用。 能存 API Key、token、密码，也能存 SSH 私钥、.p8、PEM 这类文件，支持导入 .env。Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Grok Build 一键接入，其他支持 MCP 的客户端可以手动配置。 请旨免费，MIT 协议开源，安装包经过 Apple 公证，中文界面，需要 Apple 芯片的 Mac、macOS 14 或更高版本。 主页：

projects.title: SweepKit
projects.summary: SweepKit is a free, native Mac menu bar app that helps you clean up messy Downloads and Desktop folders. It previews files and lets you sort or trash them in seconds using quick number keys.

projects.title: Show HN: Impetus – I turned my MPE keyboard into a DAW control surface
projects.author: gregsmith4000
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm a sound editor and composer. I had an MPE (MIDI Polyphonic Expression) keyboard sitting on the desk in front of me and not enough space for a DAW control surface. The MPE keys to me were about the same size as a mixing board fader, and operated on the same y-axis gesture, so I decided to see if I could make the translation. About a year later, I have an 8-channel control surface running on HUI or Mackie Control with all major functions, including a system wide keyboard shortcut and macro engine. The crucial part was getting the keys to respond like a real fader, starting in the right position when touched and not introducing jumps or jitters into the mix. The result is really smooth control though, and it works better than I originally imagined it would. It's macOS only for now, and works with ROLI Seaboard models and KMI K-board Pro. It should also work with Haken Continuum, but is not tested. DAWs tested and confirmed: Pro Tools, Logic Pro, Cubase, Studio One, Reaper, Ableton Live and Digital Performer, plus video editors using the same protocols, such as DaVinci Resolve's Fairlight page. I would love any feedback, especially if you own any of these devices and can try it out. There's a free trial. Thanks!

projects.title: 【开源自荐】StockBar：把行情放进菜单栏的开源盯盘小工具
projects.author: Garretqaq

github.name: Garretqaq/stock-bar
github.description: 把行情放在菜单栏，随时掌握市场动态。macOS 菜单栏 / Windows 悬浮行情条的 A 股盯盘小工具：实时价格、涨跌幅、分时图抬眼就能看，不占 Dock。Tauri 2 + 原生 TypeScript

projects.summary: 项目：StockBar | 平台：macOS / Windows / Linux | 许可：MIT | 最新版本：v0.0.6 它是什么 一个把行情放进菜单栏的开源盯盘小工具，Tauri 2 + Rust + 原生 TypeScript。 盘中想瞄一眼自选，又不想一直开着完整的行情软件 —— 那类软件占地方、还显眼。StockBar 把常看的几只留在菜单栏，点一下展开指数、自选和分时图，看完就收起。macOS 上不占 Dock；Windows 托盘放不下文字，就另外给一条可拖动的悬浮行情条。 界面是真的轻：不用 UI 框架、不用图表库，列表是原生 DOM 拼的，分时图是 canvas 一笔一笔画的。数据走东方财富的公开接口，失败时自动切到腾讯，所以不用注册、不用 API Key。 功能详解 📌 抬眼就能看见 菜单栏常驻，最多放 3 个标的。三种样式：单行文字、双行紧凑、仅图标 —— 双行是 canvas 按 2x 绘制的 PNG，两张一行摆得下名称、价格和涨跌幅。名称、价格、涨跌幅可以各自开关，顺序也能拖。 📊 分时图与成交额 点指数卡片或自选行就展开当天的分时，再点一次收起。内置上证、深证成指、创业板指；大盘指数的分时多取一天，用来算「与上一日同期」的成交额对比，个股则是单日。 🗂️ 自选与分组 搜索支持代码、名称和拼音；置顶、拖动排序、自定义分组都在。分组多了筛选条会横向滑动，末尾的 ☰ 把全部分组摊成一片标签，带每组的自选数量，点一下就切过去。加入菜单栏、移入分组、删除都支持批量。 菜单栏常驻，最多放 3 个标的。三种样式：单行文字、双行紧凑、仅图标 —— 双行是 canvas 按 2x 绘制的 PNG，两行摆得下名称、价格和涨跌幅。名称、价格、涨跌幅可以各自开关，顺序也能拖。 自带零依赖的 MCP 服务（11 个工具），支持 MCP 的 AI 客户端可以按你的话操作： 「新建一个『持仓』分组，把宁德时代加进去并置顶。」 「把苹果和英伟达移到『观察』分组。」 命令通过本机 127.0.0.1 上的随机端口交给应用执行，走的是和手点界面完全相同的校验与同步规则，界面会立刻跟着变。这一步默认关闭，需要时到设置里拨开。 ⚙️ 按自己的习惯来 跟随系统 / 浅色 / 深色主题，红涨绿跌 / 绿涨红跌，3 / 5 / 10 / 30 秒刷新，报价与分时可固定用东方财富或腾讯。安装后能在「关于」页检查更新、一键升级。 两个平台各长什么样 macOS 是自绘窗口控件的菜单栏小窗（360×560），Windows 走平台布局：托盘 + 桌面悬浮行情条，托盘图标随任务栏深浅自动着色。 技术栈 | 部分 | 选型 | | --- | --- | | 桌面外壳 | Tauri 2、Rust | | 界面 | 原生 TypeScript、Vite、canvas（无 UI 框架、无图表库） | | 数据 | 东方财富公开接口，失败时自动切腾讯 | | MCP | 零依赖 stdio JSON-RPC 服务 + Rust 侧本地 HTTP 桥 | | 测试 | Vitest（前端纯逻辑 + MCP 脚本，含一条起进程的端到端用例） | 快速开始 macOS 与 Windows 都有现成安装包（Linux 暂无官方预编译包，可从源码运行）： 下载： 从源码跑，需要 Node.js 22+、pnpm、Rust stable 和对应平台的 Tauri 2 开发依赖： bash git clone cd stock-bar pnpm install pnpm app:dev 只想看界面的话 pnpm dev 即可，浏览器里 Tauri 调用会降级为空操作。 需要说清楚的几件事 macOS 安装包暂未签名与公证，首次打开请右键「打开」，或 xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/StockBar.app。 交易状态按市场时区和报价里的最后成交时间推断，没有节假日日历，开盘前无法提前判定当天是否休市。 行情来自公开接口，刷新频率不代表交易所级实时性；覆盖范围以数据源返回为准。 项目还很年轻（v0.0.6），用着顺手或者踩到坑，都欢迎来 Issues 说一声。觉得有用的话，点一颗 Star 就是最大的鼓励 ⭐️

projects.title: Fuzio
projects.summary: Fuzio is a Chromium-based browser component for Java and Kotlin desktop apps, adapted for China’s Linux-based operating systems and local CPUs, including LoongArch, Kunpeng, Phytium, and Hygon. It lets you embed web applications into desktop software, provides control over browser networking and SSL/TLS certificate handling, and comes with built-in communication with Google services removed.

projects.title: 【工具自荐】1Capture：面向高频反馈者的 Mac 原生精美截图录屏工具
projects.author: macing
projects.summary: 大家好，自荐一个我们开发的面向高频反馈者的 Mac 原生精美截图录屏工具 1Capture。

projects.title: Klip
projects.summary: Your Mac clipboard forgets everything the moment you copy something else. Klip doesn't. It keeps a searchable local history of text, images, links, and files in your menu bar. Fully offline. Zero creepy permissions. Free on the Mac App Store.

projects.title: PasteZen
projects.summary: PasteZen is a Mac menu bar app that cleans text the moment you copy it: strips formatting, removes tracking params from links (utm, fbclid, gclid), rejoins broken PDF lines, and masks API keys, emails & card numbers before you paste. It has zero network permission — no account, no analytics, clipboard never written to disk. Core features free forever; Pro is a one-time purchase, no subscription.

projects.title: TaskTicklet
projects.summary: TaskTicklet is a native macOS menu bar app that tracks your work and coding agents together. See Claude Code and Codex sessions, token usage, estimated costs, and task contributions. Automatically detect and log calls, meetings, and interruptions, keeping them separate from focused task time. Understand where time and effort go and compare activity across models. Agent logs are read locally, it never leaves your machine. TaskTicklet never starts, stops, or controls your agents.

projects.title: PaneScale
projects.summary: PaneScale is a desktop app that runs Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and seven more coding agents side by side in one resizable grid. You see at a glance which agent is working, which one is done and which one is waiting for you. Every agent can get its own Git worktree, one prompt can go to every pane, and Claude Code, Codex and Kimi sessions switch to a chat view where approvals are buttons. Plan limits and reset times stay in view. Runs locally, no account. Free in early access.

projects.title: Back To Top
projects.summary: Skip the scroll back up. Back To Top adds a floating button and a toolbar shortcut to Safari on Mac. Choose from 10 styles, drag the button into place, and control when it appears. Paid app on the Mac App Store.

projects.title: Meowslim
projects.summary: Meowslim is a Quran and prayer companion with no ads. Read the full 30-juz Quran with tafsir and verse-by-verse murottal, get prayer times and adhan alarms for your location, find the qibla, and count dhikr on a digital tasbih. A worship tracker with daily streaks and XP helps you keep a routine, and Musa the cat keeps you company. Free on Android, with desktop apps for Windows, macOS and Linux. In English and Indonesian.

projects.title: Show HN: Mac equivalent of Nvidia ShadowPlay. Recording missed moments on Mac
projects.author: itzadetunji
projects.summary: (TLDR at the end) Hello everyone, I've been a gamer all my life, and ever since I got a Mac, I've noticed that I am unable to save recordings of gaming sessions the way NVIDIA ShadowPlay or other related software does on PC, but now it's possible. The idea of how it works came from my PS4, which let me save clips, and I didn't know how it worked. I later looked into it and figured it out using a rolling buffer so you don't store everything, but just enough to capture the moment The first version of this was built on iOS, and it's live on the App Store for you to check out. I am sure those who play Fortnite or Call of Duty: Mobile will want to check this out and share their clips with their friends. The macOS version was built back in April but I've slept on it for a while and decided to look into it and make it much faster, better and with much more customizability. I'd really love your feedback, and I do appreciate contributions to the repo so we can make it better TLDR: When gaming on Mac, you can now save moments you missed using a shortcut ;)

projects.title: 【开源自荐】Codex Deck，轻松管理 Codex 多账号与额度
projects.author: Sanjeever
projects.summary: 我做了一个开源桌面工具 Codex Deck，把 Codex CLI 多账号、额度和历史会话放在一个窗口里。一眼查看各账号剩余额度和恢复时间，快速切换账号，也能搜索、阅读本地历史会话。支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux，提供后台额度刷新、低额度提醒与 WebDAV 备份，让日常使用 Codex 更省心。

projects.title: [开源自荐] Grove：给多仓库项目建 git worktree 工作区，并行跑多个 Claude Code 会话
projects.author: efim0v

github.name: efim0v/grove
github.description: Run parallel Claude Code sessions on a multi-repo project. Feature workspaces built from git worktrees, session management, and moving a session between Claude accounts. macOS menu-bar app and CLI for AI coding agents.

projects.summary: Grove 是一个 macOS 菜单栏应用加命令行工具，面向拆分在多个 Git 仓库里的项目（比如客户端、服务端、配置各在一个仓库）。它为每个功能建一个“工作区”：一个目录里放着你选的各个仓库的 git worktree，都在同一个分支上。Claude Code 从这个目录启动，看到的是这几个仓库的同一个分支；同时开好几个会话，也不会互相把分支切走。它还能集中查看各项目、各账号的 Claude Code 会话，并把会话转到另一个 Claude 账号继续。 亮点 一个分支贯穿多个仓库：建工作区时，Grove 在你选的每个仓库里执行 git worktree add，分支名按模板生成（默认 feat/{name}），你指定的共享文件（比如 CLAUDE.md）会链接或复制进新工作区，各仓库还可以运行自己的创建后钩子。每个仓库可以从各自的基础分支开始；新工作区也能基于另一个工作区的分支来建，Grove 直接从 git 推导出它们之间的关系。 和 Claude Code 自带的 --worktree 不同：claude --worktree 只在当前这一个仓库里建 worktree，Grove 把多个仓库的 worktree 放在同一个目录、同一个分支上。如果产品只有一个仓库，Claude Code 自带的功能可能就够用了。 会话集中查看，还能换账号：列出各个项目、各个 Claude 账号下的 Claude Code 会话。一个账号的限额用完时，可以把会话交给另一个账号：Resume as… 用另一个账号直接接着跑，什么都不用复制；Migrate to… 把会话记录、记忆、文件历史和任务完整复制过去；Share 把会话放进共享存储，所有关联的账号都能看到。 另外还有提交图（分支、远程、标签）和代码行数统计；命令行工具 grove 提供 scan、workspaces、sessions、create、graph、doctor 命令，都能输出 JSON。 可以当学习材料：怎样为多个仓库批量创建 git worktree，并确认它们都切到了同一个分支；菜单栏为什么用 NSStatusItem + NSPanel，而不用 SwiftUI 的 MenuBarExtra，也不用 NSPopover（GroveMenuBarApp.swift 的注释里写了原因）。 纯 Swift 编写（SwiftUI + AppKit），没有第三方依赖，有九百多个测试；免费，GPL-3.0 开源；仓库附有简体中文 README。

projects.title: [开源推荐] 可任意缩放的 Mac 浮动系统监视器
projects.author: Nongfsq

github.name: Nongfsq/ftop
github.description: A small, quiet system monitor for Apple Silicon Macs: one floating glass panel that works at any size.

projects.summary: 给 Apple Silicon Mac 做的原生系统监视器。整个界面是一块浮在桌面上的面板，拖动边缘时自动换成合适的布局并贴合窗口，从菜单栏大小的小条到完整面板都不会裁切或留空。每个核心单独一根柱子并显示当前频率，另有 GPU、内存压力、网络、功耗、温度和最忙的应用。适合跑本地模型、编译时随手看一眼机器状态。 亮点 1. 任意尺寸都有对应布局：内容按优先级取舍，从不裁切，窗口自动贴合布局，不留空白。 2. 不用 sudo 读出每个核心和 GPU 的实时频率：性能核、能效核分组显示，柱高是占用，横线是频率。 3. 几乎不占资源：没有用 SwiftUI，面板由 Core Text 绘制、动画只用 Core Animation 图层，占用不到一个核心的 1%，被遮住时几乎为 0。 4. 诚实的读数：硬件读不到的数值显示为不可用而不是 0，温度标明来自哪一级传感器。 5. 免费开源（MIT），签名并经过苹果公证，可自动更新。

projects.title: Clipboard Manager - ClipBox
projects.summary: ClipBox brings your clipboard history together across Mac, iPhone and iPad. Save text, links, images and snippets; find them with advanced search; restore deleted clips for 30 days; and sync with iCloud. On Mac, queue clips and paste them in order.

projects.title: TailcatBox
projects.summary: Tailcat Box is a desktop app that links two computers directly. Share a short code to chat, call, share screens, send big files, publish ports from your machine or LAN, or open a shell. No account, no public IP, no router setup. Windows, macOS, Linux.

projects.title: Paperwing
projects.summary: Paperwing is a free, open-source PDF app for Windows and macOS with Acrobat's layout and shortcuts. Edit, sign, convert, organize, compress and protect PDFs with 100+ tools. No account, no subscription, no upsells, and your files never leave your computer.

projects.title: Jarvis Live
projects.summary: Jarvis is a realtime voice AI you talk to like a person. It answers out loud in about a second, searches the web and shows live cards. When a task needs a computer, it says so and hands it to Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity or Hermes on your own machine, then reads you the result. Talk face to face with a live avatar. Self-host the open-source app (MIT), or link the free desktop app to Jarvis Cloud and use it from iPhone, Apple Watch, Android and the web.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】MastraWork：把 Agent 运行组织成任务的开源桌面 AI 工作台
projects.author: movclantian

github.name: movclantian/mastra-desktop
github.description: Local-first multi-agent coding workbench built on Electron, React and the Mastra framework. 本地优先的开源桌面 AI 工作台，基于 Mastra + Electron，把一次 Agent 运行组织成可暂停、可回溯、可交接的任务。

projects.summary: 项目：MastraWork | 平台：Windows / macOS / Linux | 许可：Apache-2.0 | 最新版本：v0.0.7 它是什么 一个本地优先的开源桌面 AI 工作台，底层是 Mastra 框架 + Electron。 它想解决的事情很具体：现在多数 AI 工具给你一段回答，事情就停在那儿；代码改到一半让它继续，它常常重新把文件读一遍，从接不上的地方往下编。前面聊过的上下文，像是没发生过。 MastraWork 的做法是把一次 Agent 运行组织成一个任务。任务落在具体的工作区里，长在线程上，每一步都留下痕迹。它能暂停，能回头检查，也能交给团队里的其他成员接着看。断掉之后不是从头再来，而是接着往下走。 它面向软件工程和知识工作：Agent、团队、工作区、终端、浏览器、MCP、技能和资料库收在同一个应用里，围着同一个任务转。 功能详解 🧭 工程任务 读取代码、全局搜索、编辑与 AST 修改、运行命令、查看差异、调用 LSP 都在里面。关键是读、写、执行分开授权，每一步都有记录，不是开一个大权限就全放开。 🛡️ 受控执行 计划、构建、复查三种模式，切的是「Agent 现在能碰什么」。人工询问和批准留在流程里，高风险动作停下来等人确认，不靠模型自觉。 👥 Agent 团队 主 Agent 可以带一群专家成员，支持委派、交接、并行、分支、循环和审批工作流。复杂任务拆给合适的人，而不是一个 Agent 硬扛。 🧩 开放扩展 模型 Provider、MCP Server、技能与插件、浏览器、资料库、记忆和网页检索，按需接入，不绑定任何一家模型服务。今天用这家，明天想换，配置改一下就行。 🖥️ 桌面集成 Electron 主进程、原生浏览器视图、PTY 终端、系统通知、凭据保险库。API Key、OAuth token 和 Cookie 由桌面主进程的凭据保险库保管。 📚 记忆与资料库 记忆跨会话保留；资料库统一收文档、表格和网页；用量、费用和历史数据随时可查。 一个任务是怎么走完的 一个任务从开工到验收，Agent 手里的权限是变的，分三个阶段： 1. 计划 —— 先把事情想清楚，读代码、查资料、出方案。 2. 构建 —— 方案定了再动手，改代码、跑命令、推进任务，每一步都留下记录，随时可以停下来回头看。 3. 复查 —— 对照差异和工作记录验收，高风险的操作在这一步需要人批准。 读、编辑、执行和外部工具在三阶段各有一套策略，图的入口在应用内设置里，实际安全性以服务端权限检查和测试记录为准。 技术栈 | 部分 | 选型 | | --- | --- | | 桌面外壳 | Electron 44、electron-vite、electron-builder | | 界面 | React 19、TypeScript、Tailwind CSS 4、CodeMirror 6、xterm | | Agent 框架 | Mastra 1.77（core、memory、rag、mcp、observability） | | 数据与检索 | libsql、DuckDB、fastembed 本地向量 | | 代码与文档 | Shiki 高亮、Mermaid、KaTeX、PDF 与 Office 解析 | | 工具链 | Biome、Knip、pnpm workspace | 快速开始 三个平台都有现成安装包，也可以从源码跑（需要 Node.js >=22.19.0 <23、pnpm 12.11.2）： sh corepack enable corepack prepare pnpm@12.11.2 --activate pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm dev 首次启动后配一个可用的模型 Provider、选一个工作区目录即可。需要网页检索、浏览器、MCP 或技能时，再按实际服务分别配置凭据。默认本地数据目录是 ~/.mastrawork，Mastra 服务跑在本机 4111 端口。 下载： 关于「本地优先」 需要说清楚一点：「本地优先」说的是桌面宿主、默认工作区和本地数据边界优先留在本机，不表示所有推理都在本地完成。模型推理走哪个服务由使用者自己配置，模型服务会收到你发过去的提示词和选定的上下文。 项目还在很早期（v0.0.7），用着顺手或者踩到坑，都欢迎来 Issues 说一声。

projects.title: PasteSpace Clipboard Manager PRO 3.0
projects.summary: PasteSpace 3.0 is a big update to the private clipboard manager for Mac. Find a screenshot by any word in it, with text recognition in up to 30 languages. With Pro, search inside PDFs, Word and Excel files, scans included, and you can edit their text. New filters and sorting find anything in seconds, the Vault now hides passwords and card numbers even from search, and a redesigned window shows more of what you copy. Everything stays on your Mac: no account, no cloud. Free; Pro is $19.99 once.

projects.title: [开源自荐] Bulchimbeon：只在 AI 编程代理工作时阻止 Mac 休眠的菜单栏工具
projects.author: s3onghyun

github.name: s3onghyun/bulchimbeon
github.description: 🪖 불침번 — Your Mac's night-watch soldier. Keeps your Mac awake only while AI agents work. No hooks, no daemon, macOS 13+.

projects.summary: 一个 macOS 菜单栏工具：只在 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编程代理真正在干活时阻止 Mac 休眠，代理安静下来后自动"换岗"，让 Mac 恢复正常睡眠。适合让代理通宵跑任务、又不想忘记关 caffeinate 的开发者。 亮点 1. 只看"真正在工作"的代理：从外部观察代理进程（caffeinate 子进程和 CPU 占用），仅打开的空闲会话不算，不用改任何代理配置、不装 hook 2. 合盖也能保持唤醒：看门狗保证即使应用被强制退出，5 秒内也会恢复原来的休眠设置 3. 过热自动"战斗休息"：温度过高时暂停值守，降温后自动恢复；低电量时自动撤岗 4. 无守护进程、无 root 辅助程序：一个应用，macOS 13 起可用，支持中文界面；另有 Linux 版命令行守护程序（Go） 5. 像素风小兵在菜单栏下巡逻，MIT 开源

projects.title: CleanPause
projects.summary: CleanPause pauses keyboard input and trackpad gestures and darkens your Mac displays while you clean. No countdown: return with a corner hold, by typing done, or with a keyboard shortcut. Free for macOS 13+. Accessibility permission required.

projects.title: Qualitify, record, review WhatsApp calls
projects.summary: Qualitify records your team's WhatsApp calls from a desktop app, so the conversations nobody could review finally can be. A fair sampling policy picks which calls reach review, so coverage spreads across everyone. Score them against your own criteria and weighting, flag mistakes that fail a call outright, and pin notes to the second. Set daily call goals per agent, then attach coaching plans and compare before-and-after scores with sample sizes shown. Free 14-day trial, no card.

projects.title: Agent Radar

Lowlight is a small menu bar app that adds extra steps under the macOS minimum, plus the normal range above it. You choose how many extra steps you want. projects.title: Show HN: Merlin, Run Your Claude Code and Codex from Slack, Linear and GitHub
projects.author: dottchen
projects.summary: Hi HN, I built Merlin to let you use your own Claude Code and Codex subscription from Slack, Linear, and GitHub. There is a desktop app for macOS and Windows, and a CLI daemon for Linux. When someone mentions Merlin in a Slack thread or Linear issue comment, the task runs on that team member's machine, using their own Claude Code or Codex runtime, and progress and results come back to the original thread. Teammates can steer the agent mid-run. Merlin also has schedules, shared skills, and memory. I know you've probably heard about Claude Tag. Merlin is similar to that but also different. The model usage goes to the Claude Code or Codex subscription instead of API bill, and you can use Merlin across different surfaces to streamline workflow instead of just in Slack (Linear's agent session works particularly well with Merlin. You can just leverage Linear as your control panel for agentic work using Merlin). Merlin also runs on your local machines, which means that you can use your local context including MCPs, skills and local files instead of in a cloud sandbox. Merlin does not upload your working directory, and provider credentials stay on the device. The request and the context it needs pass through Merlin. Runtimes start private, and an owner can make one public so teammates, including non-engineers, can use it. But there're also some limits, and we'll probably deal with them in future updates: - An offline or sleeping machine can't take work. The same issue as OpenClaw. But if you have a mac mini or ec2 setup it should be fine. - Linux is CLI only. We may later add desktop for Linux. - While runtime delegation isn't a problem for now, we're still working on how to make the best use of each team member's local runtime and let them work together cohesively. We've been internally using Merlin for quite some time. It really helps when you're trying to add some AI juice to the conversation or just delegate things to your agents. I think it reduces the friction of having to do the copying & pasting and switch to another app to ask for AI's input when you're having a discussion in a collaborative environment like Slack or Linear. It's really the fastest way from intent to execution. Pricing: free for up to 5 active users and 1,000 requests/month. We think this should get small teams started and get real value from it. Team is $59/mo and Scale is $99/mo, with a 14-day Team trial and no credit card required. I'm here all day to answer questions, and I'd especially like to hear whether non-engineers on your team would actually use this.

projects.title: Show HN: BScaff - A CLI tool for project scaffolding and snippets
projects.author: akashnagcs
projects.summary: I built BScaff, a CLI tool for saving and reusing project structures, templates, files, and text snippets. It can serve as a URL bookmark tool as well. It started with project scaffolding, but I wanted something more general-purpose: a tool that could save almost any reusable starting point and bring it back whenever needed. For each language, I had a specific way of structuring projects that I have refined over years, but I could not find any tool which can quickly help to generate such scaffolding quickly. Copier and Cookiecutter exists but they depend on templates, and I didn't want to create templates for such tasks. One more use-case I had was when I used AI chatbots who suggest some project structure, and I want to quickly create that. So I wanted something offline which can quickly help me save and recreate file trees. Then I added snippets to it too, but I mostly use it for notes taking personally. Some things you can do with it: * Save Git repository templates locally and use them offline whenever you need to create a new project * Create reusable templates from existing directories * Save and recreate directory structures by copying ASCII file trees and the tool will read it from clipboard and recreate it (or save it for later) * Save collections of files and generate them again in another directory * Save text snippets and either copy them to the clipboard or generate files from them The idea is to avoid repeatedly recreating the same boilerplate, directory structures, configuration files, etc. And you can use it as a note-taking app as well with snippets. It has templates support as well with Jinja-based variable replacement. Template updates are supported, but project updates are not yet implemented, have planned it for future. It is written in TypeScript, runs on Node.js, and is available on npm. GitHub: https://github.com/akashnag/bscaff Install: npm install -g @akashnag/bscaff Feedback, feature suggestions ( I already have a big backlog though :P ), and contributions are welcome!
