projects.title: Show HN: Helicon – Desktop App for Meta's Muse Code CLI (Linux, Windows, macOS)
projects.author: harjjotsinghh
projects.summary: Hi Hacker News, I'm Harjot. I've been using Meta's Muse Code CLI daily for a few weeks now. One thing that I found difficult to handle was managing or controlling multiple sessions across multiple projects, while using the terminal for the muse CLI. Initially, I used cmux to create workspaces/groups for my different projects to group them, and then created 4 split terminals in each of those projects, that ran muse code sessions in each of them. It worked, but it was ugly. I didn't like using that. It could be because I'm not really a terminal person and would much rather prefer a proper dedicated GUI or desktop/app interface, and I would prefer it any time over a terminal screen or CLI. So it might be personal preference but yeah. So, I started building a desktop app around it, mainly to scratch my own itch. Helicon is a desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux, plus a VS Code extension that also works in Cursor and Devin. It doesn't replace the CLI. It runs `muse serve` and talks to it, and it reuses your existing `muse login`, so you don't have to get an API key and you don't pay an extra bill. You can use your existing Muse Code subscription plans. Some things that I use the most: 1. Resuming sessions that I started in the terminal. I don't start many sessions in the terminal now that Helicon exists, but initially I wanted to access all the sessions that were running in a terminal to be accessible from Helicon, when it was created initially. 2. Inline diffs that I can approve, similar to how Cursor works. 3. I can clearly see my 5-hour and weekly plan limits directly from the app itself and don't have to manually keep going to Meta's Muse Code billing page and manually keep refreshing the page to see my current usage/limits. I built it using Tauri 2 and React. It is MIT licensed. I built a lot of it with AI coding agents, especially Opus 5.5 (I really like using this model). It's at v0.21.9 now, and 9 people have contributed so far. Some issues: the Windows installer isn't code-signed yet, so you'll see a SmartScreen warning. And the macOS build isn't notarized, so you need to click "Open Anyway" once. You can try it in the browser with mock data, no install needed: https://helicon.sh/try It's unofficial and not affiliated with Meta. If you use a coding CLI every day, what would you want from a GUI for it? And what would make you go back to the terminal?

projects.title: Show HN: Atticus – Hold-to-talk voice assistant for macOS that runs on Claude -p
projects.author: SaarthRanka

github.name: SaarthurR/atticus-mac
github.description: Fast, free voice assistant for your Mac. No API key: runs on your Claude Pro or Max plan. Remembers you and learns your shortcuts. Hold ⌃⌥Space and talk.

projects.summary: Hi HN! I'm Saarth. I'm in 9th grade, and I built Atticus. Atticus is a fast and cheap Mac assistant that can do tasks for you. You hold down Control-Option-Space, speak or type your task, be it complex or a simple browser search, and Atticus will get on it. The interesting part is that simple tasks, like opening apps, playing a Spotify playlist, or web queries, don't touch AI, and instead are processed locally and typically finish in under a second. For example, prompting Atticus to open apps takes around 0.08 seconds, sometimes even finishing before you finish your sentence, sort of like Jev. Any tasks that are more complicated will be sent to Claude via claude -p, meaning you never need an API key and Atticus will run on your existing Claude Pro or Max plan. By using this approach, costs are also cut down immensely, with, on average, tasks costing a fraction of a cent. To achieve Atticus' speed, it remembers shortcuts from each task it completes. When it does a task right for the first time, it saves its steps and replays them the next time without AI. For example, a workflow of creating a new meeting took about 30 seconds the first time around. Atticus then logs the exact steps to memory and takes 5-8 seconds on the next pass. To add to this, Atticus also learns about you as you use it more and from what's on your computer, including your name, your apps, and things you want it to remember, personalizing its answers to you. To combat the safety concerns over giving an AI unrestricted access to your device, Atticus has toggleable restrictions, so before anything is deleted, sent, bought, or written to a file, the user is prompted before that action. Some features I'm currently working on include a meeting copilot that capitalizes on Atticus' speed, allowing Atticus to listen in on meetings and answer questions in real time as they come in, personalized to the context of the meeting and what it knows about you. To run Atticus, macOS 26 or higher is required for its voice transcription features. The voice transcription is also done locally by macOS. Atticus is free, open source, and also very fresh, and I'm completely aware of its many rough edges, which is why I'd love to hear from everyone about what breaks and what you guys would like to see Atticus do!

projects.summary: 一款运行在 macOS 和 Windows 上的显示器联动工具。它监听普通 USB 切换器的动作，通过 DDC/CI 协议自动向外接显示器发送切源指令，让键盘、鼠标和多台显示器一键切到另一台电脑。 为什么做这个项目？ 很多双机办公的开发者（比如一台 Mac 办公，一台 Windows 娱乐或跑编译），桌面通常是两台电脑连着一到两台显示器。 目前的切换方案普遍存在痛点： 1. 硬件 KVM：支持 4K/高刷的硬件 KVM 普遍在数百甚至上千元，而且桌面接线复杂、容易挑线。 2. 纯软件 KVM（如 Barrier/Synergy）：通过局域网传输键鼠，有输入延迟，且两台电脑处于不同网络或内网隔离时无法使用。 3. 低成本 USB 切换器：几十块的切换器只能切键鼠，每次切电脑都要伸手去摸显示器背后的 OSD 按键，如果是双屏更要按两次。 它是怎么工作的？ 键盘、鼠标插在普通的 USB 切换器上，显示器视频线各自直连两台电脑。 两端运行 KVMFlow。按一下 USB 切换器切走键鼠时，软件捕获到设备离开/接入事件，立即通过 DDC/CI 向显示器发送切源指令（如从 DP 1 切到 HDMI 1）。 视频信号和外设依然走物理直连，零延迟、不占网络带宽、纯本地运行。 功能与特点 支持平台：macOS（Apple Silicon）与 Windows x64，底层核心采用 Rust 实现，跨平台体验一致。 多显示器支持：支持分别记录每台屏幕对应的输入源通道。 纯本地运行：不收集键鼠输入，不转发画面，无需注册账号。 开源协议：MIT License。 界面预览

projects.summary: 在 VS Code / Cursor 里提供类似 Eclipse 的底部 Javadoc 面板：源码留在编辑器里读，当前光标处类 / 方法 / 字段的 / … / 渲染到面板里；工程源码和 jar / jdt 依赖源都可用。可选通过 LLM 翻译成中文，原文与译文对照。 为什么做 从 Eclipse 转到 VS Code / Cursor 写 Java 时，最怀念的就是底部那个随光标刷新的 Javadoc 视图。悬停提示一闪而过、不够沉浸；打开完整 HTML 站点又太重。于是做了这个轻量面板：只渲染已有注释，不生成骨架，也不跑 JDK javadoc 导出站点。 核心功能 底部 Javadoc 面板随光标刷新（默认 Panel，可拖到侧栏） 渲染签名与 @param、@return、@see、@since 等标签 解析 {@code}、{@link}、{@linkplain}、{@literal}、{@value} 及常见 HTML 实体 链接可点击：{@link} / @see 在编辑器内跳转，外链用系统浏览器打开 明确支持 jar / jdt 依赖源，不只是工作区文件 可选 LLM 翻译：任意 OpenAI 兼容接口（OpenAI、DeepSeek、通义兼容端、本地 Ollama 等），译文缓存，API Key 存 Secret Storage 快捷键 Ctrl+Alt+Q，以及状态栏 / 标题栏入口 快速开始 1. 从 Marketplace 或 Open VSX 安装 JavaDoc Rendered View 2. 打开任意 .java（工作区或 jar 附加源码均可） 3. Ctrl+Alt+Q 打开面板，光标移到带 Javadoc 的成员上即可 4. （可选）执行 JavaDoc: Set Translation API Key，在面板点「译此块」做中英对照 欢迎试用和提意见。

projects.title: GrabText
projects.summary: Lens Text is a Windows desktop tool that lets you extract text from anywhere on your screen. Press Ctrl+Shift+X, select an area, and copy text from error dialogs, videos, screenshots, and otherwise unselectable PDFs. Collect multiple snippets with Multi-select mode, or use Scroll mode to gather text across long pages. Powered by a multi-engine OCR fallback system, with high-DPI and multi-monitor support.

projects.title: [开源自荐] 小喷 1.1.0： Mac 菜单栏语音伙伴，支持 ChatGPT 订阅和本机 Ollama
projects.author: AvalonKing
projects.summary: 我是小喷作者。这是我业余维护的原生 macOS 菜单栏语音助手，刚发布 1.1.0 ，代码采用 MIT 协议。想解决一个小需求：手在键盘上时，顺口查天气、定计时器或调音量，不用先找聊天窗口。 叫一声“小喷小喷”就能开始，回答后可以继续追问。提醒保存在本机；提醒和音量指令由本机解析执行，不依赖模型工具调用。普通问答使用你选择的大模型，并流式朗读。 技术上使用 Swift 6 / SwiftUI 。唤醒词用 macOS 本机语音识别；模型入口按服务商、通用接口、本机三组管理，各自保存配置，密钥和登录令牌放钥匙串。可以接自己的 OpenAI / Anthropic 兼容 API 、已有的 ChatGPT 订阅，或本机 Ollama 。应用免费下载，第三方模型和云端识别可能收费，ChatGPT 订阅受账户额度限制。 服务商目录集中定义协议、地址与模型预设，方便扩展；与模型有关的特殊参数单独处理。对本机技能，我更在意执行后能确认实际结果，例如调音量后重新读取设备状态，设备不支持时直接提示。 1.1.0 加了回声消除和直接开口打断，也能设成唤醒词打断。蓝牙耳机暂不支持语音打断，可用 ⌥⌘K 。朗读可选系统声音，或下载约 3.1 GB 的 Qwen3-TTS 在本机 GPU 运行。 隐私边界：默认叫醒后，含唤醒前约 2.5 秒的录音会发到千问做识别；直接说话打断时，也会发送约 1 秒预录及后续插话确认人声。可以切换本机识别。识别出的聊天文字发给所选模型，对话只留在内存；天气查询会向 Open-Meteo 发送城市或粗略坐标。 需要 macOS 14+ 和 Apple Silicon 。当前安装包尚未经过苹果公证，首次安装有额外门槛，请先看安装说明。 [代码与安装说明]( https://github.com/jiaqianjing/xiaopen-mac#安装) · [1.1.0 下载]( https://github.com/jiaqianjing/xiaopen-mac/releases/tag/v1.1.0) · [隐私说明]( https://github.com/jiaqianjing/xiaopen-mac/blob/main/docs/PRIVACY.md) 欢迎试用和提 Issue ，尤其想听听唤醒、断句和连续对话在哪些场景还不自然。

projects.title: 【开源自荐】LightGitPad：AI 写代码时，用来看项目和 Git 改动的轻量查看器

projects.summary: 这是我做的开源桌面工具 LightGitPad，适合在 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程助手修改代码后，检查工程和 Git 改动。 在一个窗口里可以查看： 工程文件树和带语法高亮的代码。 Git 改动及左右对照 diff、提交历史和分支列表。 Markdown 渲染预览，方便阅读助手生成的计划和报告。 支持 Windows 10/11 x64 和 macOS 12 及以上（Apple Silicon、Intel）。源码采用 C++ / Qt 6，MIT 协议；v0.2.18 已提供两平台安装包及 SHA256 校验文件。 它不调用任何 AI 服务，不需要账号或 API Key；Git 的提交、推送、拉取和切换分支仍由用户或编程助手完成。需要本机安装 Git 2.23 或以上。当前为 0.x 早期版本，安装包尚未用付费证书签名，首次启动需按 README 的说明确认。 项目： 下载： 中文说明： 欢迎试用，并通过项目 Issues 反馈问题或建议。

projects.title: Acclimach

projects.title: 【开源自荐】jev-chat-jarvis-mac —— macOS 聊天悬浮窗：先看懂对方，再回复
projects.author: eatmoreduck

github.name: jev-chat/jev-chat-jarvis-mac
github.description: 聊天悬浮窗助手（macOS）：屏幕感知 + 本地小模型判断意图与风险，按话术生成回复候选。纯只读。

projects.summary: 自荐一个开源小工具：jev-chat-jarvis-mac 它是一个 macOS 悬浮窗：聊天应用里弹出一条消息，悬浮窗会告诉你这句话的真实意图（8 类，零样本 86.4%）、风险分级（0-9 分）和几条候选回复，点「填入」进输入框——发送键永远由你自己按。 技术上有几个我觉得还算有意思的点： 1. 感知层没有侵入任何聊天应用：要么对前台聊天窗口按窗口 ID 截图（不是全屏），再用 Apple Vision OCR 只扫聊天区，按气泡和左右对齐区分正文、昵称、固定公告和引用；要么直接走系统文本接口读，不截图不 OCR。 2. 判断层是个本地 2B 小模型，一次前向同时出 8 类意图的全分布和风险分级，下载后完全离线；也可以配 TypeSafe Jev 的 key 走云端。生成层接任意 OpenAI 兼容端点（DeepSeek、智谱、本地 Ollama 都实测过），14 种话术并发生成候选，再由本地模型重排。M1 Pro 上出意图约 1.5 秒。 3. 坚持只读不代发：不模拟任何按键——合成输入事件会被部分应用的账号风控识别；「填入」优先走辅助功能接口写入并读回确认，定位不到就复制到剪贴板让你自己粘贴。 用法：Releases 下载 .app 拖进应用程序，授予屏幕录制权限即可。仅支持 Apple Silicon（M 系列）+ macOS 13+，MIT 开源。 适合每天在微信/飞书/QQ 里打字很多、想先看懂对方再回复的人，以及研究屏幕感知 + 端侧小模型落地的同学。

projects.title: 【开源自荐】jev-chat-jarvis-ios —— 一个键盘打通所有聊天 App：先看懂对方再回复
projects.author: eatmoreduck

github.name: jev-chat/jev-chat-jarvis-ios
github.description: iOS 键盘：在任何聊天 App 里直接出意图、风险与候选回复——复制消息，键盘上见分晓。Swift / SwiftUI，中英双语。An iOS keyboard that drafts replies inside any chat app.

projects.summary: 自荐一个开源小工具：jev-chat-jarvis-ios（iOS 键盘版） 它是一个 iOS 自定义键盘：在任何聊天 App 里，长按复制对方那条消息，切到 Jev 键盘点「分析剪贴板」，键盘上直接给出这句话的意图（8 类概率分布）、风险分级（0-9）、行动建议和候选回复，点一下候选文字就进输入框。不跳 App、不切后台、不申请录屏权限——一个键盘打通所有聊天软件。 技术上有两个我觉得还算有意思的点： 1. 判断层走 TypeSafe Jev 的 systemone 接口，一次调用同时拿到 8 类意图的概率分布和 0-9 风险分布，还给候选回复排序；没配 key 也不会挂，自动退化成只起草的"盲起草"。生成层是标准 OpenAI 兼容 / Anthropic 兼容接口，智谱、DeepSeek、OpenRouter 都有预设，12 种话术并发各出 2 条（前稳后放）。 2. 键盘扩展有 60MB 内存上限，整个键盘是在这个约束下用纯系统控件搭的；App 和键盘共用的判断口径（意图集、风险量表、话术库、prompt）收在 Shared/ 目录单一实现里，用 swiftc 就能在 Mac 上跑口径回归，不需要 iPhone。 隐私边界：文字只在你点「分析」那一刻发往你自己配置的接口，无自建服务器、不落盘、不进日志；Key 存本机 App Group 私有容器；键盘不监听、不上传按键。发送永远由你手动完成。 Swift 5 + SwiftUI，iOS 16+，MIT 开源，Xcode 免费个人账号就能真机跑。

projects.title: Show HN: Mailbox Viewer – publish FOIA email dumps as a static Gmail-like site
projects.author: rahimnathwani
projects.summary: Responses to public-records (FOIA, or California PRA) requests often arrive as PST or mbox files, which 'normal' people don't know how to open. If they're lucky they can import them into Apple mail or the Outlook desktop client. But it's hard to share with others, and impossible to link to a specific thread or a specific spot in a specific thread. Jmail ( https://jmail.world ), the Gmail-style viewer for the Epstein emails, was heavily upvoted on HN, because it felt so easy to use. I had hoped the team would open source the code, but I don't think they did. My first attempt at my own version (made for a specific pst file I received) was usable, but had some limitations. Recently, I threw Claude Opus 5.5 (xhigh) at the problem. This is the result. The mbv build command turns a mailbox (PST, mbox or Maildir) into: - a set of parquet files - a word index - embeddings. You upload those to any static host that support HTTP range requests (e.g. Cloudflare R2) and deploy one front-end viewer (e.g. Vercel) for any number of mailboxes. There's no backend computation. The browser queries the Parquet files with DuckDB-WASM over HTTP range requests. It rebuilds conversations (including from Outlook's Thread-Index), keeps folders as labels, supports Gmail's search operators (from:, has:attachment, before:, OR, "phrases"), searches text inside PDF and Office attachments, and adds semantic search with a small embedding model that runs in the browser. Every view has its own URL, so you can deep link to a search and a conversation. This link searches a school district mailbox for "straight white male" and opens the matching thread with the hits highlighted: https://mail.ocaho.com/youcubed-2026-03#search/Straight%20wh... Demo with a fictional mailbox: https://mail.ocaho.com/demo Code (MIT): https://github.com/rahimnathwani/mailbox-viewer

projects.title: Show HN: Dewey: a connectome-driven fruit fly for your macOS menu bar

Next to continuing the long lineage of desktop creatures (the 90s Dancing Baby!) it raises a few questions: with Dewey driven by a 'real' connectome is it OK to bring this thing alive in a virtual environment? Is it purely reflexive? What about a bee, a social animal? To be on the safe side: Dewey can get some company on your desktop by adding a few friends. see also: https://0110.be/posts/Dewey%3A_a_connectome-driven_fruit_fly...

A sidebar shows which agent is working, which is waiting for you and which is done, and the menu bar shows it from any app. Each task gets its own git worktree, started from a prompt, a GitHub issue or a Jira ticket. Review the diff, commit, push and open the PR in the same window. Built on libghostty, so it reads your Ghostty config. Free and MIT licensed. No account, no telemetry.

projects.title: Show HN: BetterWispr – Free, open-source dictation for Mac
projects.author: kartik017

projects.title: Show HN: WallHop – 12ft.io is gone, so I built a replacement
projects.author: TheWaffleHax
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm Josh. WallHop is a free paywall bypass: paste an article URL (or prefix any URL with wallhop.io/) and you get the readable article without the paywall popup, ads or clutter. No signup, no extension. I built it after 12ft.io went away. The News Media Alliance took it down in July 2025 and I missed having something I could hit from my phone. How it works: it started as a fork of everywall/ladder (GPL-3.0) and I've modified it heavily since. Instead of relying on one trick, it chains several bypass methods per request and falls back to archive.is when they all fail, so one site blocking one technique doesn't break it. Things that might be interesting: - iOS Shortcut: on iPhone, tap Share > WallHop from any article in Safari or another app. This is how I use it 95% of the time. - It works on Medium member-only posts, which 12ft never handled. - Bookmarklet for desktop, plus /raw/<url> and /api/<url> endpoints if you want to script it. I've tested it against most major news outlets and a bunch of local papers. It won't work everywhere. There are SOME server-side paywalls that are out of reach, and I'd rather say that up front. If you find a site that breaks, I'd love the link, and I can likely figure out a way to bypass it!

projects.title: 【自荐】Auten：让 Claude Code / Codex / Cursor 直接操作你的电脑和 Android 手机（MCP 服务器）
projects.author: mbicecode-ctrl

github.name: auten-ai/auten-mcp
github.description: Computer-use MCP server: give Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client hands on a real screen: your computer (Mac/Windows/Linux) and your Android phone (beta). Clicks, types and reads the screen, even in apps with no API.

projects.summary: 阮老师好，自荐一下我们做的 Auten，一个 computer-use MCP 服务器。 AI 编程助手很会写代码，但遇到没有 API 的软件就没办法了：桌面客户端、老的后台系统、只能在手机 App 里完成的操作。Auten 给 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 或任何 MCP 客户端一双"手"：在真实屏幕上点击、输入、读取内容。支持你的电脑（macOS / Windows / Linux X11），以及通过 USB 连接的 Android 手机（beta）。 几个设计点： 优先读取系统的无障碍树（accessibility tree）：智能体拿到的是带编号的真实按钮和输入框（listelements 然后 clickat(3)），而不是猜坐标。没有无障碍信息的 App 再用 OCR 和截图。 任务做成一次后可以保存为技能（skill）。下次重放不调用模型、不消耗 token，几秒完成；界面变了会自己修复。 密码保存在本机（macOS / Windows 钥匙串，Linux 本地私有保险库）。filllogin 在本机直接填入，模型看不到明文。 安装（第一步装本地运行程序，Linux 上会用一次 sudo 安装依赖）： bash curl -fsSL | bash claude mcp add -s user auten -- npx -y @autenai/mcp AI 用你自己的（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 或自己的 API key），Auten 只负责"手"。免费版每月 30 分钟运行时间，不用绑卡；付费版目前是早期价格。界面和文档暂时只有英文。说明一下：本地运行程序不开源，GitHub 仓库里是 MIT 协议的 npm 启动器、各客户端配置和文档。

projects.title: 做了个开源 Mac App：用 adb 在 Mac 上看清、管好家里的安卓电视、盒子和手机
projects.author: xxzhaoming
projects.summary: 起因是客厅的安卓电视。打开开发者模式、用 adb 连上以后，发现能读到的东西特别多：屏幕开没开、前台是哪个 App 、正在播什么、开机多久、内存存储、最近的使用记录……只是全都藏在命令行里。于是用 Claude Code 写了个 Mac App ，把这些都摆出来，顺手把常用的操作也做了。不只是电视，安卓盒子、手机、平板都能用。 GitHub： https://github.com/zhaoweijia1997/Sideboard （截图在 README 里） ## 能看到什么 - **总览**：屏幕状态（亮屏 / 熄屏 / 屏保）、前台 App 、正在播放的内容、开机时长、CPU 、内存、存储、网络、温度、音量 - **最近 24 小时**：什么时候开关机、亮屏熄屏、打开过哪些 App 。数据来自安卓自己的使用记录，Sideboard 没开的时候发生的事也看得到 - **长期记录**：存在 Mac 上，按周 / 按月看每天亮屏多久，攒满四周还有「每天几点亮屏」的热力图 - **体检**：每个 App 用了多少流量、最近的崩溃和无响应、谁在偷偷唤醒设备 - **详细信息**：型号、系统版本、芯片、分辨率和刷新率、Wi-Fi 信号、电源和待机设置、深度睡眠时长 ## 能做什么（只在你点的时候） - **实时画面**：在 Mac 窗口里实时显示设备屏幕，点击就是点屏幕、拖动就是滑动，方向键当遥控器 - 遥控器、截屏、录屏，图片和视频直接存到 Mac - App 管理：卸载、停用预装 App （随时能恢复）、导出 APK - 文件管理：浏览、上传下载、拖进窗口就传过去；拖进 `.apk` 就安装 - 清理：应用缓存、已卸载 App 的残留、安装包。大文件只列出来，不替你勾 - 在设备上打开链接：从 Safari 拖个链接到窗口上就行 - 菜单栏常驻：深夜电视还开着、存储快满、发热、有 App 被装上或卸掉，都会发通知 ## 几条原则 - **不改设备的任何设置**，包括待机设置；熄屏时只偶尔看一眼，不让设备睡不着 - **设备上不留东西**：截图、录屏直接传回 Mac ，临时文件随手删掉 - **数据不离开你的 Mac**：没有账号，没有统计，不联网上传 设备上什么都不用装。有个可选的配套 App （约 120 KB ，不申请联网权限），装上能多出 90 天的记录、App 图标，以及从 Mac 往电视里输入中文。 ## 怎么用 1. 装 adb：`brew install --cask android-platform-tools` 2. 设备上打开开发者选项里的 USB 调试或网络调试 3. 从 GitHub 的 Releases 下载 dmg 。还没做苹果公证，第一次打开要右键 →「打开」 需要 macOS 14 及以上，Apple 芯片和 Intel 都行。MIT 开源，界面有 7 种语言。 还是早期版本（ 0.6 ），欢迎试用、提 issue ，或者回帖说说你想用它干什么。

Specifically, you can type bracketed phrases {such as this}, press Shift-Command-K (or a different shortcut of your choosing), and the tool sends your bracketed phrase + the surrounding text contents to an LLM of your configuration for generating text to replace the bracketed phrase. The program returns 3 candidate phrases and the experience is entirely keyboard navigable. Demo: https://jackdamon.org/assets/images/lacuna-scheduling-demo.g... Example scheduling workflow using Lacuna’s native UI and sample suggestions. So far I find myself frequently using it when drafting emails where I want help with quick phrasing. The project was inspired by Rectangle, an open source utility app for window tiling that is keyboard based. Lacuna is open source and available here: https://github.com/jdamon96/lacuna Blog: https://jackdamon.org/blog/lacuna/

projects.summary: 自荐一个免费开源的 macOS 窗口切换器：Open Contexts。 Mac 上同时打开多个浏览器、编辑器和终端窗口时，系统自带的 ⌘Tab 只能切换应用，找到某个具体窗口还要多一步。Open Contexts 按最近使用顺序列出每个窗口，并提供屏幕边缘应用栏，方便用键盘或鼠标直接切换。 主要功能： 窗口级切换：默认 ⌘Tab 切换所有窗口，Command + 反引号切换当前应用的窗口；快捷键可以自定义。 屏幕边缘应用栏：可放在左侧、右侧或底部，常驻显示或鼠标靠近边缘时唤出，支持显示图标和窗口标题。 可保存的窗口分组：将不同应用的窗口按代码、资料、聊天等任务归组，支持拖动排序和固定位置；重启后恢复分组及可匹配窗口的归属。 原生、免费、开源：使用 Swift、AppKit 和 SwiftUI 开发，采用 Apache 2.0 许可证，无需账号或订阅，分组数据保存在本机。 项目复刻了 Contexts 的应用栏和窗口切换体验，并加入可保存的自定义窗口分组。目前不支持窗口搜索和触控板切换手势；保存分组不会重新打开应用或恢复桌面窗口的尺寸和位置。 支持 macOS 13 及以上，提供 Apple Silicon / Intel 通用 DMG，安装后需要授予辅助功能权限。当前发行包尚未经过 Apple 公证，遇到系统拦截时可参考 README 的安装说明；macOS 13 等较旧版本尚未完成实机验证。 中文官网及交互演示 · GitHub 源码 · 下载最新版本 实际运行截图： 披露：我是项目维护者，希望能作为周刊工具推荐候选。欢迎反馈，感谢！

projects.title: 【工具自荐】飞砂宝盒：桌面整理 + 快捷访问 + 全盘搜索，以及 8 款按需下载的办公急救工具，核心客户端 20MB
projects.author: mroger-tech
projects.summary: Windows 效率工具：桌面文件自动归类、快捷访问面板、Alt + Space 全盘搜索；另有 8 款办公急救工具按需下载，用哪个装哪个。 体积 安装包约 20MB，核心装完约 60MB 工具全部装齐约 400MB（主要是录屏的编解码组件） 工具按需下载，不装不占空间 为什么自己做 自己做之前也试过不少桌面整理软件。有的功能就一个整理，桌面干净了，软件也就不大打开了；有的倒是功能多，但安装包越来越大，还时不时跳出推荐。 我们想要的很简单：平时能帮收拾桌面、搜文件，急用时又能处理 PDF、Office、压缩包密码这类麻烦事，而且别一上来就又大又吵。所以做成「日常好用 + 急救按需装」——整理和搜索默认免费，办公工具用到再下，不追求功能堆满。 主要功能 1. 桌面整理：新文件按规则进分区。可全自动归位，也可先入「未分类」再一键整理（避免找不到刚下的文件）。默认分区免费；自定义分区与规则需会员。 2. 快捷访问：常用应用 / 文件夹固定到面板，快捷键唤出。 3. 全盘搜索：Alt + Space，支持格式筛选。 4. 桌面待办：可贴在桌面；云同步需会员。 5. 8 款急救工具（按需下载） 免费：窗口抓取器（点一下查出弹窗所属进程）、自动关机助手 会员：PDF 密码管家、PDF 转换专家、Office 解密专家、压缩包解密专家、HEIC 互转、录屏 免费与付费 免费：默认分区整理、快捷访问、全盘搜索、桌面待办、部分皮肤、窗口抓取器、自动关机助手；不登录也可用。 会员（订阅 / 买断）：自定义分区与规则、待办云同步、部分皮肤，以及其余 6 款工具。 工具需联网鉴权，文件仍在本地处理；无弹窗、无捆绑。 支持平台 Windows 7 及以上（32 / 64 位）。 截图 【截图 1：桌面整理前后】 【截图 2：快捷访问面板】 【截图 3：Alt + Space 搜索】 【截图 4（可选）：按需下载的工具面板】

projects.title: 【开源自荐】Ginno：本地优先的个人 AI Agent，数据不出本机，自带可视化工作流
projects.author: robscc
projects.summary: 背景 Claude Code 这类 Agent 的形态很好用，但我想给「个人使用」做一个完整的桌面形态：数据不出本机，工具 / 权限 / 技能 / 工作流有统一的界面，流程可编排、运行可观察。 于是用业余时间做了两个多月，自己每天在用（dogfooding），迭代了 220+ 次提交，目前是能日常干活的状态。 它是什么 Ginno 是一个 本地优先（local-first）的个人 AI Agent 桌面应用（macOS）。 一条设计原则贯穿始终：你的数据不离开你的机器。 无数据库：所有状态是 ~/.ginno/ 下的 JSON / JSONL / Markdown，可读、可手改、可进 git 无账号、无云同步：打开即用；拷走文件夹就能搬家 自带模型 Key：OpenAI / Anthropic / DeepSeek 或任意兼容端点；Ginno 只是客户端，不托管你的 Key 和数据 技术栈：Tauri 2（Rust 桌面壳）+ Next.js 前端 + Python 运行时（FastAPI / LangGraph）。 能力上： 多 Agent 对话：会话中随时切换 Agent，共享历史、各自独立记忆 工具 · 权限 · 技能 · MCP · Hooks：Claude Code 同款形态，全部内置 可视化 Workflow Studio：一份带版本的 DSL，编译成 LangGraph 状态图执行，运行过程实时观察 本地知识库：索引你的 Obsidian 仓库，回答带引用来源 长程 Goal + TODO：让 Agent 持续推进一个长期目标，并和待办同步 内置浏览器 + 联网搜索：检索带来源标注 效果 工作区： Workflow Studio（可视化编排 + 运行观察）： 本地知识库： 安装 macOS（Apple Silicon）： 安装包（推荐）：Releases 下载 Ginno0.1.0aarch64.dmg（未签名，首次打开请右键 → 打开） 或从源码运行： bash git clone cd ginno pnpm install cd packages/runtime && uv sync cd ../.. && pnpm dev 其他 MIT 开源。项目还很早期，API 和 UI 迭代很快；欢迎试用，欢迎提 Issue / PR，中英文都行。

projects.title: Show HN: Smart Blur – Auto-Blur PII in the Browser, with a OpenAI Local Model
projects.author: vickyonlinecont
projects.summary: Hi folks, I'm Vicky. I build privacy tools that use local AI, on late nights and weekends. Smart Blur is a Chrome extension that blurs sensitive info on any web page before anyone else sees it. There are already a few tools like this, so why another one? Two reasons: Local AI for unstructured PII. Most existing tools use regex, which handles emails, phones and card numbers but can't find names or addresses in plain text. Smart Blur runs OpenAI's Privacy Filter (Apache-2.0) locally on WebGPU. The model is a one-time ~810 MB download from Hugging Face, cached in the browser, and it needs WebGPU. Share Shield. It detects when a page starts sharing your screen (Meet, Teams, Zoom web) and turns blurring on in every tab, then turns it off when you stop. To be upfront: pattern blurring (emails, phones, cards, SSNs, IPs, API keys, custom regex), click/draw-to-blur and hiding tab titles are free. The local AI and Share Shield are a paid Pro upgrade. It's Chrome/Edge only, works on web pages only (not desktop apps), and the AI works best on English. No account and no server. The only network calls are the model download and the optional payment, which you can check in DevTools. There's a practice page with fake customer data at smartbuildlabs.com/apps/smart-blur/try/. I'd love to hear where detection misses or over-blurs.

projects.title: Show HN: Gretel – Topic specific feeds built from YouTube recommendations
projects.author: Ezap2
projects.summary: One of the annoying things about YouTube is that it is really good at catching my attention, but I have little control over what kind of feed it can show me, so it becomes distracting instead. I don't want to hide recommendations entirely though, I just don't want all my interests mixed into one feed. So I wondered if I could have separate YouTube profiles for different interests, but make creating one as simple as picking a few topics instead of having to create or connect another Google account. So I built Gretel, a desktop app. It uses YT.js to access YouTube, and it runs locally so the requests come from my own machine rather than a server. I create profiles, each with their own topics. Gretel then searches YouTube for the topics, collects candidate videos, and creates an embedding that is used to filter videos later on. From the candidate videos, Gretel fetches related videos and continuously expands outward while filtering unrelated videos. This creates the base feed. After that, as I watch videos, the topic embeddings are continuously updated, and at the same time Gretel persists the YouTube sessions so the recommendations adapt as well. I have been working on Gretel on and off for a while. It's beta: usable but still rough. I am curious if, after using a profile for a while, the feed actually starts converging toward what you wanted. Bug reports and contributions are welcome too. You can sign in with Google to use the included embedding credits, or bring your own OpenRouter key. Other providers and local embedding models are coming.

projects.title: Show HN: Delegator – Stop juggling coding-agent sessions
projects.author: mattm
projects.summary: I wanted to share Delegator with the HN community. delegator gives you a personal inbox to manage your tasks that is completely local to your machine. Backstory: Like everyone else, I've been experimenting with different AI-assisted development workflows. I realized I was having difficulty with all the context switching between tasks. Asking agents to develop code ends up taking about 5-10 minutes usually for well-scoped tasks. At the beginning I would read the AI output as it went along and sometimes interrupt to guide it. But as LLMs have gotten better, there's less need to do that. So I would spin up another task during the latency and then another. (I wrote a little bit about this previously here https://mattmccormick.ca/we-re-all-managers-now-my-journey-i... ) Jumping back and forth between terminals with the Agent being at different stages was mentally taxing. I experimented with some different options and ended up realizing that to avoid the drain of context-switching, what I really needed was a queue. Delegator works by putting all scoped tasks through the system. It stops when the ready queue has reached your configured limit. This is to prevent too much work from piling up waiting for review. It also presents the work from getting too far ahead in case any issues are found as part of development. I also realized that for most tasks, agents can be treated as a background process. You pass in the work to the process. It processes it and then gives you an output to review. All changes are made in git worktrees for safety. Who's it for? Delegator is for engineers who still want to understand the code and changes. It's not for vibe-coding or exploratory work. Don't get me wrong, I'll still spin up an agent session for brainstorming design options. But once I'm aligned on a direction, I'll then ask the agent to break down the work into "dg tickets". Since Delegator is a local program, agents can interact with it quickly and seamlessly. Right now it's just CLI based but I'm looking to expand this into a GUI/Desktop App so I would be interested in any feedback you have. Let me know if you have any questions and I'll respond. The code is source available so you can check it out at https://github.com/alcubie/delegator if you want to check anything.

projects.summary: Lokii 是一款极致轻量、亚毫秒级响应的 macOS 原生即时文件搜索工具，致力于在 Mac 上带来类似 Windows 下 Everything 般的轻巧、瞬时文件名检索体验。 在 macOS 上，Spotlight 或访达搜索在定位文件时有时不够快速直接，或者在海量文件中难以做到纯文件名的“键入即出结果”。Lokii 采用 Rust 内存倒排索引核心（lokii-core）+ 纯原生 Swift/AppKit 前端的架构，在数十万文件规模下依然提供亚毫秒级延迟与极低的资源消耗。 核心特性 1. 亚毫秒级即时检索：输入字符的同时结果瞬时呈现在屏幕上，50 万级文件检索延迟 < 10ms，常驻内存占用极低（< 100MB）。 2. 多模式智能识别：支持纯子串匹配、通配符（, ?）、正则表达式（^...$）以及模糊拼写容错（Fuzzy）。 3. FSEvents 实时无感监听：基于 macOS 多路 FSEvents 增量事件流与防抖队列，文件增删改移与重命名实时自动同步，日常待机 CPU 开销接近为零。 4. 全键盘极速流交互： 全局快捷键呼出（⌘⇧Space） 方向键平滑导航，Enter 访达中直达定位 ⌘C 一键复制完整文件路径，Esc 瞬间隐藏退出 5. 纯原生 AppKit 视觉质感：高信息密度原生虚拟列表、自适应斑马纹、系统原生文件图标渲染与轻量视窗动效。 6. 持久化紧凑缓存：基于 bitcode 紧凑二进制格式序列化存储索引，启动瞬间热加载恢复就绪状态。 7. 100% 离线与隐私优先：纯本地运行，没有任何账号系统，零网络请求、零遥测与追踪埋点，文件名与目录结构绝不离开您的 Mac。

projects.title: Atlarix CLI
projects.summary: Atlarix CLI is an AI coding agent for your terminal. Run atlarix in any project and ask it to build, fix or explain something. - Five modes on shift+tab: Build, Explore, Plan, Debug, Review - Any model: Atlarix Auto, your own key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek...) or local via Ollama / LM Studio - Every edit is a diff you approve; commands run in a per-OS sandbox - Sub-agents and background jobs you can watch live - Shares sessions and keys with the Atlarix desktop app Free.

projects.title: Nexo
projects.summary: Nexo brings your team's chat, tasks, sprints, calls and guest meetings into one app, built for teams of 2–20. Turn any message into a task with assignee, due date and checklist, plan sprints with burndown charts, and jump on a voice or video call with one click. Files are encrypted at rest, each with its own key. Web app plus desktop apps for Windows, macOS and Linux that update themselves. Free, no card needed. Available in English and Spanish.

projects.title: BrowserDrop
projects.summary: BrowserDrop lets you access your Android files from any desktop browser over your local Wi-Fi. Pick a folder on your phone, scan a QR code, and start browsing, previewing, downloading, and uploading files. No USB cable. No cloud storage. No desktop app. No account required. Your files stay on your local network, making BrowserDrop a simple and private way to move files between Android and your computer.

projects.title: MVP launch
projects.summary: NoSnooze is a task-based alarm clock for people who keep hitting snooze. Instead of simply tapping a button to dismiss your alarm, you must complete a mission to prove you're awake — solve a math problem, shake your phone, take a photo, or complete a memory challenge. Build wake-up streaks, track your progress, and turn waking up early into a habit. No snooze. No shortcuts. Just wake up.

projects.title: Notice – Mindful Screen Time
projects.summary: Notice is a free iOS timer for mindful screen time. It sits in the Dynamic Island and works with Shortcuts so you can see how long you have been on your phone. It is about noticing how long you have been on your phone, not blocking apps. No account required.

projects.title: 做了个查 AI 用量的 App
projects.author: chenzhe
projects.summary: 做了个 App 叫 **usAge**：连上账号，用了多少、什么时候重置、还剩多少钱，一屏看清；放个小组件在桌面，抬头就能看到。 ![]( https://source.usage.o-c.do/site/posts/v2ex/cover.jpg) ## 支持哪些服务 Claude 、Codex 、Cursor 、智谱 GLM / Z.ai 、Kimi 、MiniMax 、Xiaomi MiMo 、Qoder 、OpenRouter 、DeepSeek （鸿蒙版的 Qoder 在下个版本）。 - 订阅制看已用比例和重置倒计时，按量付费看余额和花销 - 网页登录或者填 API Key 都能连 - 没有你在用的？ App 里可以申请接入，直接回帖也行 ## 主要功能 - **一屏看全部额度**：5 小时窗口、每周额度、Token 消耗、账号信息，点开就有 - **五种小组件**：基础、数码管、贡献图、LED 、卡包，小中大三种尺寸，一个最多放 4 个账号。小组件上能直接切换额度、刷新，Codex 有重置卡时也能在小组件上直接用掉 - **分享卡片**：Token 战绩、额度状态、AI 花销三种，可以拿来晒 - **多设备同步**：Apple 设备走 iCloud ，华为设备走云空间，手机上连一次，其他设备自动出现 ![]( https://source.usage.o-c.do/site/posts/v2ex/iphone.jpg) ![]( https://source.usage.o-c.do/site/posts/v2ex/widgets.jpg) Mac 版除了主窗口还有菜单栏，会读本机日志，显示今天 Codex CLI 和 Claude Code 用了多少 Token 、大概花了多少钱； Siri 、快捷指令、聚焦搜索里也能直接查额度和刷新。 ![]( https://source.usage.o-c.do/site/shots/zh-Hans/mac-detail.jpg) 鸿蒙版支持手机、平板和电脑，大屏是侧边栏两栏布局。Apple Watch 上抬腕也能看。 ![]( https://source.usage.o-c.do/site/press/zh-Hans/screens/harmony-pc-status.png) ![]( https://source.usage.o-c.do/site/posts/v2ex/watch.jpg) ## 凭证安全 - 不注册也能用 - Cookie 、API Key 、OAuth 令牌只存在本机系统钥匙串里 - 查用量的请求由你的设备直接发给各服务商，**不经过我的服务器** - 同步走你自己的 iCloud / 华为云空间，凭证字段加密存储，可以随时关 - 服务器只存 usAge 账号和购买记录，用来在别的设备上恢复 Pro ## 价格 - 免费版：连接 1 个服务，所有小组件样式和分享卡片都能用 - Pro：¥15 一次买断，不限连接数量，没有订阅、没有广告 - 登录 usAge 账号后，Pro 在 Apple 、鸿蒙、安卓之间通用 - 鸿蒙首发特惠 ¥6 ，到 10 月 30 日 不想先连账号的话，设置里打开「演示数据」就能把所有界面看一遍。 ## 下载 - **Mac**：已上架 Mac App Store → https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/id6812881047 - **iPhone / iPad / Apple Watch**：1.1 **正在等待审核**，过审后同一个链接就能下。（ 1.0 审了 12 天还没结果，索性撤回，直接拿 1.1 首发） - **鸿蒙（手机 / 平板 / 电脑）**：今天刚上架华为应用市场 → https://appgallery.huawei.com/app/detail?id=ltd.zhe.usage - **安卓**：官网直装版 → https://usage.o-c.do/zh-Hans/android ，Google Play 版也在审核中 - 官网： https://usage.o-c.do 系统要求：iOS / iPadOS 18.6+、macOS 15.6+、watchOS 10+、HarmonyOS 6.1+、Android 12+

projects.title: Factorai
projects.summary: Fatcorai is the Agentic Development Environment (ADE) for the AI era. It is a free, community-driven, open-source desktop app for running coding agents. Sessions, not files, are the unit of work: see which agent is working or waiting on you, review its diff, search every conversation and schedule routines.

projects.title: [开源] ALTRun: 不到 1 MB 的 Windows 启动器, 操作方式参照 Alfred, 支持拼音首字母和 Everything
projects.author: zhugecaomao
projects.summary: 大家好, 分享一个我自己每天在用的小工具: ALTRun, 一个 Windows 上的启动器 (类似 macOS 的 Alfred, 以及 Windows 上的 Listary, Wox、PowerToys Run、Raycast, ALTRun(Pascal)、RunZ)。 按 `Alt+Space`, 输入几个字母, 按 `Enter`: 打开程序、找文件、算数、搜网页、翻剪贴板历史, 都在一个窗口里完成。 ![搜索窗口]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhugecaomao/ALTRun/main/docs/images/screenshots/search.png) ## 为什么又做一个启动器 以前一直用老牌的 [ALTRun]( https://github.com/etworker/ALTRun) (etworker 用 Pascal / Delphi 写的) 和 [RunZ]( https://github.com/goreliu/runz) (AutoHotkey), 小巧顺手, 但我还想要拼音首字母、Everything 文件搜索、剪贴板历史、文字片段这些功能, 以及更现代的界面。也试过 Wox、PowerToys Run、Listary 等, 不是太大 (几十上百 MB, 常驻占内存), 就是中文支持一般, 或者和 Total Commander 配合不好。 所以用 AutoHotkey v2 重新写了一个: 名字沿用 ALTRun, 向原作致敬, 也借鉴了 RunZ 的设计; 操作方式参照 Alfred; 之后一直按自己每天的使用习惯打磨。 ## 几个特点 - **小**: 下载不到 1 MB, 解压后约 2 MB, 不需要 .NET、Electron 或其他运行库 - **便携**: 免安装、不写注册表、不需要管理员权限, 数据都在 `Data\` 文件夹里, 放 U 盘或同步盘都行 - **拼音首字母**: `wx` → 微信, `vsc` → Visual Studio Code, 匹配的字会高亮 - **越用越准**: 记住每次输入选了哪个结果, 常用的自动排前面 - **文件搜索**: 装了 Everything 就毫秒级搜全盘, 没装用内置索引; 输入 `D:\Projects\` 可以逐级浏览文件夹, `Tab` 补全 - **多合一**: 计算器 (单位、进制、日期、汇率)、网页搜索、浏览器书签、剪贴板历史 (文字 / 文件 / 图片, 可置顶)、文字片段 (`;关键字` 自动展开)、切换窗口、40 多个 Windows 设置页面、系统命令 - **全键盘**: `→` 打开操作面板 (管理员运行、打开所在位置、复制路径、属性...), `F3` 直接编辑, `Ctrl+1`~`Ctrl+9` 直接打开第 N 项 - **Total Commander 用户友好**: 打开 / 保存对话框里 `Ctrl+G` 跳到 TC 当前目录; `Insert` 标记多个文件后一起操作; 文件管理器可以设成 TC - **个性化**: 简体中文 / 繁體中文 / English / 日本語界面, 20 套内置主题, 可跟随系统深浅色 - **隐私**: 不收集任何数据, 只联网检查更新 (开启货币换算后每天下载一次汇率) | 操作面板 | 剪贴板历史 | |:---:|:---:| | ![操作面板]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhugecaomao/ALTRun/main/docs/images/screenshots/actions.png) | ![剪贴板]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhugecaomao/ALTRun/main/docs/images/screenshots/clipboard.png) | ## 下载和安装 - GitHub: https://github.com/zhugecaomao/ALTRun (GPL-3.0, 开源免费) - 官网: https://zhugecaomao.github.io/ALTRun/ - 直接下载 [最新版本]( https://github.com/zhugecaomao/ALTRun/releases/latest), 解压后运行 `ALTRun.exe` - 或者用 Scoop: `scoop bucket add altrun https://github.com/zhugecaomao/ALTRun` 然后 `scoop install altrun` 装好后按 `Alt+Space`, 输入 `?` 可以看到全部用法。有新版本时搜索窗口里会提示, 按 `Enter` 就能更新。 欢迎试用和提意见, 有 bug 或想要的功能可以在这里回复, 也可以去 GitHub 提 issue。觉得好用的话, 给个 Star 就是最大的支持 🙏

projects.title: Quota
projects.summary: Quota is a free, open-source desktop app for keeping track of your AI tools without opening each provider's dashboard. It shows subscription allowances, reset times and API credit balances in your tray or a floating widget. You can add multiple accounts for integrations that support it.

projects.title: Kishi Notch
projects.summary: Kishi Notch turns your MacBook notch into an interactive island: reply to WhatsApp, Messages and Mail notifications, join your next meeting in one click, control music, run timers and see AirPods battery. Plus a detailed menu bar battery.

projects.title: Boop
projects.summary: Boop puts 24,563 kaomoji one tap away on iPhone and one shortcut away on Mac. 37 moods, instant search, saved favorites. Type "shrug", get ┐( ˘_˘)┌, in any app. Free, offline, no accounts, no ads, no tracking.

projects.title: Interview Signal
projects.summary: A desktop app for recruiters and hiring managers. During the interview: a live transcript and a question guide built from the job description, with follow-ups. After it: a scorecard where every score carries the candidate's own words, checked against the transcript, plus a client submittal in about a minute. It captures the call on your own computer, so no bot joins, on Zoom, Teams, Meet or phone. Transcripts stay on your machine. Free 20-minute trial, no card.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】nerf-watch：检查 Claude Code 和 Codex 有没有悄悄变笨或变贵
projects.author: Abelo9996

github.name: Abelo9996/nerf-watch
github.description: Find out when your coding agent quietly got worse or more expensive. Local-first checks on Claude Code and Codex session logs, no telemetry.

projects.summary: nerf-watch 读取 Claude Code 和 Codex 已经写在你电脑上的会话日志，告诉你 Agent 有没有在你没改任何设置的情况下"悄悄变了"：实际回答的模型和你选的不一样、推理强度降了、CLI 升级后每轮的缓存写入翻倍、缓存命中率掉了、工具调用出错变多。 很多人觉得"更新之后变笨了""额度掉得更快了"，但没法验证。数据其实就在本地日志里。我第一版在自己的日志上报了 6 个警告，结果全是误报（子智能体的流量混进了平均值），现在只比较主对话、要求变化在至少两个项目里都出现才报警，每条结论都写明有多少数据支撑。 完全本地运行，不联网，MIT 协议。还有一个 macOS 菜单栏小工具，变化时图标变红。 bash npx nerf-watch check

projects.title: DotQuit
projects.summary: DotQuit is an open-source, lightweight macOS menu bar utility written natively in Swift. Closing an app's last window on macOS often leaves it idling in memory. DotQuit solves this by gracefully quitting apps when their last window closes. • Native Swift with ~19MB RAM footprint • AXObserver-based gentle termination (no force-kill) • Customizable app whitelist • Apple Notarized & open source (GPLv3)

projects.title: BusinessOS
projects.summary: BusinessOS just shipped 40 free instant tools — VAT calculator, GST calculator, invoice number generator, freelance hourly rate calculator, break-even, MRR/CAC/LTV calculators, receipt generator, and 32 more. Each runs entirely in your browser, no signup, copies the answer to your clipboard. Plus the full app: private, offline-first, encrypted invoicing + expenses + reports. Voice-to-invoice in 3 seconds. WhatsApp send on every invoice. Free during limited early access.

projects.title: Review
projects.summary: Free desktop app for reviewing Git branches and GitHub PRs. Comment on any line and keep comments private until you publish. Add AI reviewers with your own models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter or local via Ollama. Split the review across a team of models, see exactly which rules each one checked, and retry only what was missed. Open source (MIT), no account, for Mac, Windows and Linux.

projects.title: IGDL
projects.summary: Save Instagram reels and photos by swapping one word IGDL downloads public Instagram reels, videos, photos and full carousels from a link, with no login and no app. The shortcut: change instagram.com to igdl.app in any post link and the download starts by itself. 26 languages, nothing stored.

projects.title: PickPDF
projects.summary: Edit PDFs in your browser without uploading them. PickPDF lets you change existing text, redact content, sign documents, fill forms, merge pages and run OCR on scans. Use the built-in on-device AI to summarize and explain your PDF. Start free with no account. Desktop apps are available for Windows, macOS and Linux, plus Chrome and Edge extensions. Optional external AI connections send context to your chosen provider.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】HeadOrbit：戴着 AirPods 用头操作 Mac，歪头语音输入、转头模糊屏幕
projects.author: cogria

github.name: Cogria-AI/HeadOrbit
github.description: Your AirPods know where you're looking. macOS menu bar app: look-away blur and posture reminder from AirPods head tracking.

projects.summary: 阮老师好，自荐一个 macOS 菜单栏小工具 HeadOrbit，用头的动作操作 Mac，不用摄像头。 AirPods Pro、AirPods 4 这类耳机里有运动传感器，苹果拿它做空间音频的头部追踪。HeadOrbit 读的就是这份数据：扭头、点头、歪头三个动作，左右上下六个方向，每个方向可以绑一件事。 比如语音输入。向左歪头，HeadOrbit 按住 Fn，长按 Fn 听写的输入法开始听你说话（用豆包输入法实测过）；头摆正，Fn 松开；再向右歪一下，就是回车。 另外几个内置场景： 转头模糊：头向左或向右转过 35°，持续 0.6 秒，整个屏幕模糊，转回来就清楚。有人走到身后时用得上。 坐姿提醒：塌腰的时候下巴会慢慢抬起来继续看屏幕，抬头超过 15° 持续 5 秒，屏幕模糊，提示坐直。只看抬头，低头看键盘不算。 颈部活动（2.1 新加）：屏幕上出现一条轨迹，用头跟着描，绕环和画 8 字。 触发角度、延时、按键都能改，也可以自己建场景。

projects.title: Patchcord
projects.summary: Patchcord is a macOS menu bar app that runs any Audio Unit plugin on your mic and hands the result to Zoom, Teams, Meet or Discord as a virtual mic. Use free plugins like RNNoise or pro tools like Antinode Clear. Every mic gets its own EQ with a live spectrum, switching mics mid-call just works, and Patchcord Camera keeps you in lip sync. Free to use, 7-day Pro trial, Pro is a one-time purchase. No account, no subscription.

projects.title: TinyOwl
projects.summary: TinyOwl — local image compression for Mac. Your images never leave your device. Batch compress PNG, JPG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, TIFF & AVIF. Save reusable presets (resize → compress → convert → upload), run from menu bar, clipboard or Finder. Optional direct upload to R2, S3, OSS or COS — public link for every file. Rust-powered, fast on Apple Silicon. One-time $9 (regular $15), 7-day free trial — no subscription, no account. One license, 2 Macs, lifetime updates. https://tinyowl.app

projects.title: Gulp
projects.summary: Gulp is a scratchpad that forgets. Press a shortcut, type or say a quick note, and a goldfish in your Mac's menu bar holds it for a few hours while the ink turns gold. Then it's gone. No account, no sync, no history. Free.

projects.title: USA Lead Extractor
projects.summary: Discover, organize, and export verified US business contacts in minutes. Get emails, phone numbers, and social media links with our powerful, precision-engineered desktop app.Meet USA Lead Extractor - a desktop tool designed to help you find, organize, and export business contacts across the United States. Search by category and city, collect business information, build custom prospect lists, and export your data to Excel or CSV.

projects.title: PressDeck
projects.summary: PressDeck turns supported Volume Up and Volume Down double presses and long presses into shortcuts for actions you choose, including launching apps, controlling media, opening Android settings, toggling the flashlight, or asking Android to take a system screenshot. Unlike a general macro engine, it stays focused and deterministic. A guided compatibility test checks what your device can support, and accepted button events are processed on-device.

projects.title: PixDok
projects.summary: Crop e-Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID, ABHA & Ayushman PDFs to exact 85.6×54mm PVC card size. Free, print-ready A4 layouts. Plus PDF editor, passport photo & background remover.
projects.summaryZh: 把 e-Aadhaar、PAN、选民证、ABHA 和 Ayushman PDF 裁成 85.6×54mm PVC 卡尺寸，生成可打印 A4 版式，并支持 PDF 编辑、护照照和背景移除。
projects.summaryEn: Crop e-Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID, ABHA & Ayushman PDFs to exact 85.6×54mm PVC card size. Free, print-ready A4 layouts. Plus PDF editor, passport photo & background remover.

projects.title: Principal Plan
projects.summary: Principal Plan is envelope-based budgeting software for Windows and Mac. Give every dollar a job when it arrives and see what's safe to spend before you spend it. It's a native desktop app, not a web app: it works offline, needs no account, and keeps your financial data on your own computer. Import bank files (CSV, OFX/QFX, QIF), reconcile statements, and use the optional iPhone and Android companion to check envelope balances on the go. Free 60-day trial.

projects.title: Meeting Buddy
projects.summary: Meeting Buddy is a tiny meeting reminder for macOS that helps you stay focused without missing your next meeting. When it’s time, Buddy Pig jumps and parachutes down from your menu bar to grab your attention, even while you’re working full-screen. See your upcoming meetings, join with one click, or snooze when needed. It’s not another calendar. It’s a little companion that makes sure you’re where you need to be.

projects.title: What Happened
projects.summary: Tell your Mac what's wrong in your own words. What Happened records what your Mac does every ten seconds, so it can answer "why was my Mac slow at noon?" with names, and then fix it with your OK. Fixes are one click from the menu bar, the cleaner and uninstaller move things to the Trash with Undo, Space maps your disk, and an MCP server lets Claude Code or Codex read how your own apps behaved. Your history stays on your Mac.

projects.title: Clippio
projects.summary: Clippio is a native macOS clipboard manager that saves unlimited copy-paste history locally, opens with ⌥ Space from any app, and stays 100% offline — no cloud, no telemetry. Search in milliseconds, multi-paste in sequence, extract text from screenshots with on-device OCR, expand snippets likereply, and own it forever.

projects.title: Zack Typing
projects.summary: Zack Typing turns speech into text on Windows. Click into an email, document or chat, use the recording shortcut and speak. Pause and continue when you need to. Improve or Shorten your draft, keep the Original, and edit the text without recording again. Add names and specialist terms to your dictionary or import your own audio notes. Free and paid plans available.

projects.title: Nomadic
projects.summary: Nomadic is a desktop app for the whole job search: learning roadmaps, openings read from company hiring pages, application forms that fill themselves, and one board to track it all.

projects.title: Search On Mac
projects.summary: Search your Mac by describing what you remember. SearchOnMac finds files, apps, windows, and clipboard history with fast, native macOS search.

projects.title: XF1 Mouse 
projects.summary: XF1 Mouse brings trackpad-style gestures to any regular mouse on your Mac. Hold the right button, draw a quick stroke and let go. Flick left or right to switch desktops, up for Mission Control, and use simple combos to change tabs, close or reopen them, minimize windows and more. There are 25+ built-in actions, and you can record your own gestures and map them to any shortcut. A normal right-click still works like always. No account, nothing leaves your Mac, and it's free during early access.

projects.title: Netra
projects.summary: Your Mac notch is empty black space. This puts a pair of cute eyes there. They follow your cursor, blink, and look sleepy when you step away. Click them and you get the useful stuff: a focus timer, a clipboard, a shelf to hold files you are working on, music controls for Spotify, Apple Music, and YouTube, and a simple view of which apps you used.It stays in the notch. No extra window. The eyes are the fun part. The tools are why you might keep it.

projects.title: CleanClip
projects.summary: CleanClip is a privacy-first browser extension that turns messy copied text into clean plain text, Markdown, or simplified rich text. Remove tracking links, invisible characters, weird spacing, unwanted formatting, and other clipboard junk while keeping useful structure like headings, lists, and links. Everything runs locally in your browser with no account, no analytics, and no cloud processing.

projects.title: Remote Clipboard
projects.summary: Copy on one device. Paste on another. Remote Clipboard syncs text and files in real time through a short-lived room link. Use it from a browser or the rclip CLI on laptops, phones, servers and virtual machines. Share with people or let AI agents drop off results, pick up files and pass work between agents. Keep multiple named clipboards, restrict private rooms to invited emails, and choose when everything expires. Public rooms need no sign-in.

projects.title: Orcyx
projects.summary: Orcyx is a local-first desktop app for running several coding agents at once. Multi-pane terminals, a terminal-linked IDE, an embedded browser and a markdown knowledge graph with its own MCP server share one window. Each agent works in its own git worktree. An auditor reviews what comes back, and the merge stays your call. You bring your own provider key. Windows today; macOS and Linux are coming.

projects.title: Copilot Computer Use
projects.summary: Computer use is a new public preview feature in GitHub Copilot CLI and the GitHub Copilot app for macOS and Windows, built by GitHub. It lets Copilot read on-screen content and click, type, scroll, and drag across desktop applications, including legacy GUI-only software with no API or CLI. Users approve access before Copilot controls an app, and macOS walks through the needed Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions.

projects.title: Orcylo
projects.summary: Orcylo is the Activity Monitor alternative for Mac 🖥️ 📦 Groups ~700 processes into the ~25 apps you actually use 📈 30 days of history: see what slowed your Mac, even after the fact 🚨 Smart alerts when an app misbehaves 🤖 Claude Code & Codex usage limits right in your menu bar ⚡ Native, lightweight, stays out of your way Stop guessing why your Mac is slow. 🚀

projects.title: 【开源自荐】一款开源的网页策略游戏（支持AGENT一键接入托管）
projects.author: athlan20
projects.summary: SLG：一款开源的网页三国策略游戏，可以自己建城、征兵、攻城，也可以把令牌交给 Claude、ChatGPT 或自己写的脚本，让 AI 按同样的规则 24 小时替你经营，离线时还会给你写日报。支持 MCP，一行配置就能接入。 在线公测： （Google / GitHub 登录，中英文界面） 开源仓库（MIT）： 为什么做这个 SLG 游戏拼的是谁更肝：半夜收资源、掐点出兵、提防偷袭。我想反过来：让游戏本身就是给 AI 玩的，人可以亲自上手，也可以只负责定方向。 它和一般的「AI 对战平台」不同 这是一款完整的游戏：15 种建筑、11 个兵种互相克制、多回合战斗、世界地图、名城、武将、科技、全服事件、玩家对抗。人类玩家完全可以自己玩。 服务端不跑任何 AI，智能全部由玩家自带；网页和 AI 走同一套协议、同一套校验，没有专门给 AI 的后门。 AI 只能用令牌登录，拿不到账号密码，令牌随时可以重置。 提供 MCP 插件（npx -y slg-mcp），Claude Desktop、Cursor、Claude Code 里加一段配置就能直接说「帮我打三国」。 排行榜可以按 AI 模型分组，看哪个大模型最会打仗。 技术栈：Node.js + Fastify + 标准 WebSocket + PostgreSQL，前端 React。

projects.title: Show HN: Claude Code Routine Session Cleanup Skill
projects.author: naw103
projects.summary: Claude Code's scheduled tasks (routines) leaves a session behind on every run and in the desktop app you can only delete them one at a time. We had 618 open sessions in just one routine. The skill plans the clean up (keeps the newest N and protect any sessions where you typed a reply - optional) and then has Claude delete through the apps own session tool, 25 per call each behind an approval card. I tried just deleting the sessions on disk manually first but deleting the files directly dosnt work because the app keeps the list in memory and writes records back. The apps delete tool is turned off inside routine runs so the clean up command has to run from a normal conversation session. The planner is a single python file that dosnt delete by itself so you can run it by hand to see where everything exists.

projects.title: Show HN: Agents Sleep Preventer – keep your Mac awake only while AI agents work
projects.author: Charlon
projects.summary: I run several Claude Code and Codex sessions in parallel and kept coming back to either a sleeping Mac with half-finished work, or a Mac that stayed up all night because I'd left caffeinate on. Agents Sleep Preventer hooks into the agents' own configs (Claude Code, Codex, Hermes), so it knows when each session is actually working. It keeps the Mac awake only then, lid closed included, and lets it sleep when they're done. The menu bar lists every session by project and branch: which are working, which need you and why ("Claude needs your permission to use Bash"), and the background commands each one still runs, with a Stop button. "Sleep when done" puts the Mac to sleep once everything finishes, with an optional time limit for agents that poll forever. It also does local push-to-talk dictation (Whisper or Parakeet, nothing leaves the Mac). Free, MIT, Rust + Swift. macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon, plus a Windows build.

projects.author: honestTai

github.name: honestTai/HRouter-Desktop
github.description: A local-first desktop workbench for AI coding agents: providers, keys, models, profiles, routing and usage. Optional HRouter key quick setup. Built on CC Switch.

projects.summary: 自荐一个 MIT 开源桌面工具：HRouter Desktop，用于集中管理 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编程工具的供应商配置和模型线路。 做这个工具的起因是频繁切换模型：Claude Code 一份配置，Codex 一份，Gemini CLI 又是一份，每次换供应商都要重新找 Key、端点和模型映射，改完还担心覆盖原有配置。我希望把这些接入操作集中到一个工作台，让使用者少折腾配置，多专注编程。 主要功能 统一接入工作台：覆盖 Claude Code、Claude Desktop、Codex、Gemini CLI、OpenCode 等 11 个 Agent；可接入官方供应商、自建端点和兼容服务。 先看变更，再切配置：主动开启 Claude / Codex 配置保护后，可保留自定义字段、预览变更、保存本地快照，并在恢复前检查冲突。 为模型准备备用线路：配置主备供应商及精确模型路由，在支持的本地代理模式下自动故障转移。不同 Agent 的支持范围不同，并非全部都支持代理接管。 常用配置存成方案：保存供应商、MCP、Skills 的选择，重新应用前先检查。接入方案不等于完整配置备份。 用量可视化：查看请求、Token、缓存和本地费用估算，提供浮动用量窗口与 macOS 桌面小组件。费用估算仅供参考，不是供应商账单。 使用桌面工具不需要 HRouter 账户，也不要求使用 HRouter 服务；可自行选择已有供应商。 界面预览 以 Agent 为中心的接入工作台： 模型线路与备用供应商管理： 与 CC Switch 的关系 项目基于 Jason Young 及贡献者开发的 CC Switch，保留原作者版权与 MIT 许可证，独立维护，不是上游官方发行版。 上游的供应商、代理、MCP、Skills、会话和用量基础能力仍然保留；本分支主要围绕 Agent 优先的界面、配置保护流程、可复用的接入方案、精确模型主备链和兼容性修复进行扩展，不将继承能力包装为新发明。这是本分支的改动说明，不代表当前上游缺少所有对应能力。 下载与

projects.title: 【开源自荐】atv-core：用 iPhone 自带的 Apple TV 遥控器控制 Android TV 和 Mac
projects.author: corvofeng
projects.summary: atv-core 让 iPhone 控制中心自带的 Apple TV 遥控器，可以直接操控 Android TV 和 Mac。手机端无需安装额外 App，也不需要购买 Apple TV。 图文介绍与使用指南 我是项目作者，做它是为了方便在沙发上控制电视，以及接在客厅电视上的 Mac mini。找不到电视遥控器时，可以直接从手机控制中心调出遥控器；用 Mac 看视频或听音乐时，也可以随手移动鼠标、调音量和控制播放。 使用时，在电视或 Mac 上安装接收程序，手机与目标设备接入 同一局域网，再从 iPhone 遥控器中选择设备并配对即可。iPhone 端无需安装，电视或 Mac 端需要安装接收程序。 iPhone：找到遥控器，开始使用 从屏幕右上角下滑打开控制中心，点击「Apple TV 遥控器」，选择已运行接收程序的设备并完成配对，就可以滑动和点按操作。 | 找到遥控器 | 使用遥控器 | | :---: | :---: | | | | Android TV 端效果 接收程序显示配对信息和连接状态。连接后，滑动手机触控板即可移动电视界面的焦点，点按确认打开当前项目。 | 接收程序 | 电视桌面 | 焦点移动后 | | :---: | :---: | :---: | | | | | Mac 端效果 Mac 端提供菜单栏应用，手机触控板可以用于移动鼠标，也支持方向键模式和媒体控制。下面是操作时的 Web 面板预览，可以查看触控轨迹、按键事件和音量状态。 | Mac 端操作预览：触控轨迹与遥控状态 | | :---: | | | 主要功能： Android TV：滑动触控板移动焦点，支持确认、返回、主页及媒体控制。 macOS：将触控板操作转换为鼠标移动，也支持方向键模式、音量调节和播放控制。 局域网连接：手机与目标设备在同一局域网内完成发现和配对。 实现原理很简单：在 Android TV 或 Mac 上模拟 Apple TV 的通信服务，接收 iPhone 发来的遥控事件，再转换为目标设备的按键、鼠标或媒体操作。项目以 MIT 协议开源。 目前提供 Android APK，以及 Apple Silicon、Intel Mac 的 DMG 安装包。首次使用需要配置相应权限：Mac 需要 辅助功能权限；Android TV 根据输入模式配置 ADB 调试和无障碍服务，详细步骤见项目文档。不同电视系统的权限入口和功能支持可能有所差异。 项目源码 安装包下载 欢迎有类似使用场景的朋友尝试，并反馈设备兼容性和使用问题。

projects.summary: 一句话分工： Herdr = 让 Agent 一直跑着、并排管理 Herduck = 记住一项活的目标 / 做到哪了 / 卡在哪 / 下一步，以及能翻回去的记录 互补，不替代。 官网 https://www.herduck.com 仓库 https://github.com/wenhanweime/herduck 上一帖 https://www.v2ex.com/t/1243952 GitHub Discussion （求反馈） https://github.com/wenhanweime/herduck/discussions/2 也在 Herdr Show and tell 发了一帖： https://github.com/herdrdev/herdr/discussions/4822 已有能力（还很早期）： - 工作 / Agents / 项目 / 会话 四个入口 - 相关对话尽量自动收拢到同一项活（可配置；也有偏本地关键词的路径） - Agent 会话自动起名；闲置一段时间可睡眠，释放内存 - herduck 命令让 Agent 读 / 更新工作计划 - 兼容 Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode / Pi / Gemini CLI / Cursor ；快捷键尽量跟 Herdr 对齐 本轮对外动作： - 仓库 homepage 指向 herduck.com - README 首屏补了官网链接和 Demo 占位 - 开了反馈 Discussion 仍已知的坑：源码安装需要 Rust / Zig / just ； macOS 需按文档重签名；早期不稳定点欢迎 Issue 。 求反馈： 1. 自动把对话归到同一项活，误伤多不多？ 2. 闲着就睡的阈值是否合理？ 3. 和纯 Herdr 并用时，哪些界面显得重复？ 安装最短路径： ``` git clone https://github.com/wenhanweime/herduck.git cd herduck just install herduck ``` 欢迎 star / Issue / 一起维护。给 Herdr 用户补「隔天接得上」，不是抢跑 Agent 那一层。 少数派长文已投稿待审（大白话版）：多开 Agent 几天后，最烦的是隔天接不上

projects.title: Show HN: Quiet – exploring when an AI assistant should intervene
projects.author: roger05
projects.summary: I’m Ruggiero, a CS student working on a research project about humanComputer interaction and AI. I built QUIET because I’ve been thinking about a problem with current AI interfaces: they usually either wait for an explicit prompt, or try to take over a task. I wanted to explore a different relationship between humans and AI: an assistant that can understand when to stay out of the way, when to point something out, when to teach, and when to act. I’ve built a small interactive demo of this idea. It’s obviously still very early, and I want to understand whether the interaction itself makes sense before trying to build the actual AI system behind it. The prototype is intentionally not AI-powered yet. The four examples are scripted so I can test the interaction itself before spending time building the underlying AI system. The idea is that the assistant can choose different levels/forms of intervention: * stay silent * point at something * explain / teach * do the task The important question for me isn’t whether an AI can perform these actions. Current systems can already do many of them. I’m trying to understand whether an assistant that decides when and how much to intervene is actually useful. I’d particularly like feedback on: * Did the interventions feel helpful or annoying? * Would you want an assistant to behave this way? * When would you prefer it to teach you rather than do something for you? * Does this interaction model make sense even without the AI being there yet? I started working on this because I feel there is an increasing gap between what computers/AI are capable of and what users actually understand and can make use of. At the same time, AI systems are becoming increasingly capable of explaining and performing tasks for us. I’m interested in whether the interface itself should evolve to bridge that gap. Demo: https://quiet-hci.pages.dev I’d really appreciate any criticism, especially if you think the interaction model doesn’t make sense. The demo suit best the desktop screens on phones Im working on a totally different but also similar idea of interaction, and since this is a simulation of the desktop tool it should work best on it , Thank You <3

projects.title: Show HN: Beyond "chat with your database" – agentic data exploration
projects.author: sandhya6
projects.summary: Business intelligence is changing. AI can now do more than turn a question into a single SQL query: it can investigate a question through a series of queries, examining the result of one query to decide what to query next. Today, to answer a business question against a database, analysts use a tool like Tableau: they select relevant data, build an initial view using fields, filters, calculations, and visualizations, then look for patterns or anomalies. They form hypotheses and test them — filtering by region, drilling into customer cohorts, comparing time periods, or creating calculations to validate or rule out an explanation. They repeat this process until the evidence supports an answer, then save a workbook or dashboard for others to review and monitor. With a single question, AI can now perform much of this exploratory loop: it can investigate the data, follow the evidence through multiple queries, and present the supporting analysis. This is agentic data analysis — AI autonomously decides what to investigate next based on the results it has already found. Reportr puts agentic AI at the center of the experience, then builds complementary capabilities around it to address AI's limitations: SEMANTIC LAYER Production databases are rarely clean: columns that are no longer used, cryptic names like status2, misc, or flag, columns whose meaning has quietly shifted over time, tables that linger long after their purpose is gone, and so on. This is known as schema rot. AI tools guess wrong against schemas like this. Reportr's semantic layer lets you give tables and columns business-friendly names and descriptions, document relationships, capture business rules, and flag what AI should ignore — so it's working from what your data means, not just what it's called. USER OVERSIGHT AI-generated answers can be wrong. Reportr lets you inspect the SQL executed to arrive at an answer. It also provides explanations of what the SQL does (understandable by business users), and how it works (intended for technical users). You can review the analysis rather than simply accepting AI's conclusions. BETTER USER EXPERIENCE Reportr UI is specifically optimized for chatting with a database. Database queries often return large number of records. Ask which customers haven't placed an order in the last 90 days, and the answer is a list of customers. Reportr displays tabular data in an interactive grid that can handle thousand of records without breaking a sweat. The grid supports sorting, searching, and filtering. REPORTS AND DASHBOARDS Chat is ephemeral. Every conversation starts fresh, and that's fine for exploration — but not for information you need every week. When a chart or table reveals something worth tracking, save it as a report. Combine reports into dashboards to monitor changes over time, share findings, and keep important insights accessible without having to ask the same questions again. ROLE BASED ACCESS CONTROL Not everyone on your team needs the same level of access. Reportr's role-based access control lets you give each user exactly the permissions they need — from view-only access to report building, database management, and full administrative control. CENTRALIZED MANAGEMENT Reportr is a web application — there's nothing to install, nothing to update, and no desktop app to manage across your team. Database connection strings, AI keys, are all managed centrally. Reportr can connect to all supported databases directly, MCP servers and drivers are not needed. INSTALL ON-PREMISE Reportr can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure, ensuring your data never touches our servers. You can supply your own AI API key. Your data will not be used for training AI models. If you use Claude on AWS Bedrock, Amazon additionally guarantees that your data is never stored or used for training — and Bedrock is HIPAA eligible. GIVE IT A WHIRL Visit https://reportr.com to give it a try. We look forward to getting your feedback. Reportr is easy to try: you can provision a sample database with the press of a button and start asking questions right away. Or connect your own database and analyze your own data. You can ask up to five questions for free.

projects.title: Show HN: Open-source model routing for coding agents at Astra-level performance
projects.author: adchurch
projects.summary: A few months ago we started building a model router for coding agents because we thought we could outperform any single model with an ensemble approach. Recently we’ve achieved that milestone and I want to talk about how we did it. First of all, a quick explanation: the Weave Router ( https://github.com/weave-os/router ) plugs into any coding agent (e.g. Claude Code or Codex) and intelligently switches between LLMs. So, for example, Astra handles tricky debugging or complex system design tasks, and Deepseek v4 Flash handles simple frontend updates. What we’re announcing today is our new routing model, which we’re calling Weave Router 2.0. We benchmarked 2.0 against GPT-6 Astra on Terminal Bench 4.0 and SWE Atlas. On both benchmarks, the router had equivalent pass rates. On Terminal Bench, the router hit 52% of Astra’s cost, and completed tasks 2.2x faster. On SWE Atlas, the router cost 54% as much as Astra and ran 2.5x faster. (Full results on our website at https://weaveos.com/router !) It turns out training a model to route effectively - taking into consideration model capabilities, costs, cache awareness, and more - is a really hard problem! I want to talk about three ways we were able to improve so much over the last few months: 1) a new architecture, 2) larger training data set size, and 3) smarter cache-eviction impact calculation. 1) a new architecture. Our initial approach used an RL model without many priors. While RL is still an important part of the story, the cost of fully exploring the space of routing decisions is very high, so we’ve taken some shortcuts that have significantly improved performance. Consider how large the search space for the routing problem is. Take a typical coding agent session, with ~100 agent turns (i.e. 100 LLM API calls). Technically there are 100 chances to select a model. If we assume a roster of ~10 models (of course there are lots more but we can remove any that are Pareto dominated), then there are 10^100 possible paths through that session. We simply cannot explore all of them! So that's why clever tricks to shrink this space are so important. In particular: we trained a hidden Markov model to trace the session state, then a classifier maps the session to one of a few buckets of similar models. Using the HMM allows us to evaluate not just where a session is currently, but how it got there . We've gotten significantly better performance on bucket selection by incorporating that information - we believe this is because two sessions that might look quite similar to a naive classifier are much better distinguished by this HMM approach. Using this HMM + classifier to select a bucket first significantly shrinks the space to explore, by throwing out most models that could not reasonably serve the given session. This rearchitecture was the single biggest performance unlock! 2) larger training data set size (much less technically interesting but still an important part of the story). By using frontier LLMs to help us label a larger and more diverse set of coding agent sessions, we were able to bootstrap the two models discussed in 1) to a better state, while also providing even richer reward signals for RL. 3) smarter cache-eviction impact calculation. One of the hardest parts of routing well (if you care about saving money) is using the model caches intelligently. We built a subsystem that can calculate the expected value of switching models (and thus paying a high one-time cost to fill up a different cache) much more accurately, helping us avoid costly and unnecessary switches in more cases, while still switching when the benefit outweighs the cost. This is where most of our improvement on cost has come from. We still have a lot of room to continue to improve (we won’t rest until we’re consistently beating Astra/Fable, not just tying!) but matching frontier model performance was a huge milestone for our routing model, and in my opinion validates our initial hypothesis that an ensemble of models can do better than any single model ever could. Our router is open source ( https://github.com/weave-os/router ) so anyone can try it out. Or if you prefer you can use our hosted version ( https://weaveos.com/router ).

projects.title: [开源推荐] Speech Wingman：中英混说的离线语音与自定义提醒
projects.author: AmethystineAlpaca

github.name: AmethystineAlpaca/speech-wingman
github.description: Offline AI speech companion for macOS: fast Chinese/English mixed-speech previews and custom contextual alerts. Swift + SenseVoice + Qwen3.

projects.summary: Speech Wingman 让你用自然语言写下讲话时想注意的规则，在 Apple Silicon Mac 上本地识别中英混合发言，并在命中时给出原话和简短提醒。新版支持每行独立规则、随发言语言切换提醒，以及桌面悬浮按钮。运行无需云端服务，适合演讲和沟通练习；当前是需要自行构建的源码预览版。 亮点 项目维护者自荐，更新至 0.3.0 源码预览。 离线与隐私： 转录和规则推理在本机完成。应用及辅助进程使用 macOS 沙盒，没有网络权限；不会自动保存录音或会话转录，无需运行时账号或 API key。 独立规则： 每行是一条单独判断的条件，例如“说到 banana 就提醒”和“说汤姆坏话就提醒，赞扬不提醒”。模型只看当前定稿片段，不发送累计对话历史。 中英混说与桌面控制： 同一识别器处理中文、英文和混合发言；提醒语言跟随当前发言。可拖动的悬浮按钮一键开始或停止监听。 可学习的实现： SwiftUI/AppKit + Silero VAD + SenseVoiceSmall + Qwen3 4B，包含音频分段、跨进程推理、逐条规则检查、过期结果取消与引用校验。 有范围的验证： 本次 28 条合成文本用例、14 组核心测试通过；早期短句音频测试约 1 秒出现首段转录（Apple M4 / 16 GB、模型已加载）。这不是提醒延迟或真实场景准确率保证；提醒还需要额外推理时间。 当前需要自行构建，没有现成或公证安装包。要求 Apple Silicon / macOS 14+，建议 16 GB 内存；首次开发准备需要联网下载依赖和模型，构建完成后离线运行。多条规则和长发言可能延迟提醒，模型会有漏报或误报。源码 MIT，模型权重适用各自上游许可，包括 SenseVoiceSmall 的 FunASR 模型协议。

github.name: realAllenSong/ThunderTalk
github.description: 🎙️ Free, open-source local voice toolkit for macOS (Apple Silicon): hotkey dictation in any app, file transcription with speaker labels, and text-to-speech with voice cloning (VoxCPM2, IndexTTS-2.5, Kokoro). 100% on-device. Chinese, English and mixed speech.

projects.summary: 大家好，我是 ThunderTalk 的作者，想自荐一个完全在本机运行的 macOS 语音工具。 ThunderTalk 是一个 MIT 开源、免费的 Mac 语音工具箱，所有模型都在 Apple 芯片上本地运行，录音和文字不离开电脑。它对中文、英文和中英混说做了专门优化。 主要功能： 语音输入：在任何 App 里按快捷键说话，松开就把文字粘贴到光标处。可选 Qwen3-ASR、SenseVoice、Parakeet、MOSS 等多个本地模型。 录音转文字：拖入音频或视频，输出带时间戳的文稿，可以区分说话人，导出 TXT、Markdown、SRT、VTT 或 JSON。 文字转语音：VoxCPM2、IndexTTS-2.5、Kokoro 三个引擎，内置 14 个音色（影视解说、纪录片旁白、新闻主播、Vlog、播客等风格），每个音色都可以先试听。 声音克隆：录 5 到 15 秒自己的声音，就能用它朗读任意文字。 翻译（可选）：用 SeamlessM4T v2 边说边译。 几个实测数字（M3 Max）：VoxCPM2 和 IndexTTS 约为实时速度，Kokoro 在 CPU 上约为实时的 4 倍；生成的语音用独立的识别模型转回文字比对，中英文错误率为 0–3.4%。 安装：brew install --cask realallensong/tap/thundertalk，或从 GitHub Releases 下载。需要 Apple 芯片的 Mac，macOS 15 及以上。

projects.title: 分享一个开源的本机 AI 网关：中转、国产模型、Claude Code、Codex 放在一起管，每个请求花了多少钱都看得到
projects.author: Faz
projects.summary: 先说适合谁：同时用 Claude Code 、Codex ，手上有好几个中转或国产模型的 key ，被 CC Switch 切换折腾过的，可以试试。 ![概览]( https://thinkwat.ch/lite/overview.webp) ## 之前用 CC Switch 的几个痛点 - **切上游总要重启客户端。（ proxy 模式也没有特别好用）** - **Codex 初始化时输入的 key 被它学了过去，结果上游直接炸了。（好像最近修了）** - **Codex 换了供应商，旧会话就接不上**（[#7257]( https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7257)，四十多楼，还开着）。 - **路由弱，切换也不方便。** 一个客户端同时只能用一个供应商；按模型分给不同家（[#3703]( https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/3703)）挂了快四个月没有维护者回复；负载均衡标了不做，理由是会丢缓存（[#842]( https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/842)）；按供应商单独设代理，3.14 起还被去掉了（[#2243]( https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/2243)）。 - **设计和产品力差。** 界面不好看，交互也乱。功能越堆越多：十个客户端、MCP 、Skills 、提示词、会话、用量、几十个供应商预设（里面还有赞助商），核心的切换和路由反而没做好。 - **中转能看到你发出去的全部内容**，它发出前不做任何检查（[#7357]( https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7357) 还开着）。 ## 换成 ThinkWatch Lite 之后 思路不一样：客户端只接一次，指向本机的网关，之后的事都在网关里做。 - **切中转不用重启**：换上游、调路由都在网关里完成，客户端的配置不再动。手动选择的策略组在菜单栏或托盘里就能切。 - **配置只写一次**：接管时只改指向网关的那几项，写之前给完整 diff 、备份原文件，随时能还原。客户端只拿到一把网关专用的 key ，原来的 key 和登录信息不会被导入或拿去用。 - **Codex 会话不再拆开**：Codex 只认一个 provider ，换上游不影响会话列表（接管前的旧会话仍在原来那边）。 - **路由够用**：按模型、token 数、工具、图片、思考等条件分给不同的上游，也能改写模型名；故障转移、轮询、延迟最低、费用最低都有。轮询时同一个会话固定在同一个上游，缓存照常命中。 - **什么格式都能接**：Anthropic 、OpenAI Chat 、Responses 、Gemini 四种格式互相转换。Claude Code 能用 GPT 、Gemini ，Codex 能接只有 Chat 接口的中转。 - **每个请求看得清**：费用、token 、缓存命中、首 token 时间、生成速度，走了哪条规则、依次试了哪几个上游，完整的请求和响应都在。中转可以按倍率计价，请求还能重放到另一个上游对照。菜单栏直接显示今天花了多少，GLM Coding Plan 、ChatGPT 的额度也能看。 - **省套餐额度**：Claude Code 自己发的标题生成、预热这类辅助请求，可以由网关本地应答，不发给上游。 - **中转收不到你的 key**：发出前把 API key 、token 、私钥等换成占位符，响应里回显时再换回来；模型让客户端执行「下载后执行」「外发环境变量」这类命令时，在流式输出中途切断。默认只记录、不拦截，看过日志确认没有误报再打开。 一键接管的客户端：Claude Code 、Codex （包括 ChatGPT 桌面版里的 Codex ）、opencode 、Claude Desktop 、Zed 、Aider 、DeepSeek Harness ； Cursor 、Continue 、Antigravity CLI 有手动配置的说明。Windows 上 WSL 里的 Claude Code 、Codex 也能接（ WSL 1 或 mirrored 网络）。网关还能装在 Linux 服务器上，由桌面端远程管理。 ![流量]( https://thinkwat.ch/lite/traffic.webp) ## 安装 - macOS （ Apple 芯片）：`brew install --cask thinkwatchproject/tap/thinkwatch-lite` - Linux：`curl -fsSL https://github.com/ThinkWatchProject/ThinkWatch-Lite/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh` - Windows （ x64 、ARM64 ）： https://thinkwat.ch/zh-CN/lite/#install GitHub： https://github.com/ThinkWatchProject/ThinkWatch-Lite （ MIT ，数据都在本机，不收集使用数据） 用着有问题，或者想要哪个客户端、上游，欢迎在楼里说。
