projects.title: Jeeves
projects.summary: Jeeves is a desktop app for reusable AI workflows. Set up the steps for a task, run them with your input, and review the result. Start with a weekly update: notes in, draft and check, update out. Change the steps in a visual editor and reuse them next week. Add human input when the workflow should wait for you. Free and open source for Mac, Windows, and Linux.

projects.title: SupaClip
projects.summary: Clipboard history for macOS with search, pins and previews. Press ⌘⇧V, type a few letters, press return. Pay once, no subscription, nothing leaves your Mac.

projects.title: Silkwoven & Co.
projects.summary: Silkwoven & Co. reinterprets South Asian & Himalayan garment heritage—from hand-spun Pashmina and Dhaka jacquards to structured Bandhgalas and Daura-Suruwals—into quiet-luxury tailoring for modern life. Crafted in small ateliers in Nepal and India with zero exterior logos, and engineered with the same restraint: Next.js 16, sub-second performance, strict zero-tracker prior consent, and cryptographic HMAC checkout security. No hype or synthetic shortcuts—just enduring materials and honest drape.

projects.title: Show HN: Chow, a FOSS food diary
projects.author: sltr
projects.summary: Hi HN. Today I'm showing off Chow.fit, a plain-text FOSS food diary written in Gleam. You can self-host it with the Dockerfile or just use the one I host on chow.fit. Why does the world need another food diary app? Well, I can't speak for the whole world, but as for me: I used MyFitnessPal back in 2017-2019. It was mostly tolerable with an ad blocker. A month ago due to numbers I didn't like, I wanted to start tracking calories again. I quickly noticed that in the MFP android app, the barcode scanner is now a paid feature. It felt like paying to use my own phone camera. Their web app is slow and stuck in 2013, so I made my own web app which better aligns with my values and goals. I've lost 5% of my body weight! I like to call an app like this "un-SaaS" because it subverts a lot of the usual SaaS playbook. - Distraction-free. No AI, no ads, no tracking, no engagement-hancing e.g. no activity/news feed. It logs food and gets out of the way. - All features except sync work without a subscription. - An optional subscription enables sync. A year covers my hosting costs and buys me a T-shirt. - Sync is local-first. You can still log food e.g. in an airplane. The app syncs up when you go back online. - If you stop the subscription, the app keeps working without sync. - Your data is plain text files on your device. When SparkPeople shut down in 2021, its users could only download their daily totals. They lost everything else. That can't happen with Chow. - It uses public food data (FDC and OFF), not proprietary - It can import from MyFitnessPal using a bookmarklet to get your auth token which stays local. - It has a desktop app, Android/iOS app, and a CLI. None currently shipped, but you can build from source. Folks who track what they eat: Let me know what else you'd like to see!

projects.title: Downsweep
projects.summary: Downsweep is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app that clears your Downloads folder: installers for apps you already have, byte-for-byte duplicates and files you forgot. Everything goes to the Trash and can be undone. No analytics, no accounts.

projects.title: ZenVoice
projects.summary: ZenVoice is private dictation for Mac. Press a shortcut, speak naturally, and polished text lands in any app. Speech recognition and ZenPolish run on your Mac, even offline. It removes fillers, formats numbers and times, adapts tone to the app, and lets you review text before inserting it. Choose from 14 on-device models, including Parakeet, Whisper, and Hinglish Prime. No account or subscription.

projects.title: LemonSees
projects.summary: Agentless SOC & GRC platform — monitoring, 39 DBs, threat intel over SSH. Windows desktop app.

projects.title: AI Reply Assistant
projects.summary: AI Reply Assistant connects your WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram and Messenger accounts on iPhone and iPad and drafts replies from the actual conversation. Smart Reply gives three drafts you edit and send; nothing goes out without your tap. Summary sorts unread chats into replies needed and FYI. It runs on Apple Intelligence on-device, or Claude with your own key or pay-as-you-go credit, and adds scheduled messages, translation and Apple Shortcuts actions.

projects.title: ClipTen
projects.summary: Copy up to ten things. Paste any of them with one shortcut. Save: Ctrl + C + 1 Paste: Ctrl + V + 1 (⌘ instead of Ctrl on Mac) No history list to open or scroll, unlike Maccy, Ditto or Paste. Each copy stays on its own number key. Works in any app with text, links, images and files. What you copy stays on your computer, encrypted. live For Mac and Windows. Free plan with 5 slot, 30-day trial with all ten, Lifetime from $10.

projects.title: Universal Clipboard
projects.summary: Stop texting yourself links. Universal Clipboard sends text between Android phones, iPhones, iPads and any computer's browser, over the internet: copy on one device, tap the clip on another, paste. On a computer there's nothing to install: open the web app and scan its QR code. It never reads your clipboard in the background, only the text you choose to send. Free to start. Pro keeps a searchable clipboard history that never expires, sorts links, codes and emails, and adds Copy Now alerts.

projects.title: TypeCorrect
projects.summary: Typed “руддщ” instead of “hello”? Double‑tap Shift and TypeCorrect converts the text and switches your keyboard layout. A tiny, private menu bar app for macOS.

projects.title: [开源自荐] Codex 保安：实时审计 OpenAI Codex 在本机做了什么的安全工具
projects.author: jliushi

github.name: jliushi/codex-baoan
github.description: Codex 保安：OpenAI Codex 本机安全审计。实时发现高危命令、凭据访问、提示注入与投毒篡改；只读日志，不代理、不装证书。

projects.summary: Codex 保安是一款 Windows 桌面工具，只读 Codex 自己写在 ~/.codex/sessions 的会话日志，实时检查它执行的命令、改动的文件和读进上下文的内容，发现提权、删库、读取凭据、数据外传、提示注入和配置投毒就提醒你。不代理流量、不装证书、不改任何配置。 亮点 只读日志：不走代理、不装根证书、不改 Codex / CC Switch 配置，删掉不留痕迹 提示注入识别：命令输出、网页、MCP 返回里写给 AI 的指令，包括不可见 Unicode 和 Markdown 图片外带 配置体检：检查 AGENTS.md、config.toml、技能、放行规则、MCP 配置有没有被投毒，并记录哈希对比变化 模型审计：配合 CC Switch 对比请求模型和上游自报模型，发现中转站偷换小模型 每条记录附触发片段、完整命令、所在会话和建议；检测引擎用 Rust 编写并单独测试，MIT 开源

projects.title: Windot
projects.summary: Meet WinDOT, a floating toolkit for Windows that puts everyday tools one shortcut away. Check the weather, manage clipboard history, jot notes, start a timer, calculate, pick screen colors, capture screenshots, stage files, open quick links, and control audio, all from one compact panel.

projects.title: Halo
projects.summary: Halo turns your Mac’s notch into a customizable workspace for music, lyrics, files, timers, clipboard history, notes, launching apps, system controls, and more. Start with a polished preset—or shape the interface around the way you use your Mac.

projects.title: API Keys, without the terminal
projects.summary: A Mac menu bar app that stores your API keys once, in your Mac's own Keychain. Claude Code uses them through a built-in MCP server without ever seeing the value. Touch ID to reveal, every use logged, clipboard clears itself, 400+ services recognized.

projects.title: m’kay
projects.summary: Talk to the AI agents on your Mac from any browser or phone. Other voice apps talk to one assistant. m’kay talks to all your agents: Claude Code, Codex and Cursor on your Mac. Ask which one is done, hear its reply, and tell it what to do next from your phone's browser, on the train, or at the gym. It drives the real desktop apps, so your sessions and projects stay where they are. Nothing is sent until you say "yes" to a read-back. Open source: run it all locally, or use the menu-bar Mac app.

projects.title: History Logger
projects.summary: History Logger is a Windows desktop application for authorized browser activity monitoring and screenshot management. It records browser history, groups consecutive visits into sessions, captures scheduled screenshots, and provides a centralized dashboard for reviewing activity. Key features include session-based history, screenshot management, browser and date filtering, configurable retention, a 24-hour free trial, and Product Key activation. Designed for authorized devices and monitoring use.

projects.title: Desktops
projects.summary: Desktops is a sleek macOS menu bar utility that shows your active desktops at a glance. So you always know where you at, in terms of desktops on macOS. You get the mental picture of your macOS workspace and helps you multitask. Click to switch. Customisable styles. Lightweight and native.

projects.title: Google Indexer
projects.summary: Google Indexer is a fast indexing tool for websites and backlinks. Submit URL lists, get crawl status on every link, and move pages out of “waiting forever” limbo. Flat pricing: $0.39 per URL. Crypto only. No KYC. Refunds if a task fails. If you publish content, build links, or run client SEO — this is the shortcut to getting those URLs fetched.

projects.title: Replaceme
projects.summary: Free native Mac menu bar app. It follows your Mail, Messages and notifications and texts you a short brief through iMessage with what needs your attention. No new inbox, no API key. Runs on Jev, TypeSafe's new decision model, fast and cheap enough to check every message. That's why it's free. Content goes to hosted AI and isn't stored. The privacy page says exactly what leaves your Mac. macOS 14+.

projects.title: Lume
projects.summary: Lume is a native Windows notes app (WinUI 3, no Electron) that stays hidden until you need it. Shake your mouse or press a shortcut, write, and it's gone. Beyond quick notes: a scratchpad that does maths as you type and runs small Python, JS or PowerShell snippets, pen ink right on top of your text, and freehand boards next to your notes. Local-first, optional OneDrive sync. Free for up to 20 notes.

projects.title: OmniMac
projects.summary: Free, open-source macOS menu bar app: a Dynamic Island that works on Macs without a notch, per-app volume and equaliser, window layouts, clipboard, OCR. 0.017–0.033 % CPU.

projects.title: ChatGPT Update Notifier
projects.summary: Well, I kept missing ChatGPT desktop app updates and was suprised that the Linux app did not have an update flow built-in. I am sure OpenAI will eventually address this. Until then, here is a small, unofficial notifier for the ChatGPT desktop app on Linux. The Windows version of the app already has this update-checker feature. It checks the signed OpenAI package repository and reminds you about newer app versions. It never installs an update without your confirmation.

projects.title: Flotnote
projects.summary: Flotnote is a Markdown notepad that floats above every app on your Mac. Hit one shortcut, write the thought down, and get back to work. Every note is a plain Markdown file in a folder you choose, so Obsidian and any other editor can open it right away. Full-text search, wiki-style links, tags, and several floating notes at once. No account, no servers, no subscription.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】OrbCue：替你盯着命令行 Agent 的windows桌面小球，减少你的“上下文切换”
projects.author: QZYH123

github.name: QZYH123/OrbCue
github.description: Desktop orb for Windows that cues you when Claude Code, Grok, Codex or Cursor Agent needs you. Working sessions show a count; waiting/failed sessions get a ? / ! plus a notification. Local-only, hook-based, no conversation reading.

projects.summary: OrbCue 是 Windows 桌面上的一颗悬浮小球，解决的是人在盯着多agent进度时总要专注或者不断"上下文切换"来轮询不同会话的进度的问题，它替你盯着 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Grok Build等命令行 Agent。它利用hook把轮询优化为中断逻辑，把 Windows 和WSL 里的所有会话汇总在一起：谁在工作、谁在等你、谁做完了一眼可见，还会弹通知或推送到手机，点一下就能跳回对应终端。 适合同时跑多个 Agent、或者挂着长任务去做别的事的时候用。项目用 Rust 和 Tauri 2 开发，界面基于Svelte，只读取工具自带的 hook 事件，不读对话内容。 功能： • 状态汇总：所有 Agent 会话汇总到同一颗球上，显示工作中、等待输入、等待授权、完成、失败。 • 多工具接入：支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor CLI、Grok Build，装在 Windows 或 WSL 里的都能接入，其他工具也可以通过命令自行接入。 • 提醒：弹系统通知并响提示音，可选通过 ntfy 推送到手机。 • 跳回终端：点一下回到对应终端。用 orb run 或"原命令启动"开的会话，能精确跳到那个标签页。 • 一键连接：自动发现已安装的工具，一键写入 hook，改之前自动备份，断开时只撤掉自己写的部分。 • 隐私：只读取 hook 事件，不读对话内容，数据只留在本机。 • 小球交互：可以贴边收起、调透明度，支持全局快捷键、开机自启和多套主题。

projects.title: Driftpad
projects.summary: Driftpad is a free Mac menu bar app for notes that clean up after themselves. One click on its icon opens a note that floats above every app, desktop and full-screen window. Type a reminder, number or idea and carry on: after 2 seconds the note turns see-through so it never blocks your work, and when its time runs out (1 minute to 1 hour) it disappears. Pin the notes worth keeping. Hovering or typing pauses the countdown. No permissions, no account, no internet needed. Made by Phantom.

projects.title: Focus Shield
projects.summary: Focus Shield is a free Mac menu bar app that blocks YouTube, Netflix, X, Instagram, LinkedIn and Prime Video in Chrome and Safari. Want to switch it off? First you read three short facts from books on attention by Jonathan Haidt, Johann Hari, Cal Newport and Gloria Mark. Still sure? Pause it for 30 minutes or an hour, and it turns itself back on. New in 1.2: automatic updates. Signed and notarized by Apple, no account needed, and your browsing never leaves your Mac.

projects.title: Loupe for Kubernetes
projects.summary: Loupe is a free, open-source Kubernetes desktop app built in Rust. It reads your kubeconfig and gives you live lists, logs across every replica, shells, port-forwards, Helm, CRDs and diffed YAML edits, with read-only guards on production. Apache-2.0.

projects.title: Waslane
projects.summary: Apple's Continuity stops at the iPhone, Phone Link stops at Windows. Waslane brings your Android phone to your Mac and iPad: mirror and control the screen, send files both ways, read and answer SMS, get notifications with inline reply, share the clipboard, browse photos and contacts. Everything runs over your own Wi-Fi with TLS 1.3, no server, no account, no tracking. Free 7-day trial, then $12.99/year or $29.99 once. The Android companion app is free.

projects.title: videoCn
projects.summary: videoCn is a complete video player for shadcn/ui. One command installs it, and it picks up your project's theme: colors, radius, light and dark mode. Every control is a prop, so there is nothing to rebuild, yet the code is yours to edit. MP4 and WebM play natively; HLS, DASH and live streams go through Shaka Player, loaded only when needed. Features : - chapters - quality selector - keyboard shortcuts - accessible sliders included Free and open source. A lot is coming (subtitles, heatmap...)

projects.title: Deskbit
projects.summary: Native macOS sticky notes with pinning, group selection, auto-arrange, rich text, Markdown shortcuts, and history recovery. Notes stay on your Mac with no account required. Open source under MIT, with English and Simplified Chinese interfaces.

projects.title: Usage Buddy
projects.summary: UsageBuddy gives developers one place to track their Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor usage. Add multiple accounts, see remaining limits and reset times, and get alerts before you run out. Everything is visible in a simple desktop app, so you don’t have to open multiple tools or remember which account has usage left.

projects.title: Godmode Bot
projects.summary: Most AI agents stop at the login screen. Godmode Bot gives Claude a real browser plus a local, encrypted vault for your logins and 2FA codes, and types them into the page itself, so the model never sees a password. Build persistent agents with their own memory (each one is a git repo), cron routines and delegation, plus an inbox where agents report missing logins. Desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux, or self-host it with a web dashboard. Free and MIT.

projects.title: Dial • Time Tracker
projects.summary: A simple time tracker for the Mac menu bar. One click starts a project, another switches, and ⌥⌘T opens it from any app. What makes it different: Dial notices the meetings and calls you forgot to track. It reads your calendar and sees when Zoom, Meet or Teams is using the mic (it never listens), then asks before adding the time. Nothing counts until you say yes. Fully local: no account, no server, your time never leaves your Mac. 11 MB. Free for 7 days, then $49 once or $3.99/month.

projects.title: FileSorter Pro
projects.summary: FileSorter Pro is a lightweight desktop tool that automatically organizes messy folders by file type (images, documents, videos, audio) and batch-renames files with a custom prefix, number, and optional date — all with a preview before anything changes. No command line needed, no complex setup — just pick a folder and go. Built for anyone tired of manually sorting downloads. Works on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

projects.title: Heimdall
projects.summary: The all-seeing, privacy-conscious watchman inside Ruune Desktop. Heimdall reads what's on your screen, matches it against your meetings and conversation history, and drafts the reply right where your cursor is - in Slack, Mail, Chrome, anywhere. He also cleans up dictation on the fly and translates idiomatically, one shortcut per language. Everything stays on your Desktop Better Wisprflow + Granola + Memory graph + AI Assistant with Online, Offline capture

projects.title: Billed
projects.summary: Billed is a lightweight Windows desktop app for freelancers and small businesses who want simple invoicing without recurring fees. Create invoices, generate PDFs, manage clients, track paid/overdue status, and export to Excel — all stored locally on your machine. Pay $4.99 once. No subscriptions, ever.

projects.title: Job Traveler
projects.summary: Job Traveler prints process/job traveler packets and a one-page calibration due list for machine shops. Fill the route or drop a CSV, download a Letter PDF meant for a clip and a tote—not another dashboard. Free samples are watermarked; $29/month unlocks saved jobs and clean PDFs.
projects.summaryZh: Job Traveler 为机加工车间生成工序/工作流转单包与一页校准到期清单，支持填写路线或导入 CSV 下载可打印 PDF，付费解锁保存任务和无水印。
projects.summaryEn: Job Traveler prints process/job traveler packets and a one-page calibration due list for machine shops. Fill the route or drop a CSV, download a Letter PDF meant for a clip and a tote—not another dashboard. Free samples are watermarked;

projects.title: QRForge — QR Code Generator
projects.summary: QRForge is a free Chrome extension that generates QR codes instantly, 100% on your device. Nothing is uploaded to any server: no accounts, no tracking, no ads. Features: text/URL input, 4 built-in themes plus custom colors, PNG and SVG download, copy to clipboard, right-click context menus for pages, links and selected text, download sizes 256/512/1024, and local history of your last 20 codes. Open source (MIT).

projects.title: CodeRook
projects.summary: CodeRook keeps every version of any project, from code to multi-GB game assets, as compressed snapshots. Its engine, CBX, is open source (Apache 2.0): save, branch and merge offline, then push to CodeRook when you want it there. The storage format and sync protocol are published. Desktop app, command line and web. Never used to train AI. 5 GB free, no card.

projects.title: Sharpshot
projects.summary: Press a shortcut, drag a box, and the shot comes back at your screen's real pixel size: on the clipboard, saved to a folder, and open in an editor with arrows, boxes, numbered steps, mosaic and crop. Pin a shot on top while you work, read its text or QR code offline, pick colours as HEX or SwiftUI. No network permission, no account, no analytics, no rating prompts, no cross-promotion. One purchase, English and Chinese, macOS 14 or later.

projects.title: BudgetFlow
projects.summary: BudgetFlow is a modern, native Windows monthly budget planner built for 100% privacy. • 100% Offline Vault: No servers, no accounts, and zero tracking. • 50/30/20 & Envelopes: Smart allocation for Needs, Wants, and Savings. • Multi-Currency: Full support for $, €, £, ₹, ¥, CAD, AUD. • Windows 11 Fluent UI: Fast desktop app with dark mode. • Honest Pricing: 30-day free trial, then $14.99 one-time lifetime license. No subscriptions.

projects.title: [开源推荐] dtflow：在终端里像看对话一样浏览 LLM 训练数据
projects.author: KenyonY

github.name: KenyonY/dtflow
github.description: Terminal browser for LLM training data with mouse support, windowed loading and full-file search — plus a CLI toolbox to filter, clean, convert and export datasets

projects.summary: 做大模型微调时，训练数据是一行一条的 JSONL，每条里嵌着多轮对话，head | jq 只能看一条，通用表格工具把对话显示成 {3}。dtflow 的 dt view 把它当"样本"来看：左边表格扫视每条样本的轮数、角色、字数和调用过的工具，右边把当前样本渲染成对话，支持全文件搜索、筛选、排序并导出子集。 亮点 认得训练数据格式：openaichat / sharegpt / alpaca / dpo 自动检测，对话按角色上色、代码块高亮、工具调用参数格式化并标出非法 JSON、DPO 的 chosen / rejected 并排对比 大文件秒开：窗口化加载，91 万行、155MB 的 JSONL 打开只占约 90MB 内存；搜索和筛选走多进程扫全文件，30 万行 0.2 秒 鼠标真的能用：点列头筛选、拖列宽、拖选文字复制，SSH 和 tmux 里也能进本机剪贴板（同类终端工具基本都是纯键盘） 筛完能落地：w 导出子集并自动记录来源文件与筛选条件，C 复制一条能复现当前视图的命令 CLI 像 Unix 工具一样拼管道：dt filter / select / dedupe / transform / export，条件直接写 Python 表达式，一键导出 LLaMA-Factory / ms-swift / Axolotl 可直接训练的目录

projects.title: Hourtick
projects.summary: Give your AI agents a seat on the team. In Hourtick, you can @mention agents in chat, hand them tasks, watch them work and bill for their time. Your team’s tasks, conversations and timesheets stay together, with a Mac menu bar timer, approvals and clear billable reports. AI can even suggest missing time entries for you to approve. Free for unlimited people, with every feature included.

projects.title: Codex Remote
projects.summary: Codex Remote is an open-source Mac menu bar app for putting Codex and Claude Code on a cloud machine you control. Choose a provider and size; it provisions the server with OpenTofu, installs the agents, and connects the machine to the apps you already use. See CPU, memory, and active sessions, pause idle servers, sync a project, or let an agent manage machines with opt-in MCP access. Your cloud credentials stay on your Mac. No hosted middleman. Independent of OpenAI and Anthropic.

projects.title: Tidyshot
projects.summary: Tidyshot lives in your Mac menu bar and handles every screenshot you take. Blur or pixelate private info and add arrows or callouts in one click. It reads the text on-device, so you can find any screenshot by what's written on it. Receipts, code and links land in Smart Collections, and everything is sorted by app. Redact covers emails, phones, cards and QR codes before you share. Works with ⌘⇧4, CleanShot or Shottr. No account, no cloud, no subscription.

projects.title: ClipKeep
projects.summary: Your Mac only remembers the last thing you copied. ClipKeep remembers everything. Cmd+Shift+V opens a searchable history of every copy: text, links, code, colors, images. Pin the snippets you reuse. Cmd+Shift+N drops a floating sticky note with checklists, tables and colors, synced across your Macs. Native, 1.6 MB, and private by design: your clipboard history never leaves your Mac. Launch offer: your first month is free.

projects.title: 做了个 Mac 防休眠小工具，主要为了合盖后继续跑 Codex
projects.author: SHIINASAMA
projects.summary: 最近自己做了个 macOS 菜单栏小工具，叫 Kipless 。 最开始其实就是我自己有这个需求。我平时会让 codex 在后台跑任务，碰到下班的时候任务还没跑完就很烦。同事都跑路了，我也急着走，但一合盖电脑就睡了，通勤路上的时间也浪费掉了，到家还得接着等。 所以我想要的其实就是：合盖，塞包里，路上让它继续跑。 一开始也用过一些现成的防休眠软件。这类工具很多，不是什么新东西。 但用下来发现，我自己的需求刚好有三种： - 电脑别睡，屏幕正常灭 - 电脑和屏幕都别睡 - 合盖以后也继续跑 有的软件有前两个，有的软件能解决最后一个。我想三个都要，又不想来回换工具，最后干脆自己写了一个。 Kipless 现在就是这三个模式，再加一个很简单的定时，可以跑 15 分钟、30 分钟、1 小时、2 小时，或者一直开着。 我自己用得最多的还是合盖模式。尤其是下班前 Codex 还在干活的时候，开着 Kipless 合盖走人，到家再看它跑得怎么样。 有一点要提前说明： MAS 版没有合盖继续运行。 合盖模式用到了一些 MAS 不允许的系统级能力，所以这个功能没办法跟着 App Store 版一起上架。 因此： - GitHub 开源版：三个模式都有。 - App Store 版：只有前两个模式，没有合盖模式，是因为受到 MAS 限制。 整个 App 是 Swift 写的，无收集、除了检查更新之外不联网。纯粹想着上架看看能不能赚个奶茶钱。 前几天 App Store 版也终于过审了，所以来分享一下。 官网： https://shiinalabs.com/zh/kipless/ GitHub： https://github.com/ShiinaLabs/Kipless App Store： https://apps.apple.com/app/kipless/id6812832674 如果你也经常挂 codex 、cc 啥的，应该比较容易理解我为什么要做这个东西。 欢迎拍砖喵

projects.title: Show HN: swe-mux – A terminal multiplexer for coding agents optimized for mobile
projects.author: jatora
projects.summary: I run a lot of coding agents at once, mostly Claude Code, Codex and pi, across several projects. I got tired of having so many windows open, of agents leaving hung processes behind, of tracking which one needed input, and of having to remote into my desktop or SSH into a single shell to manage them from my phone. Even then, a terminal on a phone couldn't show me the frontend or output I needed to verify the work. I tried Orca and herdr. Both were better than my setup, but neither had a real WYSIWYG markdown notes surface, and neither had a phone interface I could actually work in. swe-mux is the terminal multiplexer I built for that. It runs any shell or CLI in real terminals on your own machine and serves the same live sessions to your desktop and your phone. It's built around agents: Claude Code, Codex, opencode, pi and oh-my-pi get a live status (working, done, or waiting on you), searchable history and resume. Anything else runs as an ordinary terminal with everything except the status. This is the actual terminal and not a UI wrapped around the agent, and you can just use it that way, or start claude in a plain shell and that pane becomes an agent session. On the desktop it's panes and tabs of sessions, notes, files and dev-server previews. Input behaves the same across agents: Shift+Enter, Ctrl+Backspace, paste and click-to-position work in all of them, shortcuts come from presets (tmux, VS Code, Vim, Emacs), and you can paste images straight from the clipboard. Notes and any markdown file in the project open in the same WYSIWYG editor, on desktop and phone, and autosave. No more scattered locations for notes. On the phone it's the same sessions over your own Tailscale network, installed as a PWA: the terminal with a usable keyboard, git diff review, files, notes, and push notifications when an agent needs a decision. A dev server on the host's 127.0.0.1 is proxied through swe-mux, so the phone can open it without exposing another port. Being able to play-test and check a frontend there is what finally closed the development loop on the phone for a lot of my projects. Now I can and do swe anywhere. It's a problem Two things I use constantly: a prompt queue, so something I think of mid-turn waits until the agent is done instead of interrupting it, and messaging between sessions, so a Codex session can ask a Claude session something. I don't want my workflow tied to one provider. General architecture: Sessions survive restarts. A separate supervisor process owns the terminals, so the daemon can restart and the app can update without killing anything. I update it several times a day, so this wasn't optional. Status comes from the CLI's hooks, its transcript and the terminal itself, because no single one reliably tells "waiting on you" apart from "busy in the background". There's no swe-mux account, no server of mine in the path, and no telemetry. Just your tailnet It was built on Windows, which is where I use it every day and the only platform with a packaged desktop app. The installer is unsigned, so the PyPI install is the way to avoid the SmartScreen prompt. macOS and Linux run the daemon and use a browser. CI runs it on all three, but I haven't lived on those myself, however Linux I have tested. Demo, the real UI with simulated agents, nothing to install: https://swemux.dev/demo/ Install: `uv tool install swe-mux` (or `pipx install swe-mux`), then run `swe-mux` on Windows or `swemux start` elsewhere. Apache-2.0: https://github.com/jatoran/swe-mux I've put a lot of work into the initial user experience to help streamline a quick setup depending on someone's needs, feedback greatly appreciated, thanks

projects.title: Show HN: Caspian – Desktop app to build and launch small vibe-coded projects
projects.author: sshussain270
projects.summary: Hi! I am Hussain and I built Caspian. For someone who vibe builds almost all the time, for both personal tools like investment or health dashboards or tools to help others, I found my projects scattered all over the place: researching with claude, writing context in notion, building with Claude Code, Devin, publishing in vercel, posthog for analytics and then others tools for GTM. Big part of brain energy drain was context switching, I wasn't very organized. So I decided to build that lets me do all this from one place. I built Caspian. While most AI coding tools you use for vibe building stop at code, Caspian takes it all the way to users. Caspian creates a "workbench" folder in your local machine where it puts all your projects so everything stays in one place and is also easy for your other tools to work with. There is a built in co-pilot, a context manager (.md files user can copilot both read/write), a one click publisher, analytics and an email outreach manager. Though the copilot uses API for processing LLM requests via open router (I make a little margin on top), it is pricy, so I build a standard "canvas" format that Caspian uses that your Claude/Codex or other tools you use also understand and can work with. Simply point them to https://caspian.md/docs and they'll learn to work with Caspian straight away, this is so that you're not tied to Caspian's co-pilot and if you prefer to use your own tools, you can do so. Some other features I built around problems i found myself struggle with: - Prompt refinement: Enter a vague prompt in co-pilot, caspian uses a cheap model to generate a detailed before starting the task. - Preflight: It breaks down the task and tells you estimatedly, how much will it cost and how long will it take, before starting the task. - Product and User context: Co-pilot has access to the two files so both you and Caspain has understand of your product and user. - Code/No code: You can switch this button to dive into code or just stick with the vibes. I hope it helps and you can build and launch a lot quickly. Feedback what's the most annoying thing when you vibe code?

projects.title: 集成 tailscale 的 android SSH/SFTP 终端
projects.author: netox
projects.summary: 之前分享过我的 iOS 应用 NovaScale(原名 NovaAccess), 它直接集成了 Tailscale 内核, 把 SSH/SFTP/Remote Codex 这些功能整合到一个 App 里, 无需开启 Tailscale VPN 客户端, 也可以在有 VPN 运行的情况下运行, 目前还在积极迭代基于 herdr remote 协议, 以满足像我这样重度 Tailscale 用户远程开发以及维护服务的一些需求 距离之前发贴已经有一段时间了，这期间 iOS 版本增加了很多新功能，同时也修复了一些 libtailscale 的问题(相关修复开源在 https://github.com/GalaxNet-Ltd/libtailscale 不知道为啥, 感觉 Tailscale 的 iOS 有些严重问题上游修复的不积极, 比如这个断网问题: https://github.com/tailscale/tailscale/issues/19504); 与此同时, 我也一直在用多余的 codex 额度(pro 5x 用户, 近期 reset 实在时太多了), 在开发一个全免费全开源的 Play 版本, 用来满足当时一些国内外用户提到的 android 版本需求 由于之前的一些方案感觉不理想, 在 5.6/astra 发布后又进了一些优化, 感觉逐渐达到了自己可用的情况, 甚至为 SSH terminal 增加基于 SGR 的鼠标支持(herdr 这种 mouse native 的 TUI 应用需要)基本上 Astra 一发就差不多了 最近重新把之前的 play 开发者账号用了起来, 全部委托给 codex 负责截图、描述、商店操作(甚至如何搞授权也是 codex 告诉我的, 相比 iOS 开发要复杂点), 没想到当前提交隔天就通过了 因此发在这里也分享给有需要的朋友, 提前声明如下: 1 、这是一个完全免费的应用，代码完全开源 ( https://github.com/GalaxNet-Ltd/novascale-android), 与 iOS 版本不同, 没有采用 libtailscale, 直接让 codex 基于 tailscale 源码适配 2 、半年前的最初版本大概还是 claude 做的, 感觉做的不怎么样, 当前完全由 Codex 开发, 我只负责架构文档和最终的验收, 所以可以称之外完全 AI 开发并发布的版本, 后面可能会根据用户反馈、时间和 Codex 额外会进行一些迭代; 总体上感觉满足我有时候 iPhone 没电时用 Android 手机的需求 3 、代码为 GPL 协议, 原因在于从 termux 上借了一些 terminal rendering 的代码, 这部分它的协议是 GPL 的, 因此也只能 GPL 开源 Android 版本 NovaScale 的一些主要功能如下: - 无需安装 Tailscale 官方 App ，因此可以同时使用其他 VPN - 基于 libghostty(准确说是 libghostty-vt 库) + Termux 渲染方案 - 支持鼠标操作（因此 tmux / herdr 等场景可以正常使用） - 支持剪贴板功能（包括 OSC52 ） - 支持自定义控制服务器(即支持 headscale 或其他自建 tailscale coordinator) - 内置 SFTP 文件浏览器，支持直接编辑文件, 以及少量代码类型的高度支持 - 内置浏览器，可访问 tailnet 内部的 Web 服务 - 支持后台代理，让第三方应用使用 tailnet 连接, 例如你正在使用其他非 Tailscale VPN 时，也可以配合 Termius 等 SSH 客户端连接服务器 技术架构如下: - tailscale 源码包装出 lib - russh 通过 ffi 与 tailscale lib 进行通信, 实现 ssh 通道 - 使用 termux 提供的代码实现了一个 terminal UI 的渲染 - tailscale lib 中提供一个 socks5 代理, 此代理供浏览器实现基于 MagicDNS 的访问, 同时这个代理可以提供给其他进程使用 如果你是 Android 用户，并且对此感兴趣，可以通过如下链接下载: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=cc.galaxnet.novascale 简单推广下 iOS 版 NovaScale ，它包含 Android 版的全部功能，基础功能免费, 有少量的付费功能需要订阅或买断支持: - 多 tailnet 支持 - 基于内置 Tailscale 和主机 Codex App-Server 直接交互的远程 Codex 方案(无需第三方中转) - 服务器监控 - Docker 管理 目前我还在尝试通过 herdr 的协议实现原生 herdr 支持，让它能够像 herdr remote 一样工作。 iOS 版本可通过如下链接下载: https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/novascale-%E4%B8%93%E4%B8%BA-tailscale-%E6%89%93%E9%80%A0/id6749938291 PS: 1 、最近看到 tailscale CEO 也忍不住充了点 codex 的额度, vibe 了一个内置 Tailscale 的 jellyfin 客户端, 同样也是基于 libtailscale 实现的, 有需要用户可以去他的 X 的帖子上翻翻应该能找到 testflight 2 、作为 tailscale 的重度用户, 也欢迎私信技术交流

projects.title: 【工具自荐】ToolSide-浏览器侧边栏工具箱，34个本地小工具，让你的效率直接起飞
projects.author: ovelv
projects.summary: 浏览器右侧的超级工具箱：图片压缩、OCR、PDF 合并、JSON 格式化等 30+ 工具随手可用，不搜索、不切 Tab。 装一个 ToolSide，就不用装十几个插件了，也不用四处找小工具网站了。 ToolSide 把高频小工具收进浏览器侧边栏：遇到问题，点开侧边栏搜索即用，用完即走，全程不切换标签页。 ToolSide官网： 【核心能力】 ▎Markdown编辑和预览 支持在浏览器打开Markdown文件，在浏览器内编辑和预览，只需要右键md文件，使用浏览器打开即可。 ▎收藏夹同步 支持根据收藏夹内容生成1个私有导航网址，便于移动端访问收藏夹网址，实时更新同步，在PC上收藏网站，手机端也可以轻松访问。 ▎剪贴板 在任意标签页复制的文字、链接与图片，会自动进入剪贴板历史。跨标签页共享，切换页面内容不丢失；支持一键复制、导出下载，支持置顶与搜索，上周复制的内容也能找回来。 ▎截图与录屏 支持区域截图、整页长截图和可视区域截图，也能直接录制标签页或屏幕视频。截取完成后，可以在侧边栏里直接标注、复制或保存。 ▎翻译 在网页上选中一段文字，松开即显示译文浮层；也可以一键翻译整个页面，并提供原文对照，方便中英对照阅读。译文支持一键复制保存。 ▎右键直达 在网页任意位置点击右键，常用操作会直接出现在菜单里：右键图片可以做压缩、格式转换或提取颜色；选中文本可以翻译或生成摘要；右键页面空白处可以截图或录屏。 【工具覆盖的场景】 ToolSide 内置了覆盖日常办公与开发场景的一批工具，并在持续增加中： 图片处理：压缩体积、转换格式、调整尺寸、裁剪、拼接，以及识别图片中的文字 文档处理：PDF 文件的合并、拆分与压缩，PDF 与图片的互相转换 文本与数据：格式化与校验结构化数据、格式转换、编解码、字符统计、文档预览 开发辅助：解析令牌、生成随机标识、转换时间格式、查看请求信息等常用操作 AI 能力：总结当前页面或选中的文本、润色改写 效率小件：拾取页面颜色、生成二维码、换算单位、生成强随机密码 不确定某个需求能不能解决？打开侧边栏，用关键词搜索一下，中英文和常用别名都能命中。 【设计理念】 常驻侧边栏：与网页并排显示，收起后只占 36px 极窄入口，不打扰阅读 快捷键唤起：Ctrl+Shift+T（Mac 为 ⌘⇧T）打开侧边栏，Ctrl+K 聚焦搜索，全流程键盘可达 我的工具：收藏常用工具与网站，自定义打开方式 【隐私承诺】 图片、PDF、文本处理默认在你的浏览器本地完成，不上传服务器。你的数据留在你的设备上。 【三步上手】 1. 遇到问题：图片太大、PDF 要合并、一段外文看不懂 2. 点开 ToolSide：点击右侧极窄入口或按快捷键，侧边栏即时展开 3. 搜索并使用：输入关键词选中工具，在侧边栏里直接完成

projects.title: Show HN: OrbitalNote – A modern desktop orgmode editor with calendar and agenda
projects.author: mannders
projects.summary: Hey guys. Last year I switched to nvim-orgmode after trying many different organization systems. I love how it's a standard local plaintext file format that encourages forward motion. It really has helped me become substantially more productive at work. Although at one point I was looking at my apple calendar, and really wished my org agendas were visualized there, especially monthly views. Although there seemed to be caldav exporters etc, I wanted to just open a local desktop app that reads my org folder directly, and show my month. This was the original idea behind OrbitalNote. It does this well, but I had another idea. I used to use Obsidian and appreciate the plaintext markdown philosophy, but for productivity org makes more sense in my opinion. There doesn't seem to be an Obsidian level high quality desktop app with the same plaintext philosophy but geared specifically for org files and workflows. This is what I'm envisioning OrbitalNote could be. This app is free and open source. I will be adding automatic sync with mobile if there's interest. It can be found here: https://orbitalnote.org/ Thank you all for your time, I would love to hear your thoughts.

projects.title: 为了少装几个 Mac 小工具，我把自己的需求做进了 OmniDock
projects.author: xhzone
projects.summary: # 为了少装几个 Mac 小工具，我把自己的需求做进了 OmniDock 大家好，我做了个叫 OmniDock 的 Mac 工具，想放出来给大家试试。 我平时经常在 Windows 和 Mac 之间来回工作。有些 Windows 的操作和系统行为比较合我的习惯，换到 Mac 时，也想继续这么用。 比如，鼠标放到应用图标上，先看看它开着哪些窗口；再次点击图标，把眼前暂时不用的窗口收起来；需要两个窗口并排的时候，用快捷键摆好，不用来回拖。 我就想，能不能把这些用顺手的操作在 Mac 上适配一下？这样换个系统工作时，一些下意识的动作还能接得上，切换起来也自然一点。 这些需求已经有不少工具在解决。 比如 [AltTab]( https://alt-tab.app/) 可以看着缩略图切换窗口，[DockDoor]( https://github.com/ejbills/DockDoor) 可以在 Dock 上悬停预览窗口。调整窗口位置和大小有 [Rectangle]( https://rectangleapp.com/)，找回之前复制的内容有 [Maccy]( https://maccy.app/)。 它们各有侧重。不过，如果这几样功能我都想要，就可能要装几款软件。 我自己的需求又没有那么复杂，很多时候只用得到其中比较常见的那些操作。既然要做，就把这些常用的部分放到一起，也省得为了不同的小需求再去找工具。 OmniDock 就是这样做出来的。目前有这些功能： - 鼠标停在 Dock 图标上查看窗口预览，点选窗口切过去，也支持窗口级快捷切换。 - 再次点击当前应用的 Dock 图标来隐藏它，需要时再点回来。 - 给常用应用设置全局快捷键。 - 用快捷键或拖拽把窗口放到半屏、四角、三分屏等位置。 - 保存、搜索本地剪贴板历史。默认关闭，有需要再开。 - 在支持的 Finder 位置通过右键复制路径、新建文件，以及手动收起不常用的菜单栏图标。 这里有个区别需要说清楚：macOS 的“隐藏应用”会把这个应用的窗口一起藏起来，和最小化一个窗口不一样。所以这些操作是在 Mac 上做适配，具体行为不会和 Windows 完全相同。窗口预览也会受权限和窗口状态影响，官网里有对应说明。 我希望 OmniDock 能把分散在几类工具里的常用功能集中起来，让有类似需求的人少装几个软件。 对我自己来说，最想解决的还是来回切换系统时的那点不习惯：换台电脑继续工作，一些常用操作不用跟着重新适应。 目前可以免费下载，源码在 GitHub 。我把功能录成了一段视频，感兴趣可以先看看： - [官网与下载]( https://omnidock.app/zh/) - [GitHub 源码]( https://github.com/quanzhankeji/OmniDock) - [完整功能演示]( https://youtu.be/Y7r74VQ9Olc) 也想问问同样在 Windows 和 Mac 之间来回用的朋友，你们最希望两边保持一致的是哪个操作？

projects.title: 放弃 Linear 后，我开发了 Gitstride：一个 GitHub Projects 的 macOS 原生客户端
projects.author: zwyyy456
projects.summary: 我之前半年，开发个人项目的时候一直在用 Linear 来进行项目管理。本来我以为免费配额是够用的，但最近几个月，我同时开发多个项目，Issue 就多了起来，Linear 的免费配额就不够用了，因此，我就转向了 GitHub Projects ，毕竟这些项目的代码本来就托管在 GitHub 上。 迁移到 GitHub Projects 之后，我发现它内置的 PR 与 Issue 联动工作流不如 Linear 完善，也不太符合我的需求。比如，当我给一个 Issue 关联 Draft PR 时，我希望这个 Issue 的状态能自动变成 `In Progress`；当 PR 准备好 Review 的时候，Issue 的状态也能跟着变成 `In review`。如果一个 Issue 关联了多个 PR ，我希望等这些 PR 全部合并之后，它才会进入 `Done`，而不是合并其中一个 PR 就算完成了。 此外，我也不太喜欢每次都要打开网页来管理项目，还是更想用本地客户端来操作。 所以，在 codex 的协助下，我用 Swift 6 开发了 [GitStride]( https://gitstride.hyperseek.tech/zh-cn)，一个 GitHub Projects 的 macOS 原生客户端。 GitStride 实现了前面提到的状态联动规则，我不用再随着 PR 的进度手动修改 Issue 状态。如果 Project 里没有 `In review` 这个状态，设置 GitStride 的 PR 自动化后，GitStride 默认会按需为你自动在 Project 中添加这个状态。 > 设置 PR 自动化时，也可以选择后续不追加 In review 这个状态。 GitStride 在菜单栏会常驻一个图标，点击图标可以快速查看项目 Issue ；等我真的要整理任务时，再打开主窗口，在看板或表格视图中创建和编辑 Issue 。 [![pn1KrPe.png]( https://s41.ax1x.com/2026/09/25/pn1KrPe.png)]( https://imgchr.com/i/pn1KrPe) [![pn1K2rt.png]( https://s41.ax1x.com/2026/09/25/pn1K2rt.png)]( https://imgchr.com/i/pn1K2rt) 为了确保创建 Issue 、更新 Issue 描述等需要向 Github 多次发送请求的操作的跟手，GitStride 开发时借鉴了 Linear 的 local-first 的理念。GitStride 会把项目快照缓存在本机。修改改状态后，界面会先显示变化，再同步到 GitHub ；创建或编辑 Issue 提交后，app 会马上显示新内容，后台处理向 Github 发起的请求。 GitStride 还支持创建 Backlog 状态的 Issue ，新建 Issue 时可以直接选择 Backlog 状态；如果 Project 里没有这个状态，GitStride 会自动补上。 项目已经[开源在 GitHub]( https://github.com/zwyyy456/GitBoard)。如果你也在用 GitHub Projects ，欢迎试试，如果觉得好用，还请给个 Star 。更多介绍，参见 [GitStride 官网]( https://gitstride.hyperseek.tech) 下一步计划 1. 添加命令面板功能、完善 app 内的快捷键操作 2. 添加甘特图视图

projects.title: Show HN: Whiteboard (YC W26) – An open-source IDE for thoughtful software design
projects.author: sidharthkmenon

github.name: devdotfast/whiteboard
github.description: open-source canvas for thoughtful software design

projects.summary: Hello! We’re Sid, Alex, Ketan, and Milan. We’re building Whiteboard ( https://whiteboard.dev.fast/ ), an open-source desktop app where humans and agents can architect software together in a common workspace. Here’s our repo: https://github.com/devdotfast/whiteboard . We were missing the feeling of a “whiteboard session” with another dev where you leave with a deep understanding of a system, so we built this app for ourselves. Whiteboard plugs into the tools you already use - e.g. Claude Code, Codex, etc. – and gives your agent an SDK to draw on an in-app canvas to describe its work. We began with an MVP based on HTML artifacts and started rethinking the app as we ran into limitations: 1. Built on top of CodeOSS: We found that in pure HTML tools it was hard to connect a spec or diagram to code. In Whiteboard, when you click on visualizations like a sequence diagram, an entity relationship diagram, or a quote from the agent’s trace, you can jump to the underlying code directly. When navigating code, you get keybindings and LSP support from VSCode out of the box. We’ve found this is especially valuable because tradeoffs are often only discovered after a first pass at implementation (re: slop) 2. Semantic diff viewer: we wrote a semantic, AST-aware diff viewer in Rust so you can only view the code changes which are relevant to you [1]. We’ve set up some sane defaults: large added functions are summarized as pseudocode, and things like unit tests and large documentation changes are collapsed / hidden. This is all customizable with a WASM-based plugin system. 3. Decision Log: We found it difficult to reason about what set of decisions our agents made autonomously. So we built tools for agents to query and link their own traces to the Whiteboard, so you can understand how the requirements that you set were implemented, and understand what decisions your agent made autonomously. Here’s a quick demo video explaining more: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ChPn3ftULWE Folks at companies like Salesforce and Modal are using Whiteboard today as a review tool for architecture or spec-level changes – really any change where they want to be involved: 1. Reviewing your own coding agent’s work: because Whiteboard makes it easier to review large amounts of code, folks will typically have their AI agents create a prototype and a corresponding Whiteboard session so they can iterate on the design. 2. Reviewing other people’s changes: We’ve found that Whiteboard is particularly helpful when composed with tools like Greptile. For example, you can run an automated code reviewer on small changes and escalate to a Whiteboard session for the changes that require human judgement. Why we built this: we’re four buddies from college who quit our jobs as tech leads right before agentic coding became industry standard. As we iterated towards an MVP for a previous idea, we struggled to maintain a comprehensible codebase while reaping all the velocity benefits of agentic coding. As more PRs were merged without our understanding, we felt a ‘cognitive debt’ begin to seep in, until it became difficult for us to even contribute to the system [2]. We’re releasing our desktop app under an MIT license. Please poke through and feel free to contribute! Eventually we’ll charge companies for a hosted web version that manages whiteboard session creation alongside features like trajectory storage and multiplayer reviews. Everything will always remain self-hostable. Thanks for reading, and we hope you try it out! We would love to hear any feedback and to learn from your expertise. Here’s are the project links again: https://github.com/devdotfast/whiteboard , and you can install (for MacOS + Linux) at https://install.dev.fast [1] diffs library: https://github.com/devdotfast/diffr [2] Credit for the term ‘cognitive debt’ goes to https://www.geoffreylitt.com/2026/07/02/understanding-is-the...

projects.title: Show HN: Cloud-based email and calendar sync platform and Android app – for sale
projects.author: uncle_kostya
projects.summary: Hello, My name is Kostya Vasilyev and I was the original developer of an Android email app called Aqua Mail, sold to MobiSystems in 2019 at 3.5 organically grown users. After that, I built a new email app called Sugar Mail, based on a cloud email sync platform. The project hasn't been a success with end users, but I think the sync platform could be useful to someone so I'm looking to sell it and include the app too. Mail sync runs in the cloud and supports IMAP and Exchange, both with push mail, and the latter with bi-directional calendar and contact sync. Both Office 365 and on-prem Exchange are supported. Running mail sync in the cloud allows the Android app to be very efficient in terms of battery use. The Android app is just a JSON RPC client with some UI on top - so building an iOS or a desktop app would be pretty easy for the buyer. There are several geo-distributed server nodes and the Android app uses the closest one. Adding nodes for capacity is easy. The project is actively maintaned, with the Android app optimized for Android 17. The server is written in Go. I recently rewrote it in Rust, but decided to stay with Go in production for a variety of reasons (would be happy to explain in more detail). Unit economics: a $10 VPS can handle 1000 users each averaging 2 email accounts. A comparable platform is Nylas which charges $15/month per 10 accounts and has no end-user app (they used to, but not anymore). More details here: https://sugarmail.app/for-sale-one-pager.html Happy to answer questions.

projects.summary: （MIT） SyncClipboard 官方服务端的 Cloudflare Workers 复刻实现（TypeScript + D1 + R2 + Durable Objects）。官方客户端（Windows / macOS / Android，v3.1.1 及以上）零改动，把服务器地址指向部署好的 Worker 就能用：剪贴板实时同步（SignalR WebSocket 长连接）、WebDAV 兼容端点、历史记录跨设备同步。 做它的原因：官方服务端要自备 VPS / Docker / 进程守护，而这个实现把服务端搬到 Cloudflare 边缘——无服务器、免运维、按量计费，个人用量基本落在免费额度内（一台客户端全天在线约 1.7 万次请求/天，免费额度 10 万次/天）。 比官方多出来的： 内置 Web 历史管理界面：浏览 / 搜索 / 筛选 / 排序历史记录，收藏、置顶、批量操作、文本与图片预览、复制下载；回收站（删除的记录连同图片/文件数据保留 30 天，可一键恢复）；在线调整保留策略，不用重新部署。 部署两条路：命令行（wrangler），或 GitHub Actions（Fork 后配几个 Secret，推 master 自动建资源并部署）。 与官方服务端的行为差异（先说清楚，避免踩坑）： 单次上传默认上限 48 MiB（可调到 64 MiB），超出返回 413； 文件夹 zip 解压总量 64 MiB、条目 1000、单条目 24 MiB； 历史清理每 20 分钟一轮； 访问不存在的地址且未带凭据时返回 401，并计入失败限速。 这些限制来自 Cloudflare 免费档的约束（单请求 100 MiB、isolate 内存 128 MiB）；客户端默认单文件 20 MB，正常使用大多碰不到。 工程上：协议行为逐条对照官方源码实现，并与官方发布件做过 A/B 实测；22 个测试套件；所有有意偏离都登记在 docs/protocol.md 的差异表里。 独立的社区实现，与官方项目无关联、未获官方背书；协议行为与哈希算法移植自官方（MIT，版权声明已保留在 LICENSE 中）。

projects.title: Show HN: Diurnal – add a task without switching, with your calendar in view
projects.author: aashu0148
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm Anshul. Diurnal is a Mac to-do app I've been working on. Many to-do apps have a quick-add shortcut: a text field that appears when you trigger it, into which you can type a task. But the task box only knows about the task you're typing - to pick a time, you have to go to another app to check your calendar. But when you hit ⇧⌘A anywhere, Diurnal overlays your current app with your day — your tasks, Google Calendar meetings and a timeline. You can see that 3-4pm is busy, so you type "call John 4pm" and hit return. The task gets filed under 4pm, and you're back in the app you were in. If you start the line with /cal , it's a Google Calendar event. Other features: - ⇧⌘L adds tasks by voice: what you say gets split into tasks. I can say three things and get three tasks. - Reminders, daily and weekly planning, and a pomodoro timer come in the menu bar. - Offline, sync across your Macs (you need to sign in to a Diurnal account to sync, but nothing in the app is private) - The whole thing is free, and you can try it in your browser at diurnal.in without installing anything (it's a desktop app only, though). Am constantly building and improving the app and will love your feedback if you have tried it :)

projects.title: 做了个 macOS 27 菜单栏辅助小工具，让原生折叠范围可以主动控制
projects.author: Superoutman
projects.summary: 升级到 macOS 27 后，系统终于把菜单栏图标折叠做进了原生功能。但实际用下来，我觉得它目前阶段更像一个「半成品」：只有菜单栏图标比较多、空间不足时，系统才会触发隐藏功能。 我的需求其实更简单，不管菜单栏有没有挤满，我都希望把不常用的图标先收起来，需要的时候再一键展开。 所以费尽心思打磨了一个很小的 macOS 工具：ShiftBar 。 https://i.v2ex.co/W1518244l.png ShiftBar 没有重新做一套菜单栏，也不是想做成 Bartender / Ice / Thaw 那种功能比较完整的 Menu Bar Manager 。 它的思路反而是尽量利用 macOS 27 已经提供的原生菜单栏折叠能力，只补上我自己觉得缺少的那部分控制，它甚至没有设置页面（全部在图标和菜单中完成）。 目前主要做了这些： * 自定义菜单栏图标的隐藏范围 * 单击胶囊即可展开 / 收起（基于 macOS 27 原生折叠机制） * Shift + 拖动快速调整隐藏范围 * 记住设置好的隐藏范围 * 支持菜单栏布局备份与恢复 * 右键点击胶囊图标查看使用方法 为什么系统已经有原生折叠了，还要做这个？如果只是想永久隐藏几个菜单栏图标，macOS 自己现在已经能解决了，确实没必要再装一个工具。但我更想要的是什么时候折叠、折叠多少，由自己决定，不必等菜单栏真的挤满。所以 ShiftBar 的定位不是取代 macOS 27 的原生功能，而是做它的一个很轻的补充，本体才 3MB 多。 ⸻ 目前还是比较早期的版本，我自己也在持续使用和调整。 如果大家已经升级 macOS 27 ，也欢迎帮忙试试看。尤其想听听大家对于原生菜单栏折叠的使用感受，以及还有哪些地方觉得不够顺手。 ShiftBar： https://shiftbar.0x01.build/

projects.title: Show HN: Napkin – a scratchpad that holds texts and images for copy
projects.author: ppnpm
projects.summary: Napkin is a simple scratchpad to hold text and images to copy later or until you don't need them anymore, or when you don't want to organize temporary files. Clipboard does a similar kind of job, but it is essentially meant for copy and paste, it is volatile. Normally, you can't access the image or text you copied 10 days ago on clipboard. And that's fine—that's what clipboards are meant for. Napkin lets you create napkins on which you can add or paste pieces of text, URLs, and images. You can edit the text, insert images from your desktop, and copy any item at any time for further use somewhere else. Keep the app running in background, and reuse the items you pasted. Nothing is organized. You don't have to give anything a title or add tags. This is where all your mess gets dumped until you decide it's no longer useful and delete it. Just like a scratchpad! Deleted napkins go into the trash and are kept there for N days (30 by default), which you can change in the settings. Napkins older than X days (30 by default) will be flagged for deletion. You can change this period in the settings as well. You can also empty the trash, after which the files will be permanently deleted from your desktop. AI disclosure: This is a vibe-coded project. I spent most of my time testing it on Linux. Windows testing wasn't done properly, although it did run on Windows with some issues. If you try it, please test it on your system as well, and if you find any problems, feel free to submit an issue. Some notes you may need to know: - Linux builds are tested on Arch/KDE/Wayland. Windows builds and passes the full suite in CI, I ran older versions on real hardware and they worked. It is an unsigned build, so SmartScreen will warn you. - There is no global capture hotkey yet, which is the thing I most want. It needs the XDG GlobalShortcuts portal, and the session handshake. I cannot develop it headless. - There is no at-rest encryption. A scratch surface ends up holding tokens and passwords. The data directory is 0700 and excluded from desktop search, but that is retention, not encryption. Github URL : https://github.com/sudomonas/napkin

projects.summary: 这是一个用 Rust 构建的桌面语音工具。按住快捷键说话，识别出的文字可写入当前支持的输入框；也能录制或导入会议音频，在本地转写、搜索和导出。社区版免费、免账户、免激活，面向 Windows x64 和 Apple 芯片 Mac，不要求独立显卡。适合用口述组织长提示词、整理工作笔记，也可作为学习桌面音频采集、跨进程焦点识别与原生打包的工程参考。 亮点 作者自荐：我是维护者 Daming Wu（GitHub：wudaming00）。这次发布的是免费开源的 Community 1.3.1，不是原先付费版的试用活动。本文由 AI 辅助整理，功能和发布状态依据公开代码与发布产物核对。 同一应用覆盖短听写和长会议记录，包含个人词典、可编辑/撤销的纠错学习、听写历史、会议检索和导出。 CPU 优先，采用不同语言的本地模型路线。模型下载后，识别流程不上传录音或转写；模型下载、更新和用户主动配置的外部集成仍需联网。 可研究的工程问题包括 Windows UI Automation 跨进程焦点识别、麦克风与系统音频采集、会议分段恢复，以及 Windows/macOS 的 CI 打包与签名。 自有桌面源码采用 AGPL-3.0-only；模型和其他依赖保留各自许可证。仓库提供中英文介绍、构建指南、第三方声明、安全说明和贡献指南。 已发布 Windows 签名安装包和 Apple 芯片 Mac 公证安装包： 诚实边界：不同口音、术语、设备和多人重叠发言仍需更多测试，不宣称准确率第一；当前没有 Linux 或 Intel Mac 安装包。会议录音需要用户主动确认并取得参与者许可。欢迎使用合成音频提交可复现问题，不要上传私人会议或敏感日志。

It's heavily inspired by the excellent marimo pair. It's useful when you either don't want to use Microsoft Copilot, want to use a local model + harness for security reason, or want to use an agent that already has access to personal data. I've tested it with some harnesses (pi, opencode, codex) but I guess that it should work on many others. Not having a Microsoft developer account, I've yet to publish it to the marketplace, but it's sideloadable. While the first prototype was written by me, I've only kept the core and let an LLM rewrite the code.

projects.title: 做了一个 AI 辅助梳理思路/提供决策的插件，想听听大佬们的看法、建议。
projects.author: Climber47
projects.summary: ***链接***： https://github.com/WsTe47/mylife ***想解决的问题***：用 AI 来引导思考、辅助决策。 ***想法来源***：在思考自身职业规划 是否跳槽时，陷入纠结。发现走、不走，都有足够的理由去支撑。但自己到底为什么想走、却反而说不清。因此某天深夜沉思，语音输入 1h 输出了大概 1.3 万字的文档，将心中碎碎念全部吐出记录。第二天摸鱼一想，让 AI 分析了一下此篇文章，发现他能从我的说话频率等多方面总结，且点出部分自我矛盾的地方，结论竟真的十分符合我内心所想。 因此扩展思考，人总是会经常遇到这样纠结的点，拿捏不定。比如”酒后吐真言“，虽然是混乱的、但反而可能是真正的内心所想。又如可能很多场景不愿与旁人提及、缺乏树洞，比如感情之事的纠结。因此希望能让 AI 从你繁杂的说辞中，帮助梳理清楚思路。 某种角度说，就算一些人会信算命一样，给出的指引不一定是最正确的，但也算是给你一个”无悔“的参考。 ***做了什么***：形态是一个 dsh 的插件。 1 、数据输入是依赖于人工对话 + 历史数据。历史数据源于对话自动总结记录、关键信息人工输入。数据全部存储在本地。 2 、数据检索部分使用了阿里开源的 zg 项目。包含向量+BM25+rg 。 3 、整体逻辑上，会根据输入内容，去优先寻找”逻辑对立“|"自相矛盾"的地方，以此引导确认哪里是真实想法， 或者说是二者都各有道理（会引导开子一个新的 AGENT 对话新的话题）其次会寻找逻辑关联的地方，比如”想购买一个新款 iPhone“--关联到”去分析自身经济状况“。 具体内容可以看一下 readme 部分，那部分是 AI 写的，比我写的好很多。 ***目前进度&&求助的点***： 是一个 vibe coding 的产品，前两天开始的想法+行动。部分基建基于开源组件，仅把我想的最基础东西做了出来。 但是陷入了迷茫，不知道还该做些什么改进。因此期望大家看看，我这个 idea 是否可行、有没有推荐迭代的方向或建议～真诚求教，感谢各位大佬。

projects.title: Show HN: Accordia – Structured 1-on-1s for engineering managers
projects.author: NotGeorgeHere
projects.summary: Hi everyone, I'm a solo developer in Lincolnshire, UK. I've recently built Accordia. It is a 1-on-1 tool for engineering managers. You build a reusable agenda per report, run the meeting against it, and anything that turns into an action gets tracked and pulled into the next session automatically. I built it because of the 1-on-1s I sat in as a developer, not ones I ran as a manager. The pattern was always the same. The first few were good. Then my manager got busy, the meeting quietly turned into a status update, and something I'd raised in March came back as a surprise in my end of year review. None of them were bad managers but the 1 on 1 was not their priority so it ended up coming from memory and whilst there were good intentions there were issues with the process. So the thing I'm actually trying to fix isn't manager capability, it's the amount of discipline a good 1-on-1 currently demands. Most of the managers I've spoken to are running theirs out of a Notion doc or a shared spreadsheet. That works fine until it doesn't, and when it stops working nothing tells you until it's too late and you're in a messy situation. That also means I'm competing with Notion and spreadsheets, not with Lattice or 15Five. There's no performance review cycle, no engagement scoring, no HR dashboard, and direct reports don't need accounts. A few parts are open with no signup if you want to poke at it before deciding: The demo - https://www.getaccordia.com/demo , Agenda generator (no auth, exports to PDF) - https://www.getaccordia.com/1-on-1-agenda-generator , Question library - https://www.getaccordia.com/1-on-1-questions , 1-on-1 health check quiz - https://www.getaccordia.com/health-check Stack: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind v4, Supabase for Postgres and auth with server actions, Zustand, dnd-kit, shadcn/ui, PostHog, Paddle for billing, on Vercel. Local dev runs the full Supabase stack in Docker on a migration workflow. Free for up to 3 direct reports. $29/month above that which I think seems about right. There's still way more I'm planning on adding such as: Calendar integrations, AI summaries for employees, Being able to set goals, quarterly, bi yearly, yearly, Global template library - upload your own templates and download others, If you run 1-on-1s now, what does your setup look like and where does it actually fall over?

projects.title: 【工具自荐】100% 离线的 Apple 全平台智能长截图工具
projects.author: Jstrom2022
projects.summary: 导语：在 Apple 生态中，截图是每天发生频率最高的操作之一。然而，无论是 iOS 还是 macOS，想要截出一张完美无瑕、不漏隐私的长截图，依然充满了割裂感。为了解决这些看似细小却极度影响效率的痛点，我们开发了 Smart Scroll Capture 。 一、 为什么在 2026 年，截一张好长图依然这么难？ 作为重度 Apple 设备用户，我们经常遇到这样的尴尬时刻： Mac 上的“长图之痛”：想截一段长代码、终端输出或某个网页局部，传统的滚动截屏工具要么在快速滑动时出现果冻效应和错位断层，要么把固定的网页顶部导航栏重复拼进正文里。 手机拼图的繁琐与尴尬：想把一段微信聊天记录保存分享，要么手动连截 10 张图再一张张导入 App 拼接；更头疼的是，发给别人前还得手动用马赛克涂抹半天姓名、头像和电话。 隐私顾虑：截图往往包含聊天记录、财务报表、内部代码甚至身份证件。市面上不少工具把图片上传到云端处理，在隐私合规越来越敏感的今天，把这些数据交给未知服务器让人难以安心。 带着这些痛点，我们决定从底层出发，用 Swift + Metal + Vision 重新打造一款兼具极致画质、无感自动化与 100% 本地隐私安全的截图生产力工具。 二、 从“手动截取”到“全自动无感” 一个优秀的效率工具，应该像呼吸一样自然，不打断用户的当前专注流。 1. iOS 端：录屏即长图，相册自动缝合 录屏转长图：下拉控制中心开启系统录屏，匀速滑到底部后停止。系统会自动提取视频关键帧，并在 3 秒内完成像素级对齐，生成超高清长图。 相册隐形拼接：当你连续截取了几张有重叠画面的普通截图，打开 App 时，它已经在后台静默完成扫描与无缝缝合，你只需直接保存或分享。 Live Photo 动态实况拼图与互转 实况动态拼图 (LiveGrid)：支持将 2～10 张 Live Photo 自由拼为一张动态网格图，内置 20+ 种杂志级排版预设。拼好后依然是一张原汁原味的 Live Photo，在相册中长按依然能鲜活播放！ 2. macOS 端：局部精准滚动与固定导航栏去重 局部窗口独立滚动：在复杂的桌面多窗口环境中，支持只对光标所在的局部窗口（如数据库表格、终端或 IDE）进行无感滚屏截取，不干扰外部画面。 智能过滤浮动元素：算法会自动识别网页中固定悬浮的 Header、侧边栏或广告栏，确保长图中导航栏仅保留在最顶部，正文平滑连续。 官方地址： macOS 版本： iOS 版本： 三、 不止是一张图片，更是信息提炼工作流 很多时候，我们截长图的最终目的并不是为了保留一张“死图片”，而是为了提取其中的信息。SmartScrollCapture 将长图直接接入了深度生产力矩阵： [无损长截图] ───┬──► [贴图/长图文本直选即拷] (免手动 OCR，光标直接划选复制) ├──► [表格一键转 Excel] (.xlsx 格式即开即用) ├──► [100% 离线截图翻译] (依托系统原生 Translation 框架) └──► [一键智能脱敏打码] (自动识别二维码/证件/敏感词) 1. 贴图与文本直选：划词即复制 截图完成后，桌面端可以直接将长图贴在屏幕最上方。得益于底层的实时文本定位，你无需点击任何“文字识别”按钮，鼠标光标可直接在贴图画面上高亮框选文本并一键复制，完美保持原始代码缩进与排版。 2. 表格识别：1 秒导出标准 Excel (.xlsx) 老板或同事发来一张密密麻麻的数据表格截图？无需手动敲字。框选表格区域后，内置的表格结构解析引擎会自动还原行列结构，一键导出为标准的 .xlsx 文件，直接在 Numbers / Excel 中编辑。 四、 极客在意的细节：画质、性能与 100% 本地隐私 对于工具类软件，底层的扎实程度决定了日常使用的爽快感： 50,000+ 像素无损超长画质：即使是极长的网页代码，文字依然锐利无比。我们采用 Metal GPU 分块渲染与轻量内存调度机制，彻底杜绝了因超大图片导致的内存溢出（OOM Crash）。 零云端上传，纯端侧运行：无论拼接算法、OCR、智能擦除还是离线翻译，100% 在你的设备本地完成。应用没有任何第三方数据上报服务器，跨设备配置同步也仅依赖 Apple 官方的 iCloud Drive。 智能自动脱敏与擦除 (Inpainting)：在需要公开发布长图时，支持一键检测敏感候选（银行卡、手机号、二维码等）并安全遮罩；智能擦除模式更能提取周围背景纹理进行自然融合，告别难看的马赛克补丁。

projects.summary: 我是 Markview 的维护者，按周刊 README 的软件投稿入口提交，供编辑筛选。 Markview 是一个只读的原生 Markdown 阅读器，用 Rust 从零写成。它不套 WebView、不跑 JavaScript、也不调用外部 TeX 进程：Markdown 从源码到屏幕的每一步，包括排版、数学公式和 PDF 导出，都在进程内完成，装完就是一个自包含的二进制。 项目与下载： 开源协议：MIT 当前版本：0.1.4，界面语言为简体中文与英文 它最想解决两件事。 一是排版。整段用 Knuth–Plass 算法求最优断行，再加英文断词，两端对齐时词距和字距的伸缩都有明确上限，不会为了齐而把某一行硬拽开。中文按 W3C 的《中文排版需求》处理：标点出现在行首或行尾时让出半个字宽、收尾标点悬挂到版心之外，cjk-type 可以在大陆、台湾、日本三套标点惯例之间切换。行内和行间 LaTeX 用纯 Rust 的 RaTeX 解析，KaTeX 字体随二进制分发，公式与正文共享基线，和文字一起两端对齐。 二是速度。排版跑在工作线程上，超过 32 KiB 的文档会边排边把已经完成的部分发布上屏，解析仍然覆盖全文，所以引用定义这类跨段落语义依然正确。结果是首帧不随文档变大：从 10 KiB 的笔记到 1 MiB 的长文，从进程启动到第一帧可读内容都在 76 到 83 毫秒之间，彼此差距小于测量噪声；滚动完一篇 100 KiB 的中英混排加公式文档，常驻内存约 50 MiB。 其他功能：代码高亮、表格、脚注、GitHub alerts，图片支持 PNG / JPEG / GIF / WebP / BMP / ICO / SVG；文档里指向其他 .md 文件的链接在新标签页打开；编辑源文件时阅读位置自动保持。主题除内置明暗外，可写 .mvss.toml 自定义，配 ss validate / install / list 三个命令。 Linux：AppImage、deb、tar.gz Windows：MSI、zip macOS：Intel 与 Apple Silicon 均有包 安装包 11~15 MB。macOS 的包未签名，首次运行需去除 quarantine 属性。另提供命令行导出，markview --pdf doc.md -o doc.pdf 支持纸张、页边距、页眉页脚等参数，带 --watch 时文档或其引用的本地图片一改就重新导出，未变化的解析与布局直接复用；同一份文档导出两次，产物逐字节相同。 设计取舍：Markview 是只读的，不编辑、不保存 Markdown，也不打算替代编辑器。它只把「打开一份 Markdown 并把它排得好看」这一件事做好。 作为新项目，它在功能和成熟度上肯定不如一些已经发展多年的 Markdown 工具，欢迎批评和建议。

projects.title: 【开源自荐】Sound Guard：长时间无播放时自动归零 macOS 输出音量
projects.author: wlzh

github.name: wlzh/sound-guard-mac
github.description: Sound Guard for macOS: native, low-overhead, one-way output volume protection. Open source under MIT.

projects.summary: Sound Guard（声音守卫）解决一个很具体的问题：Mac 输出音量处于开启状态，但长时间没有播放活动时，自动把系统输出音量设为 0，避免下一次突然播放声音；未经用户点击确认，它不会自行恢复音量。 主要特点： 菜单栏驻留，空闲时间可设为 1–120 分钟，默认 5 分钟。 默认只保护内建扬声器，也可以逐项选择其他输出设备。 播放中不会归零；切换设备、睡眠唤醒或检测异常后会重新给予完整等待时间。 可选开启恢复提醒：检测到新的持续播放活动后弹出确认窗口，只有点击“恢复音量”才恢复之前的音量。 手动归零不会建立恢复凭据；设备、路由或音量发生变化时，旧的恢复请求会失效。 不使用麦克风、不保存音频、不上传数据，所有检测都在本机完成。 项目使用 Swift/AppKit 和 Core Audio 开发，不需要第三方运行时或驱动，需要 macOS 14.2 或更高版本。 当前公开版本为 v0.3.7 开发预览版。Release 提供 Universal ZIP，采用 ad-hoc 签名且尚未经过 Apple notarization；仓库测试报告中保留了权限、其他设备和长期性能方面仍待补充的实机验证说明。
projects.titleZh: 【开源自荐】Sound Guard：长时间无播放时自动归零 macOS 输出音量
projects.summaryZh: Sound Guard 是一款 macOS 菜单栏工具：长时间无播放活动后自动把系统输出音量设为 0，未经用户点击确认不会自行恢复。
projects.titleEn: Sound Guard: Auto-Zero macOS Output Volume After Inactivity
projects.summaryEn: macOS menu bar app that zeroes system output volume after 1-120 min of no playback, restoring only after user confirmation. Per-device protection, local-only detection. Swift/AppKit + Core Audio, macOS 14.2+.

projects.title: Show HN: A 3D Mac window switcher with browser tab support and search
projects.author: julien_dev
projects.summary: Hey HN. I made this little app, because I missed Compiz but also because I wanted a way to switch between tabs as well as my windows. Around 2008 a Linux desktop could spin your windows around a cube and flip through them like cards, and so far I have not seen anything like that on Mac. I also tried a bunch of different Command-Tab alternatives like AltTab, but so far they always lacked the following things: a live visual preview of windows and some kind of way to switch and search between individual browser tabs. So I built a simple prototype and refined it over the last two months. It goes like this: press a shortcut and every open window shows up as a 3D card, in one of seven arrangements. Browser tabs get their own cards as well and you can flick through each one. Hitting space makes the search come up so you can type a few letters and it finds the window or tab. Fuzzy searching is implemented as well. I also added a quick Option + ` (key above tab) to instantly switch to the last window without any UI coming up, because I do this a lot. For the curious: Swift and Metal, window pictures come from ScreenCaptureKit and it only captures while the switcher is open, nothing runs in the background. Browser tab support is done through the accesibility strip. Apple Silicon, macOS 14+ for now. It has a seven day trial with all features, no account, no telemtry, no subscription or marketing bs. One time purchase, $12.99 during launch, $19.99 after. 14-day money back guarantee. Very curios what you guys think :)

projects.summary: Window Layout Memory 用来分别记住单屏、双屏和多屏环境下的窗口大小、位置与显示器归属。当显示器组合变化、系统重新登录或窗口被临时重排后，可以恢复对应布局，避免每次连接显示器都重新摆放窗口。 项目比较强调“保守恢复”： 按完整显示器组合和显示器身份隔离布局，不用单屏记录覆盖双屏偏好。 对同一应用的多个窗口做保守匹配，遇到歧义时不猜测跨屏位置。 支持锁定基准、历史回退、暂停、应用排除、私人备份和只读布局预览。 可选记录用户拖动或缩放后的窗口位置，但无法确认是主动调整时只保留候选。 针对台前调度提供可选的横屏铺满功能，并避开菜单栏和 Dock。 数据仅保存在本机，不上传窗口标题、文档路径或显示器信息。 应用使用 Swift/AppKit 开发，没有第三方运行时依赖。窗口控制需要 macOS 辅助功能权限。 当前 main 源码版本为 v0.3.0-preview.20/build 27，仍是开发预览版；最新可下载 Release 为 v0.3.0-preview.19。Spaces、原生全屏窗口和台前调度分组恢复不在当前范围内。公开 ZIP 为 arm64、ad-hoc 签名且未公证，仓库中记录了测试状态和仍待完成的实机验收项。
projects.titleZh: 【开源自荐】Window Layout Memory：按显示器组合记住并恢复 macOS 窗口布局
projects.summaryZh: macOS 工具，按单屏、双屏、多屏的显示器组合分别记住窗口大小、位置与显示器归属，在显示器变化、重新登录或窗口被临时重排后恢复布局。
projects.titleEn: Window Layout Memory: Restore macOS Window Layouts per Display Setup
projects.summaryEn: macOS app remembering window size, position and display per monitor setup (single, dual, multi); restores layouts after display changes or re-login. Conservative matching, layout locking, rollback, app exclusions, local-only data.

projects.title: Show HN: Text-me: a personal agent that learns your pace
projects.author: melfernand
projects.summary: Hey, I built text-me because every productivity app I tried gave me one more place to be and maintain. Meanwhile my life actually happens over email, messages, calendar, college, Kindle, reading, and Substack. And I always have to be somewhere else. So now I send everything to one place, like texting a friend. It separates life from work, and every week it analyzes and gives you a place to start instead of another dashboard. You can connect your email and calendar through Plow. It always asks before changing anything in your calendar or sending a message. And the part that interests me most is that I don't have to keep re-sorting twenty things anymore, because it remembers. If I say some activity takes me 45 minutes on average, but I actually take 60, it learns that. So next time, if I write 45 minutes it puts 60, and it keeps adapting my calendar to that. And every morning it can send a newspaper with everything that matters to me: the people I need to answer, what changed overnight, what I have to solve today. It can even send something funny, and that goes to my Kindle. Of course it can go to the printer, email, or the chat, but I send it to my Kindle. It's open source and works over iMessage or SMS. I built it during a hackathon, and it came out of my own problems. Now I want something that learns the real pace of life. I'd love your feedback on what you think should improve.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】Fuwa：一个 macOS 窗口置顶工具
projects.author: yuxino

github.name: yuxino/fuwa
github.description: Always-on-top live window mirrors for macOS, with click-through and Finder Quick Look. 窗口悬浮镜像与快速查看置顶。

projects.summary: 我以前就想要一个这样的工具。做微信小程序时，一边改代码，一边想看开发者工具里的预览；做 App 时要盯着模拟器检查布局。编辑器一盖住这些窗口，就得反复切回来。跟着视频教程操作也一样：看一步、切回软件做一步，再切回去找刚才讲到哪儿。对照设计稿调界面，或照着 PDF 文档填参数时，也会碰到这个问题。 最近借助 AI，总算把这个想法写成了 Fuwa。做完才发现市面上已经有同类工具了，不过这个是我自己做的版本，用下来觉得挺顺手，就开源分享给大家。 Fuwa 是一个 macOS 窗口置顶工具。把想看的窗口切到前面，按 ⌥⌘P，它会在最上层显示这个窗口的实时画面。回到编辑器或正在操作的软件，预览、教程、设计稿还在眼前；置顶画面会让鼠标点击穿过去，不挡住下面的工作。也可以同时固定几个窗口，或者冻结画面，方便对着某一步慢慢做。需要操作原窗口时，可以用“显示源窗口”切回去。 Fuwa 支持 macOS 14 及以上。首次固定窗口时需要屏幕录制权限；窗口画面只在本机处理，不上传。
projects.titleZh: [开源推荐] Fuwa：把参考窗口变成可穿透的置顶实时镜像
projects.summaryZh: Fuwa 是一款 macOS 菜单栏应用，可将选中的窗口变成置顶实时镜像，鼠标可穿透镜像操作下层内容，方便边写代码边看文档或对照图片。

projects.title: 分享一个 chrome 插件，顺带分享用 Cloudflare + Resend， 0 成本搭建可收发的域名邮箱
projects.author: SoyaLeaf
projects.summary: 之前为了给自己的网站设置一个有个性的域名邮箱，又不想费心思用企业邮箱，就找到了 Cloudflare 转发邮件这条路子，然后搭配 Resend 就能使用同一域名邮箱地址发信和回复。为了更方便回复邮件，又特地写了一个浏览器插件：[Resend Mail Assistant]( https://mixiao.fan/apps/resend-mail-assistant/)。最近才在群里发现也有其他小伙伴可能需要这套方案，趁机水一篇博客，把整个方案分享出来。 本文以 `support@mixiao.fan` 为例，介绍 Cloudflare Email Routing 、Resend 和 Resend Mail Assistant 的完整配置流程。 各部分的作用如下： - Cloudflare Email Routing 负责接收发往域名邮箱地址的邮件，并转发到 QQ 邮箱、Gmail 或 Outlook ； - Resend 负责以域名邮箱地址发送邮件； - Resend Mail Assistant 负责读取当前网页邮件，并通过 Resend 完成回复。 这套方案不需要自建邮件服务器，在免费额度内也不需要额外支付邮箱服务费。它本质上是“邮件转发 + API 发信”，不提供独立的邮箱后台。 ## 邮件是怎样流转的 收件与回复分别走两条路径： ```text 收件：对方 → support@mixiao.fan → Cloudflare → QQ 邮箱 / Gmail / Outlook 回复：QQ 邮箱 / Gmail / Outlook → Resend Mail Assistant → Resend → 对方 ``` 回复发出后，对方看到的发件人是 `support@mixiao.fan`。 ## 准备工作 开始之前，需要准备： - 一个已经将 DNS 托管在 Cloudflare 的域名； - 一个用于接收转发邮件的现有邮箱，例如 QQ 邮箱、Gmail 或 Outlook ； - 一个 [Resend]( https://resend.com/) 账号； - Chrome 或其他能够安装 Chrome 扩展的浏览器。 Cloudflare 和 Resend 都需要修改域名 DNS 。如果域名已经在使用其他邮件服务，尤其是已经存在 MX 记录，不要直接覆盖原来的配置，否则可能导致原邮箱无法收信。 ## 开启 Cloudflare Email Routing 登录 [Cloudflare Dashboard]( https://dash.cloudflare.com/)，在左侧菜单展开 **Email Service**，进入 **Email Routing**。 ![在 Cloudflare 中进入 Email Routing]( https://mixiao.fan/images/articles/cloudflare-resend-email/1.webp) 首次使用时，页面会提示启用 Email Routing 。点击 **Onboard Domain** 开始配置。 ![点击 Onboard Domain 启用邮件路由]( https://mixiao.fan/images/articles/cloudflare-resend-email/2.webp) 选择需要接收邮件的域名，然后点击 **Continue**。 ![选择需要启用邮件路由的域名]( https://mixiao.fan/images/articles/cloudflare-resend-email/3.webp) Cloudflare 会列出即将添加到域名中的 MX 和 TXT 记录。确认没有与现有邮件服务冲突后，点击 **Activate**。 ![确认 Cloudflare Email Routing 所需的 DNS 记录]( https://mixiao.fan/images/articles/cloudflare-resend-email/4.webp) 这里不需要照着截图手动填写记录。不同域名、不同时间生成的内容可能不同，应当以 Cloudflare 当前页面显示的记录为准。 激活后，DNS 和路由状态可能会短暂显示为 **Syncing**。等待同步完成即可，不需要反复删除和添加记录。接下来点击右侧的 **Add a destination address**，添加真正用于收信的邮箱。 ![等待路由同步并添加目标邮箱]( https://mixiao.fan/images/articles/cloudflare-resend-email/5.webp) ## 验证目标邮箱并创建路由规则 输入 QQ 邮箱、Gmail 或 Outlook 地址后，Cloudflare 会向这个邮箱发送一封验证邮件。打开邮件并点击其中的验证链接，回到 Cloudflare 后应当能看到状态变为 **Verified**。 在已验证地址右侧打开更多菜单，选择 **Create rule**。 ![从目标邮箱创建路由规则]( https://mixiao.fan/images/articles/cloudflare-resend-email/7.webp) 接下来在 Email pattern 中填写 `support`，域名选择 `mixiao.fan`，创建的地址就是 `support@mixiao.fan`。 Action 选择 **Send to an email**，Destination 选择刚才验证过的邮箱，然后保存规则。以后发往这个域名邮箱地址的邮件都会被 Cloudflare 转发到目标邮箱。 ![将 support 域名邮箱转发到已验证邮箱]( https://mixiao.fan/images/articles/cloudflare-resend-email/8.webp) 现在可以用另一个邮箱向新地址发送一封测试邮件。稍等片刻，邮件应当出现在目标邮箱中。 Cloudflare 路由生效后，`support@mixiao.fan` 已经可以接收邮件。接下来配置 Resend 的发件能力。 ## 在 Resend 中验证发件域名 登录 Resend ，在 [Domains]( https://resend.com/domains) 页面点击 **Add domain**，添加 `mixiao.fan`。刚添加完成时，域名状态会显示为 **Not Started**。 ![在 Resend 中添加 mixiao.fan]( https://mixiao.fan/images/articles/cloudflare-resend-email/13.webp) 点击域名进入详情页。Resend 检测到 DNS 托管商是 Cloudflare 后，会在 DNS Records 区域显示 **Auto configure**。点击该按钮，按照页面提示确认自动配置。 ![使用 Auto configure 自动配置 Cloudflare DNS]( https://mixiao.fan/images/articles/cloudflare-resend-email/12.webp) Resend 会为域名添加发信验证所需的 DNS 记录，包括 DKIM ，以及退信域名使用的 SPF 、MX 等记录。使用自动配置后，不需要再回到 Cloudflare 逐条复制这些记录。 等待 DNS 生效，然后点击页面右上角的 **Verify DNS Records**。验证完成后，域名状态会变为 **Verified**。 ![Resend 域名验证完成]( https://mixiao.fan/images/articles/cloudflare-resend-email/14.webp) 如果页面没有显示 **Auto configure**，或者自动配置失败，再根据 Resend 页面生成的名称、类型和值，到 Cloudflare 的 DNS 页面手动添加。不要复制截图或其他域名的 DNS 值。 配置时需要注意： - 保留 Cloudflare Email Routing 已经生成的 MX 和 TXT 记录； - 不要为了配置 Resend 删除 Cloudflare 的收件记录； - 同一个主机名不应存在多条独立的 SPF 记录； - 如果 Cloudflare 提示记录冲突，先核对主机名和用途，不要强行覆盖。 域名验证完成后，进入 [API Keys]( https://resend.com/api-keys) 页面创建一个 API Key 。这个 Key 相当于发信密码，只在扩展中配置，不要放进文章、截图或公开代码仓库。 ## 安装 Resend Mail Assistant [Resend Mail Assistant](/apps/resend-mail-assistant/) 是一款 Chrome 侧边栏扩展，可以通过用户配置的 Resend API Key 发送邮件，也可以读取 QQ 邮箱、Gmail 和 Outlook 网页端当前打开的邮件并准备回复。 从 [Chrome Web Store]( https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/resend-mail-assistant/madpgfpaigaifaomnkeojjjljmnajipl) 安装扩展后，打开侧边栏并进入“设置”： 1. 点击“添加 API Key”，粘贴刚才在 Resend 创建的 Key ； 2. 选择直接保存、本地密码或 Passkey 作为本机保护方式； 3. 点击“测试”，确认 API Key 可以正常使用； 4. 添加发件人 `support@mixiao.fan`。 扩展中的发件人必须属于已经在 Resend 验证通过的域名，否则 Resend 会拒绝发送。API Key 、已保存的发件人与发件箱记录保存在当前浏览器的扩展存储中；只有主动发送时，邮件数据才会提交给 Resend 。 ## 在网页邮箱中回复 收到 Cloudflare 转发的邮件后，在 QQ 邮箱、Gmail 或 Outlook 网页端打开它。右键点击页面，选择 **用 Resend 回复当前邮件**。 ![在网页邮箱中选择用 Resend 回复当前邮件]( https://mixiao.fan/images/articles/cloudflare-resend-email/9.webp) 扩展会打开侧边栏并尝试读取当前邮件，自动解析原始发件人、主题、日期和 `Message-ID`，同时填写收件人与回复主题。 ![扩展读取当前邮件并准备回复]( https://mixiao.fan/images/articles/cloudflare-resend-email/10.webp) 确认发件人、收件人和正文后，点击“发送邮件”。扩展会通过 Resend 发出邮件，并附带回复会话所需的邮件头。对方收到邮件时，回复会尽可能出现在原来的邮件会话中，而不是变成一封毫无关联的新邮件。 ![通过 Resend 发出的回复进入原邮件会话]( https://mixiao.fan/images/articles/cloudflare-resend-email/11.webp) 如果扩展无法自动读取当前邮件，可以在邮箱中打开“显示原始邮件”或“邮件原文”，复制完整源码，粘贴到扩展的“粘贴原始邮件源码”区域后手动解析。 [原文链接:https://mixiao.fan/articles/cloudflare-resend-email/]( https://mixiao.fan/articles/cloudflare-resend-email/)

projects.title: Show HN: Timeline, a team project planner with a fast canvas Gantt view
projects.author: vakahnke
projects.summary: I manage a few projects at work. I really am unsatisfied with modern tools available to me for that purpose. I had always envisioned a tool that I could interact with visually for this purpose. I started building one many years ago but the graphics programming was beyond my capabilities and nothing I made hit the mark. Along came modern AI to help get me the product and I wanted. I decided to open-source the results. Features: This tool has a Gantt chart style to it that you can interact with on the DOM. There is a feature that allows you to assign tasks to people on your team and manage the amount of tasking assigned to each person. I also included templates that allow you to re-use someone's project once they find one that works. List view allows use on your mobile device. This is built in Django and has a REST API that goes with it for adding on capability. There are directions to easily install it using Docker and take it for a spin. The events are "sticky" so they don't get moved around by accident. hold Ctrl or Command to drag an event around the timeline. I am looking forward to hearing comments and feedback on the utility of the program and how to improve it.

projects.author: gzz727007

github.name: sealkit-org/pdfseal
github.description: 🦭 100% Private, Fast, and In-Browser PDF Toolkit. Sealed in your browser. No servers, no tracking, free forever.

projects.summary: 我们在处理发票、合同、个人证件等敏感文档时，市面上绝大多数在线 PDF 工具都需要将文件先上传到第三方服务器，存在极大的隐私与数据泄露隐患。 PDFSeal 是一款专为隐私安全打造的 100% 纯本地、纯客户端 PDF 工具箱。所有计算（合并、拆分、压缩、水印、页码、签名盖章、加密/解锁、物理级内容脱敏等）完全在浏览器内存（WebAssembly / pdf-lib / pdf.js）中完成，绝不向任何服务器上传用户的文档，完全无后端、零追踪、零打扰。 核心特性 1. 绝对零上传 / 断网可用：底层没有任何文件上传接口。即使拔掉网线或开启飞行模式，所有功能 100% 正常运行，支持通过 PWA 安装为本地桌面与手机应用。 2. 功能全面不简陋：内置 14 大实用原子工具 + 自动化多步骤流水线（Pipeline）。包括但不限于： 物理级文本脱敏：彻底销毁 PDF 底层内容流并自动校验零文本残留； 智能页码覆盖：支持涂白遮罩自动取色，掩盖旧文件的错位老页码； 印章透明化与去白：自动消除纸张白底和阴影，还原纯净印油质感； 智能二分压缩：可指定目标文件大小（如 ≤2MB）进行自适应二分法搜索压缩。 3. 多端自适应优化：针对手机端设计了专属的单手操作抽屉、底部悬浮栏，并支持 Web Share API 原生系统分享（可直接 AirDrop 或微信转发）。 4. 便捷自建：提供单文件 Docker Compose，一行命令即可在局域网或内网完成私有化自托管。 界面截图

projects.title: 【开源自荐】Nano-Lumen：一个基于自研内核的 Windows 持久化 AI Runtime
projects.author: Fhaxikii

github.name: Fhaxikii/Nano-Lumen
github.description: Nano-Lumen is resident general-purpose agent for Windows desktop, designed as a persistent-state system: cross-session, crash-recoverable, local-first privacy. (Beta)

projects.summary: GitHub License：Apache-2.0 预览（终端风主题） 解决了什么痛点？ 现在的 AI Agent 几乎都一个样：开会话 → 丢目标 → 干完走人。历史、状态、生命周期全塞在一个 session 对象里： 同一 session 下上下文长期经过多次压缩后，最终会导致水位逐渐抬高，直到提示 session 不可用，聊了很久的对话说没就没了； 你说"我刚改的那个文件"，它不知道，因为它并不能实时感知到你； 它能不能做一件事，完全取决于预先内置了多少工具/MCP，AI的能力边界取决于已有的工具集合。 核心功能与特色 1. 没有 Session，只有 Task：状态所有权、对话历史、上下文管理、长期记忆是四个独立系统，压缩上下文、崩溃都不会失忆； 2. 轨迹感知：它持续观测你在哪个窗口、改了什么文件、停了多久。你说"继续刚才那个"，它接得上，不用你解释； 3. 目标导向，不是工具驱动：任务超出内置工具时，它先判断能否临时写段脚本直接跑，或者也能将脚本变成长期可用的内置插件；也不行？就自己去 MCP 生态里找——查官方 Registry、翻 GitHub / HuggingFace 做工程尽调，验证通过才接进来。它的上限不是你预装了多少，而是整个互联网有什么； 4. 操作系统：GUI 操作按风险分级，危险命令有独立第三方分类器兜底；检测到你动鼠标键盘立刻让出前台，不假设用户本人不中途操作；每一次 OS 动作都留痕； 5. 上下文治理：长对话按新鲜度分层压缩，永不爆上下文，也永远不会"会话已过期"。 技术实现与亮点 截止目前开发期五个月左右、约 9 万行有效代码（含测试，测试套件随仓库分发），单进程 Windows 桌面应用，Apache-2.0； 状态机内核：所有状态变更走唯一 write entry，重启后从持久化状态自动收敛，崩溃/任务当中关闭等情况下，下次启动还能问你要不要继续； 上下文逐级衰减，是渐进压缩而不是粗暴截断； 本地离线 RAG（bge-m3 嵌入 + 向量召回），无云上传； ...... 目前是 Beta —— 欢迎来读源码、提 issue、改代码。

projects.title: Show HN: Turnpanel is a local first AI workspace
projects.author: ksubedi
projects.summary: Hi hacker news, I am Kaushal, founder of echowin and also the guy creating TurnPanel. It began as an internally developed tool because my team and I were so sick of having to constantly bounce context around between ai chats, coding agents engines terminals, browsers files scripts, TurnPanel is a local-first workspace in which an agent can operate throughout your computer, orchestrate other agents and tools, and preserve valuable context over time. Its background maintenance processes transform commonly-used knowledge and tasks into reusable memories and skills stored locally - that's what I mean by self-evolving: it becomes more helpful through tasks finished, but cannot change its own permissions. It further includes a visible browser with DOM and CDP access, and it does a benchmark of your machine to suggest and set up appropriate local models. You may alternatively connect to codex openrouter opencode or another openai compatible provider, change models between different jobs, and run different models for helper agents. It is capable of monitoring conversational harnesses like kod and codex, keeping their terminals displayed, and responding to simple queries based on pre-existing contextual information in the workspace. Also, for constructing persistent dashboard track review queues, and other small utilities, the mini-app SDK is available that eliminate the need of creating a new project and deploying stack. Spaces form a safety boundary by taking care of what memories files services, browser sessions, models, and actions are accessible to each job, and agents are not able to add capacity to the grants. Logins payment destructive actions, and follow-up confirmations hand control back to the user. Complete workspace like jobs terminals browser streams, applications, and long-run processes can also be used via browser or PWA remotely. Its in public beta for mac and PC, with linux in the works. The basic local version is free, pro adds remote access and higher hosted-service limits. I'll be available to answer questions on how it works.

projects.title: Show HN: Microsoft Office running with Wine on Linux with no virtualization
projects.author: tombert

github.name: Tombert/office365_flake
github.description: A set of Nix Flakes and scripts to get Office 365 working on Linux without virtualization.

projects.summary: Microsoft Office famously hasn't worked well with Wine since Office 2007. There are lots of solutions out there to work around this, but all of them involve fairly heavy virtualization. Multiple people have told me that their biggest hangup for switching to Linux from Windows is the lack of the desktop version of Microsoft Office, and they don't want to run a VM to get around it. I recently fell into a bunch of free time with a Claude Max subscription, so I got Fable to hack at this until it worked! And with this, we have Microsoft Office running on Linux, with no Windows in sight! I can't promise that this will work on everyone's computer, but I did put this all in Nix Flakes, so ideally it should be relatively reproducible on any Linux system with the Nix package manager and Flakes enabled. Also, it does not work very well with X, but Wayland appears to work fine. This is not warez. You need a valid license for Office 365 for this to work. You also need to register on Microsoft's website in a browser ; the flow for registering in the app proved to be tricky and not worth pursuing. This is more proof of concept than anything else; I have no doubt that there are bugs and improvements to be made. I have only tested this with NixOS on Sway and KDE, and as stated it only really works with Wayland and the absolute latest GE-Proton, but I believe it would work fine with Gnome or any other Wayland desktop. Full disclosure, Claude Code with Fable did the vast vast majority of the work on this. I ended up primarily just reading log messages and complaining back to it.

projects.summary: I've been using google calendar for over 10 years, but since turning 40 I've found the fonts too small. So I built an opinionated ios calendar app, "big calendar", that suits my needs. Big fonts, readable (multi-line) events, wide column for today, etc. Basically it's for people who don't use timed events much. It shows whatever is in your apple calendar, so google calendars synced to your iphone show up too. Now I use it every day, and it has pretty much replaced google calendar for me. - free to use, with a one-off purchase to unlock more - not open source - built with claude (max plan 5x) in vscode/xcode If you find your calendar too small to read, maybe give it a try. Any feedback is appreciated. https://github.com/minho42/bigcalendar-public

projects.title: Show HN: tuisheet, a terminal spreadsheet compatible with OpenXML (xlsx) files
projects.author: krackout
projects.summary: Presenting tuisheet: A love letter to VisiCalc and Lotus 1-2-3. The motive was to code a programme inspired by VisiCalc and Lotus 1-2-3 interface, running on terminal, but fully compatible with the current universal standard of OpenXML (xlsx files for spreadsheets). Coded in Go lang; apart from my being more familiar with this programming language, it helps making a single executable, low on resources. Also, I like Go's compiler ability to cross compile to many platforms and OSes (which I personally often meet through my daily job). By the way, tuisheet is much more thoroughly tested and used on Linux than on Windows (or Solaris, AIX, BSD).

projects.title: 【工具自荐】CaptionWise-你的多语言 AI 语言助手，不只是翻译。
projects.author: rickif
projects.summary: CaptionWise 将实时语音翻译、双语字幕与 AI 辅助解答融入日常学习和工作。无论是留学生海外上课、观看外语视频、参加外语面试，还是参加跨语言会议，你都可以一边跟随原文与译文理解内容，一边借助 AI 梳理重点、解释疑问，让语言不再打断思路。 多语言实时翻译，跟上每一句表达 将正在听到的语音实时转换为原文与译文字幕，支持中文、英语、日语、德语、法语、俄语、西班牙语和葡萄牙语等多种语言。你可以自动识别来源语言，也可以手动指定语言并选择翻译目标，在对照阅读中理解内容、熟悉表达，更从容地跟上讲解与交流。 麦克风与电脑声音，按场景自由选择 听网课、看视频或参加线上会议时，选择电脑系统声音进行识别与翻译；需要识别身边的讲话时，切换至麦克风输入。让不同来源的语音，都能成为清晰可读的字幕。 桌面悬浮字幕，专注眼前的内容 将字幕悬浮在正在使用的窗口上方，观看课程、演示或视频时，无需频繁切换界面。支持双语、仅译文和仅原文显示，并可调整字幕字号、窗口位置与透明度，让字幕适应你的阅读习惯。 AI 随内容辅助理解，有疑问随时提问 开启 AI 助手并授权选择课程或演示窗口后，CaptionWise 会结合窗口画面与实时字幕，在内容发生有意义的变化时自动提供解释，帮助你理解概念、梳理知识点。遇到难懂的内容，也可以主动请求解释或直接提问，在当前学习语境中继续深入理解。 录音与字幕回顾，让重点可以重听 会话结束后，可以在历史记录中查看双语字幕，并播放保存在本地的录音。回放时同步高亮对应字幕，方便重听没有听清的表达、复习课程难点，或回顾交流中的重要信息。 从当下的实时理解，到结束后的回顾复习，CaptionWise 陪你更轻松地获取信息、更深入地理解内容。

projects.title: 【开源自荐】LiteMD：为 macOS 而生的轻量 Markdown 编辑器，永久免费开源
projects.author: gentpan

github.name: gentpan/LiteMD
github.description: 为 macOS 而生的轻量 Markdown 编辑器：实时预览、20 套配色、内置格式转换，文件始终是你自己的 .md

projects.summary: 我做了一个 macOS 上的 Markdown 编辑器 LiteMD，Swift + SwiftUI + AppKit 全原生， 不是 Electron 套壳，安装后 18 MB，磁盘映像 11 MB。MIT 协议，永久免费。 打开一个文件夹就能写，没有专有格式也没有数据库，笔记始终是你自己的 .md 文件 边写边渲染，标题、链接、代码、公式在编辑区里直接成形，也可以切源码或左右分栏 KaTeX 公式、代码高亮、Mermaid 图表随应用离线打包，断网照样渲染 20 套配色主题（10 浅 10 深），正文/标题/代码三种字体，字号行高行宽逐项可调 [[双链]] 与反向链接、大纲、全文搜索、命令面板、专注模式、打字机滚动 导入导出全部内置：Word、PPT、Excel、EPUB、PDF、网页、图片（文字识别）、 录音（本机语音识别）都能变成 Markdown；导出 HTML、PDF、Word、EPUB、LaTeX。 不需要装 Pandoc，也不需要 Python，转换全在本机完成 历史版本、iCloud 同步，备份指向你自己的 S3 兼容存储，凭据只存系统钥匙串 macOS 15+，Apple 芯片与 Intel 通用二进制，安装包已签名公证。
projects.titleZh: 【开源自荐】LiteMD：为 macOS 而生的轻量 Markdown 编辑器，永久免费开源
projects.summaryZh: LiteMD 是 macOS 上的原生 Markdown 编辑器，用 Swift + SwiftUI + AppKit 编写，体积约 18 MB，MIT 开源。
projects.titleEn: LiteMD: A Lightweight Native Markdown Editor for macOS
projects.summaryEn: Native SwiftUI Markdown editor for macOS. Opens plain .md folders; live rendering offline via KaTeX, Mermaid and code highlighting, plus [[wikilinks]], backlinks, search and command palette. Imports Word/PDF/EPUB, exports PDF/HTML/EPUB.
